chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 507: Rule of Desire
paragraphs: Han Xing shouted, "Radiance, use your strongest move!"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s command, the True God of Radiance executed it without hesitation.
He whispered, "Master, watch closely, this is the move I created after breaking through to True God."
"It’s called, Radiant Ten Thousand Me..."
The next moment, everyone was astonished to see in that chaotic time and space, countless God of Radiance simultaneously erupted with dazzling divine light.
The aura of each God of Radiance reached the level of the True God of Yellow Sand!

The True God of Yellow Sand, who was currently battling against him, was also somewhat surprised, "A method to forcefully increase a level for a burst technique? Indeed strong, but it merely touches upon the True God Level."
To Han Xing and others, the sudden elevation of the God of Radiance to a middle-tier True God was enough to surprise them.
However, from the perspective of the True God of Yellow Sand, this move just barely reached the level of True God.
The True God of Radiance did not get annoyed; he chuckled, "Just watch again."
As he finished speaking, the True God of Radiance extended his finger, pointing gently forward.
At the same time.
Numerous shadows of the True God of Radiance overlapped with him.
At this instant, the imposing manner of the True God of Radiance was skyrocketing.
Just after fusing with the third God of Radiance, his aura completely surpassed that of the True God of Yellow Sand!
Even more terrifying, the surrounding tens of thousands of God of Radiance continued to fuse.
The pupils of the True God of Yellow Sand transformed from initial surprise to complete shock!
"Fusion of the Self? What kind of move is this?"
"These shadows are you from another timeline, let alone fusion, even touching them would violate the Time Law, leading to immediate erasure!"
"You’ve just broken through to True God, how could you possibly violate the Time Law? Even those above True God can’t do it!"
"This is impossible!"
The True God of Radiance shook his head with a light laugh, "Of course, I haven’t violated the Time Law."
"What I command is the Rule of Light, which can be sunlight, or can be time."
"When I truly broke through to True God, I understood just how grand and vast the Light Element Rules are; even if I spend my entire life, I might never fully develop it."
"This is merely a small trick of the light element.
Sure enough, the True God of Radiance didn’t truly fuse with tens of thousands of himself, otherwise, that would be too monstrous!
However, he had now fused with 43 versions of himself.
His strength had surged tens of times over!
In the next moment, the True God of Radiance transformed into a Light Giant spanning the Void, then chuckled, "Master, this is just a simple application of the Light Element Rules."
"Even with such powerful forces fused, I still can’t fully unleash them."
"If I could fully unleash all the power, in this state, I would only need one move to slay the True God of Yellow Sand."
He spoke with utmost confidence.
Even everyone present felt that the True God of Radiance was right.
The True God of Yellow Sand roared angrily, "Arrogant!"
The True God of Radiance ignored him and shook his head regretfully, "Yet now, with this terrifying power, I can only make a simple attacking move."
At the same time, a spear as long as ten million meters appeared in the hand of the True God of Radiance.
He was akin to the mythological Sun God Apollo.
The movement of holding the spear was perfectly consistent.
"Master, watch closely!"
At this moment, Han Xing was straining every nerve to observe this move of the True God of Radiance.
His pupils had begun to turn white when the True God of Radiance fused with the first version of himself.
And now, Han Xing’s eyes even shed two lines of bloody tears!
This was because he was forcibly recording power far beyond his own, enduring immense backlash every second.
Han Xing’s figure trembled violently.
At the same time.
The spear of the True God of Radiance had already been shaped.
Upon sensing the horror of this strike, the True God of Yellow Sand began to retreat rapidly.
However, how could his speed be faster than light?
In the next instant, the Light Spear shot over in a flash.
At the same time, Han Xing was flung backward, forcefully exiting the Infinite Domain state.
Cheng Jianyong reacted the fastest, directly jumping up to catch the backward-flung Han Xing.
And Shen Yun, at the first moment, used Healing Technique, the Great Recovery Array, and even inserted a Life Tree Heart into his mouth.
Nevertheless, Han Xing’s lips bore a smile!
For before being flung away, he had heard a system prompt.
"Infinite Domain recording successful, now able to simulate the recorded attack."
Then, Han Xing tilted his head, entering a brief unconsciousness.
At the same time, that Light Spear caught up to the True God of Yellow Sand in an instant.
In terms of movement speed, the True God of Yellow Sand was not weak.
Sand in the Void could instantly escape millions of kilometers using energy fluctuations.
Yet, no matter how fast he was, he couldn’t outrun light.
The spear darted straight at him, and the True God of Yellow Sand felt a sense of impending doom!
However, being a True God, how could he not have his own signature moves?
Knowing he couldn’t avoid this strike, he stood his ground.
The Yellow Sand sneered, "Those who play with light, you’re not the only ones with True God Level techniques."
"A grain of sand, a world, the vast world, descend!"
Whoosh!
Endless yellow sand rained down.
Indeed, within these grains, as the True God of Yellow Sand had said, there were hidden small worlds.
Thud! Thud! Thud!
The Light Spear, unstoppable, pierced through an unknown number of small worlds.
The power of this spear was constantly being diminished.
Rumbling, the small worlds continuously collapsed, and the energy that leaked out even formed vortices of energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 507: Rule of Desire_2
paragraphs: The strangest thing was, Han Xing even saw one micro cataclysm after another inside it.
As if countless real small worlds were actually collapsing.
Even so,
the Light Spear still ended up hitting the True God of Yellow Sand.
In that instant, at least a thousand small worlds were blasted apart.
A fluctuation burst out that was a hundred times more terrifying than a full volley from the Divine Demon Battleship.
The tremors spread hundreds of millions of kilometers; the entire Forbidden Star River shuddered violently.
Even over in Silent City, they were staring up at the sky in shock.
In the face of that Power, even a Top-tier Divine Spirit felt so insignificant.
Right then, the three-eyed man who was soloing three True Gods suddenly slapped an enemy away with one palm, pulling open the distance.
Both sides couldn’t help but halt their battle.
They gazed toward the downstream direction of the Forbidden Star River.
A look of appreciation appeared in the three-eyed man’s eyes. "What a powerful Rule fluctuation—he’s faintly touching High-tier True God Level."
"Is that a True God Combat Skill, or some other Power?"
He could feel that within this Rule fluctuation, two auras were interwoven.
One belonged to the True God of Yellow Sand, the other to a newly ascended True God.
The intensity of the two auras was roughly evenly matched, and that conveyed a certain signal to the three-eyed man.
That newly ascended True God actually managed to stand up to Yellow Sand.
Sight returns to Han Xing’s battlefield.
After that single clash between the True God of Radiance and the True God of Yellow Sand...
he quickly retreated from the Radiant Ten Thousand Me State.
And because of that last strike, he’d overdrafted most of the True God of Radiance’s Divine Power.
Once he exited that State, his Power immediately began to plummet, to the point he was about to fall out of the True God Realm.
Of course, the True God of Yellow Sand wasn’t in good shape either.
He’d had his heart pierced through by that spear.
A bowl-sized bloody hole ran straight through his chest front to back.
Though for a True God, this degree of injury wasn’t enough to be fatal.
the Rule fluctuation imbued in it still sent his aura crashing down, almost dropping him out of the Middle-Tier True God Realm.
He looked at the True God of Radiance with a complicated expression and rasped, "You’re a terrifying bastard..."
"If you were allowed to settle for a while, get fully used to wielding the Light Element Rules, you might really be able, at the Initial Stage True God Realm, to fight on par with me."
The True God of Radiance chuckled. "Thanks for the compliment."
"So, are we still fighting now?"
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly. "Of course."
"You might have that terrifying burst method, but the load it puts on you is enormous."
"Even injured, I’m still stronger than you."
"And you, after using that move, your strength has already dropped a long way!"
The God of Radiance laughed lightly. "Is that so?"
And right then.
A pitch-black hammer suddenly appeared in the God of Radiance’s hand.
At the sight of that hammer, a hint of doubt flashed in the True God of Yellow Sand’s eyes. "This is..."
Han Xing and the others, however, all lit up.
Because they recognized that hammer.
It was the weapon used by the True God of Mighty Power.
A High-tier Divine Artifact!
Only existences at True God Level could wield it.
And now, after his breakthrough, the God of Radiance finally played his trump card!
As the Divine Power on the God of Radiance’s body flooded over the hammer’s haft...
that pitch-black iron hammer rapidly began to radiate limitless light!
The brutal Power made the God of Radiance’s aura surge sharply upward.
The True God of Yellow Sand exclaimed, "A High-tier Divine Artifact—you actually have a High-tier Divine Artifact in hand!"
"Just how many treasures do you people have?"
In that moment, the True God of Yellow Sand admitted he was truly jealous.
First those few human Legend-level fighters, using Technology Weapons that can heavily injure True Gods.
Then the True God of Radiance, breaking through and immediately possessing cross-realm combat strength.
Now he’d even pulled out a High-tier Divine Artifact!
People really will piss you off by comparison!
Think of him, the True God of Yellow Sand, entrenched in Silent City for so long, and he’d never managed to obtain a single High-tier Divine Artifact.
If that hammer were his, the True God of Yellow Sand would even dare take a swing at a High-tier True God!
The God of Radiance didn’t answer. The pitch-black hammer blossomed with endless radiance, illuminating the Void.
And once more granting him strength enough to contend with the True God of Yellow Sand.
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted. "So what if you have a High-tier Divine Artifact? In the end, you’re just a freshly ascended True God."
"And you’ve used that kind of forbidden move—you won’t last long!"
As his words fell, the True God of Yellow Sand charged in again.
The two once more launched into that bizarre duel.
The figures of the True God of Radiance and the True God of Yellow Sand kept on dying.
But it was indeed as the True God of Yellow Sand had said.
Right now, the True God of Radiance’s death speed was a bit faster.
Roughly every second, ten thousand Yellow Sand True Gods died.
While the True God of Radiance had to die a hundred thousand.
It’s a weird way to put it, but that was the reality.
Seeing this, the True God of Yellow Sand grew even more excited.
He seemed poised to unleash some technique, to completely suppress the True God of Radiance in one go.
Yellow sand swept across the sky; every single grain seemed to carry an extremely powerful Devouring Power, able to devour everything.
"Sandstorm! Burial of Heaven and Burial..."
However, before the True God of Yellow Sand could finish speaking.
The Divine Demon Battleship in the distance adjusted its angle again.
Including the Celestial Rail Strike Device, which had already finished charging at this moment.
Then, a voice rang out: "Radiance, pin him down for me!"
Hearing the voice, the God of Radiance obeyed without hesitation!
In the next instant, Chains of Light, thicker by more than a dozen times than before, suddenly appeared.
Those Chains of Light locked down tens of thousands of Yellow Sand True Gods.
Han Xing, who had already recovered his senses, suddenly froze. "Radiance, who the hell am I supposed to blast?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 507: Rule of Desire_3
paragraphs: The True God of Radiance said, "Master, these are all manifestations of the True God of Yellow Sand; whichever one you attack will inflict damage on him."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing burst into laughter.
"Very good!"
With that, Han Xing directly activated the Celestial Rail Strike Device, along with attacks from other Defense Towers, firing them all at once!
The True God of Yellow Sand immediately realized something was off, forcibly interrupting his current assault and struggled fiercely to break free.
However, the more he struggled, the more Chains of Light appeared from the True God of Radiance’s side.
At the same time.
A plethora of shells, cataclysmic attacks, the Divine Demon Battleship Main Cannon.
And a beam of light that twisted through space-time, struck the True God of Yellow Sand.
Boom!
A terrifying Energy Storm appeared once again.
These attacks weren’t the most terrifying.
The most terrifying was the beam of light from the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
When it hit one of the True God of Yellow Sand’s bodies, it split in half, instantly transforming into hundreds of thousands of beams of light.
Nearly all of the True God of Yellow Sand’s bodies were penetrated.
Realizing the terror of this shot, the True God of Yellow Sand’s expression changed slightly.
Within 0.0001 milliseconds, he reacted swiftly.
He chose to actively disperse the other manifestations of himself in different spaces.
Rustle...
One by one, the virtual images of the True God of Yellow Sand quickly dissipated.
Meanwhile, the Energy Storm swept through, enveloping all manifestations of the True God of Yellow Sand.
At this moment, although the True God of Yellow Sand scattered most of his virtual images, many were still hit by the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
Splurt!
When all the Energy Waves dissipated.
The silhouette of the True God of Yellow Sand appeared again.
But a bowl-sized bloody hole had been punched through his body.
With a complex expression, the True God of Yellow Sand looked at Han Xing; he was too engaged in battling the True God of Radiance.
Almost forgot that the nearby battleship could also pose a threat to him.
"Splurt!"
The True God of Yellow Sand spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing burst into laughter and asked, "Yellow Sand, are you bloody still willing to fight?
The True God of Yellow Sand took a deep look at him, then sneered, "Do you underestimate the existence of True God level?"
As soon as the words fell.
The True God of Yellow Sand swiftly summoned the Tree of Rules.
At the same time, a wave of Divine Power emanated suddenly from the luminous Tree of Rules.
The wounds of the True God of Yellow Sand were instantly healed.
This is the Life Force of a True God level!
As long as the rules remain, he cannot be killed.
Not only that, he can instantly recover from injuries, truly quite a cheat!
Then, the True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly, "Humph! With just these tricks, trying to repel a Middle-tier True God, how naive!"
"Today, I will certainly subdue all of you."
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
Well, it seems like this guy is ready to go all the way against them.
Han Xing looked at the True God of Radiance beside him, and asked, "Radiance, can you hold on?"
The God of Radiance also summoned the Tree of Rules, invisible Power of Rules was restoring his injuries, and his momentum swiftly soared.
He chuckled lightly, "No problem, Master."
Han Xing nodded, "Good, then let’s team up to take him down!"
"Once Madeleine breaks through, the three of us together can stall him, Yellow Sand won’t be able to leave even if he wants to!"
Upon hearing, the True God of Yellow Sand showed no sign of fear!
In the next moment.
The battle resumed between both sides!
While holding off the True God of Yellow Sand, the True God of Radiance also prevented him from bypassing and approaching Han Xing.
Han Xing, on the other hand, manipulated the Divine Demon Battleship, serving as auxiliary fire.
Every time the Celestial Rail Strike Device’s attack came.
Even the True God of Yellow Sand had to dodge.
Just like that, both sides fell into a stalemate.
Boom!
Wave after wave from the Celestial Rail Strike Device continued to blast; every appearance of the beam caused significant damage to the True God of Yellow Sand.
Then, the Silent Annihilation Lightning and Fury Heart Storm, along with various shells, bombarded in succession.
This was the most enjoyable bombardment Han Xing ever had.
Because all the danger in front had been completely blocked by the True God of Radiance.
And Han Xing and the others just needed to continue attacking.
Moreover, what they were bombing was a True God.
"Yellow Sand, take another shot from me!"
After saying that, Han Xing launched another wave of attacks from the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly.
But he could only dodge or block!
Not long after.
This void space was completely enveloped by the battle waves of True God level.
Outside these three silhouettes, anything less than a top-tier Divine Spirit would be doomed.
Time flew, a half-hour had passed.
Han Xing, who had been bombarding all along, felt a little bored.
He looked up at the blood-red Rule Tree in the sky and wondered, "Radiance, why hasn’t Madeleine broken through yet?"
The God of Radiance didn’t immediately reply but sent out a trace of Divine Power to probe.
Then, the God’s tone turned a bit strange, "Master, the Painful Empress’s state is somewhat peculiar..."
"Peculiar?"
"Yes, she seems to be transforming her Power of Rules, from the original Rule of Pain to another Power of Rules."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Huh? Transforming Power of Rules? Why?"
The God of Radiance pondered, "Perhaps she felt that the Law of Pain has too low a ceiling."
"The Painful Empress, besides mastering the Rule of Pain, also commands other rules."
"She might be transitioning to a higher-level Law of Desire."
Upon hearing, Han Xing fell into contemplation.
"Desire..."
This is also an extremely complex and powerful rule.
After all, regardless of how powerful one is, as long as you have consciousness, you possess desires.
The desire to survive, the desire to kill, the desire to vent.
Even vengeance, pain, all belong to desire.
And these desires can bring boundless strength to all beings.
This is not a simple rule.
It’s even akin to fundamental laws like light, dark, water, and fire!

And a beam of light that twisted through space-time, struck the True God of Yellow Sand.
Boom!
A terrifying Energy Storm appeared once again.
These attacks weren’t the most terrifying.
The most terrifying was the beam of light from the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
When it hit one of the True God of Yellow Sand’s bodies, it split in half, instantly transforming into hundreds of thousands of beams of light.
Nearly all of the True God of Yellow Sand’s bodies were penetrated.
Realizing the terror of this shot, the True God of Yellow Sand’s expression changed slightly.
Within 0.0001 milliseconds, he reacted swiftly.
He chose to actively disperse the other manifestations of himself in different spaces.
Rustle...
One by one, the virtual images of the True God of Yellow Sand quickly dissipated.
Meanwhile, the Energy Storm swept through, enveloping all manifestations of the True God of Yellow Sand.
At this moment, although the True God of Yellow Sand scattered most of his virtual images, many were still hit by the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
Splurt!
When all the Energy Waves dissipated.
The silhouette of the True God of Yellow Sand appeared again.
But a bowl-sized bloody hole had been punched through his body.
With a complex expression, the True God of Yellow Sand looked at Han Xing; he was too engaged in battling the True God of Radiance.
Almost forgot that the nearby battleship could also pose a threat to him.
"Splurt!"
The True God of Yellow Sand spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing burst into laughter and asked, "Yellow Sand, are you bloody still willing to fight?
The True God of Yellow Sand took a deep look at him, then sneered, "Do you underestimate the existence of True God level?"
As soon as the words fell.
The True God of Yellow Sand swiftly summoned the Tree of Rules.
At the same time, a wave of Divine Power emanated suddenly from the luminous Tree of Rules.
The wounds of the True God of Yellow Sand were instantly healed.
This is the Life Force of a True God level!
As long as the rules remain, he cannot be killed.
Not only that, he can instantly recover from injuries, truly quite a cheat!
Then, the True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly, "Humph!
With just these tricks, trying to repel a Middle-tier True God, how naive!"
"Today, I will certainly subdue all of you."
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
Well, it seems like this guy is ready to go all the way against them.
Han Xing looked at the True God of Radiance beside him, and asked, "Radiance, can you hold on?"
The God of Radiance also summoned the Tree of Rules, invisible Power of Rules was restoring his injuries, and his momentum swiftly soared.
He chuckled lightly, "No problem, Master."
Han Xing nodded, "Good, then let’s team up to take him down!"
"Once Madeleine breaks through, the three of us together can stall him, Yellow Sand won’t be able to leave even if he wants to!"
Upon hearing, the True God of Yellow Sand showed no sign of fear!
In the next moment.
The battle resumed between both sides!
While holding off the True God of Yellow Sand, the True God of Radiance also prevented him from bypassing and approaching Han Xing.
Han Xing, on the other hand, manipulated the Divine Demon Battleship, serving as auxiliary fire.
Every time the Celestial Rail Strike Device’s attack came.
Even the True God of Yellow Sand had to dodge.
Just like that, both sides fell into a stalemate.
Boom!
Wave after wave from the Celestial Rail Strike Device continued to blast; every appearance of the beam caused significant damage to the True God of Yellow Sand.
Then, the Silent Annihilation Lightning and Fury Heart Storm, along with various shells, bombarded in succession.
This was the most enjoyable bombardment Han Xing ever had.
Because all the danger in front had been completely blocked by the True God of Radiance.
And Han Xing and the others just needed to continue attacking.
Moreover, what they were bombing was a True God.
"Yellow Sand, take another shot from me!"
After saying that, Han Xing launched another wave of attacks from the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly.
But he could only dodge or block!
Not long after.
This void space was completely enveloped by the battle waves of True God level.
Outside these three silhouettes, anything less than a top-tier Divine Spirit would be doomed.
Time flew, a half-hour had passed.
Han Xing, who had been bombarding all along, felt a little bored.
He looked up at the blood-red Rule Tree in the sky and wondered, "Radiance, why hasn’t Madeleine broken through yet?"
The God of Radiance didn’t immediately reply but sent out a trace of Divine Power to probe.
Then, the God’s tone turned a bit strange, "Master, the Painful Empress’s state is somewhat peculiar..."
"Peculiar?"
"Yes, she seems to be transforming her Power of Rules, from the original Rule of Pain to another Power of Rules."
Han Xing was taken aback, "Huh?
Transforming Power of Rules?
Why?"
The God of Radiance pondered, "Perhaps she felt that the Law of Pain has too low a ceiling."
"The Painful Empress, besides mastering the Rule of Pain, also commands other rules."
"She might be transitioning to a higher-level Law of Desire."
Upon hearing, Han Xing fell into contemplation.
"Desire..."
This is also an extremely complex and powerful rule.
After all, regardless of how powerful one is, as long as you have consciousness, you possess desires.
The desire to survive, the desire to kill, the desire to vent.
Even vengeance, pain, all belong to desire.
And these desires can bring boundless strength to all beings.
This is not a simple rule.
It’s even akin to fundamental laws like light, dark, water, and fire!

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 508: Painful Empress’s Memories
paragraphs: And now, the Painful Empress is actually transforming towards this rule, which shows some real courage.
However, the True God of Yellow Sand coldly snorted beside, "Stupid, Madeleine majors in pain, and it’s exactly the pain that has allowed her to reach the top-tier Divine Spirit realm."
"Her understanding of desire is even less than some high-tier Divine Spirits!"
"Forcing a transformation of her Power of Rules now is no different from courting death!"
"Madeleine is bound to fail."
Han Xing looked at the True God of Radiance beside him and asked, "Radiance, is Yellow Sand speaking the truth?"
The True God of Radiance nodded after listening, "Master, Yellow Sand is correct, the Painful Empress lacks understanding of desire."
"Forcing a transformation now, if she fails, falling back to the top-tier Divine Spirit realm would be a lighter consequence."
"In severe cases, she might face the backlash of the Power of Rules and risk falling."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing furrowed his brow.
The crowd also looked with some tension towards the Painful Empress in the void.
The pure blood-colored Tree of Rules showed some pink mist, and aside from that, Han Xing even saw some multicolored fruits.
These fruits all symbolize the desires of various beings.
At this moment, the Tree of Rules was trembling intensely.
The magical Tree of Rules seemed about to dissipate.
Han Xing furrowed his brow further, "Radiance, is Madeleine’s success rate high now?"
Among countless True Gods of Radiance, one suddenly turned his head and said, "Master, after analysis, Madeleine’s success rate is less than 3%."
"If she gives up the transformation now and directly advances to True God using the Law of Pain, there’s still time."
Han Xing nodded after hearing this.
He looked at Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
"I’m handing over the control of the Divine Demon Battleship to you guys, I’ll go check on Madeleine’s situation."
"Try to assist Radiance in delaying time until I return."
Cheng Jianyong and others nodded heavily.
Then, without hesitation, Han Xing summoned the Oracle Throne, turning into a stream of light, rushed to the side of the Painful Empress’s Tree of Rules.
There, enveloped by a pink mist, it was impossible to see what was happening.
And as Han Xing entered the mist, he suddenly felt himself attacked by a peculiar force.
Deep within him, various desires were infinitely magnified!
At this moment, Han Xing only felt numerous voices echoing in his mind.
"I want to break the rules..."
"I want to keep all my friends alive!"
"I want the world’s strongest treasure, I want to overthrow all the goddesses..."
"I want to become a True God!"
"I want to become stronger! Even, surpass the four Supreme Gods!"
These thoughts originally hidden deep in his heart suddenly emerged one by one.
Moreover, these thoughts started growing infinitely under the pink mist’s effect.
Even, Han Xing desperately wanted to accomplish this moment.
His pupils turned extremely red.
Desire gradually devoured his reason completely!
At this time, a thought suddenly appeared in Han Xing’s mind.
"Kill the True God of Yellow Sand and make this guy pay the price for blaspheming the White Wolf!"
This thought once emerged and started growing crazily.
Han Xing immediately took out the Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow and drew the bowstring.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand’s complexion changed dramatically.
He only felt as if locked by a terrifying aura.
The terror level of that aura even surpassed the limits of a True God, reaching another mysterious and unpredictable realm.
The True God of Yellow Sand felt so small, his face almost twisted together!
This was something he had never experienced since becoming a Divine Spirit.
"What’s happening?"
Terror appeared in the eyes of the True God of Yellow Sand, he even instinctively wanted to flee.
And then, on Han Xing’s side.
He suddenly felt two magical powers emerge.
These two forces quickly suppressed the various desires within him.
At this instant, Han Xing swiftly regained consciousness.
And he looked at his talent panel, where an SSS-level Talent and an SS-level Talent were both glowing.
"Did these two talents help me break free from that state?"
Han Xing felt a bit strange.
However, now was not the time to consider these things.
"Whew..."
Han Xing took deep breaths, forcibly suppressed these distracting thoughts, and his eyes regained tranquility.
And below, the True God of Yellow Sand, who was ready to run away, suddenly felt the force locking him vanish.
For a moment, he was somewhat unsure.
He didn’t know what had happened.
But what he didn’t know was, just now, he had already walked once through the gates of hell.
At this moment, Han Xing, who adjusted his state well, shouted within the mist, "Madeleine, I’m Han Xing, can you hear me?"
There was no response within the pink mist.
Han Xing continued to shout several times, "Madeleine."
When he called out her true name for the fourth time,
A projection suddenly appeared before Han Xing.
In this projection, Han Xing saw a lush green forest.
Under one of its leaves, a small spider emerged from an egg.
At the same time, many more spiders hatched along with this small spider.
Their bodies were blood-red, and they were born with a strong predatory instinct.
One spider, somewhat unique in appearance with a spiral pattern on its abdomen, learned the fastest.
In a very short time, it learned to weave webs and catch prey.
After a short half-month of growth.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 508: Memories of the Painful Empress (2)
paragraphs: This spider caught many prey, its body growing rapidly, gradually transforming into a large spider one meter long.
Then, a girl’s body grew out of the spider’s body.
This girl was also unclad, with eight compound eyes on her forehead.
Though very young, Han Xing could vaguely see some familiar feelings from her face.
This should be the youthful Painful Empress.
She didn’t seem to possess the same allure she does now.
Back then, she had an innocent and sweet smile on her face.
However, when she was feeding, her smile suddenly disappeared, turning into a terrifying expression, forming a stark contrast.
In this way, the youthful Painful Empress continued to grow.
Her body kept getting bigger.
Of course, the most noticeable growth was her proud bust.
Though she had the appearance of a fifteen or sixteen-year-old girl, she already displayed a devilish figure.
Currently, this was ignored considering the spider’s lower body.
Young Madeleine learned to make a set of clothes using a spider web to cover her private areas.
Just when she thought her days would continue without worries.
One day, a terrifying creature broke into the forest she inhabited.
The creature had the body of a bull, the head of a lion, and the horns of a goat.
Its body was burning with dark flames.
This monster was called the World-Ending Demon.
It arrived and began feeding in the forest.
Each step left a patch of black flame behind.
The World-Ending Demon quickly noticed the Blood Spider Race in the forest.
The blood spiders had pure blood energy, which was exactly what it craved.
One by one, blood spiders were caught by the World-Ending Demon, then directly swallowed or crushed with its claws.
Madeleine, however, hid in a ground cave, luckily escaping harm.
The World-Ending Demon nearly turned the forest upside down, finding all the blood spiders.
Watching her kin die one by one, Madeleine could only huddle in the cave, fear evident on her young face.
When she emerged again, the forest had been burned down, and her kin had been slaughtered.
In the great fire, Madeleine felt complete hatred and anguish.
The blood spider began its path of growth, rapidly advancing from Tier One to Tier Two.
Then to Tier Three and Tier Four.
In just two hundred years, she broke through to Legend.
With legendary power, the Painful Empress had become a strong presence in her world.
Then, through various inquiries, she discovered the presence of those World-Ending Demons.
Ironically, the World-Ending Demons had established their own divine halls and statues in this world.
To be worshiped by the masses.
Madeleine forcefully broke into the divine hall.
However, she saw many of her kin made into specimens, unclad, exhibited in the divine hall.
Even stronger hatred and anguish stimulated her nerves.
After that battle, Madeleine, unable to defeat the World-Ending Demons, was severely injured and narrowly escaped with her life.
Later, Madeleine hid in a Secret Realm, cultivating even more diligently.
Until she broke through to become a Demigod.
And those World-Ending Demons also discovered her presence.
After a world-shaking battle.
Madeleine defeated them.
And became the only Demigod in their world.
Madeleine completed her revenge, but the pain in her heart did not dissipate at all.
Because she was now the last blood spider in the world.
After this, Madeleine cultivated to the Divine Realm.
Then used her Power to create a new Blood Spider Race.
Later, Madeleine entered the Void and found the Land of Divine War.
Then she became the top-tier Divine Spirit, the Painful Empress that Han Xing encountered.
After Han Xing finished witnessing Madeleine’s growth journey, a voice suddenly echoed in his ears.
"Oh my... everything about me has been seen by the master~"
This voice was imbued with strong allure and tenderness, entirely unlike the Painful Empress’s usual tone.
But Han Xing knew that this was due to the Painful Empress shifting towards another Rule.
So, Han Xing said, "Madeleine, don’t transform towards the Rule of Desire anymore."
"You’ve already achieved True God breakthrough relying on the Rule of Pain."
The Painful Empress didn’t reply but asked, "Master, why aren’t you affected by my Desire Power? Or could it be that my understanding of the Rule of Desire is really poor?"
Her tone suddenly became very despondent, carrying a hint of slight melancholy.
Such a voice would make people unable to resist wanting to hold her tightly and cherish her.
Han Xing also felt the impact of this Desire Power again, his pupils slightly red.
They both guessed wrong; the Painful Empress’s understanding of the Rule of Desire was no weaker than the Rule of Pain.
This level of Desire Power would instantly corrupt even a top-tier True God.
But Han Xing suppressed it entirely relying on his Talent.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, your Desire Power indeed affected me, but it was suppressed by my force."
Hearing this, the Painful Empress’s tone became playful again, "Oh, that’s good, I thought I had no charm at all..."
Han Xing said, "Madeleine, why do you have to transform toward the Rule of Desire?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 508: Painful Empress’s Memories_3
paragraphs: Upon hearing the question, the Painful Empress remained silent for a moment.
Then, she chuckled softly once again, "Master, do you know? Pain has its limits~"
"This rule has accompanied me all my life, granting me power yet bringing endless torment."
"Many times, I was tortured by this rule so much that I even wanted to end myself..."
"But at that time, I remembered that I was the only Blood Spider left in the world, and I had to survive."
After Han Xing listened, he looked at the Painful Empress again.
It turned out that Madeleine was not as crazy as she appeared.
Many times, she even wanted to end herself through suicide.
The Painful Empress continued, "As I grew stronger, the pain brought by the power of that rule intensified."
"Every night, I was tortured by this force of pain to the point of being unable to endure."
"I wanted to vent, wanted to kill everything!"
"To prevent myself from being completely devoured by this pain, I could only transform pain into desire."
"If I were to break through to become a True God, the pain would be even more intense, and I might not be able to carry on."
"It’s likely I would be tortured to suicide by the Rule of Pain first..."
Madeleine completely unveiled her inner thoughts to Han Xing.
Han Xing was momentarily stunned, then realized and nodded.
Indeed, who would want to always accompany pain?
The Painful Empress had been tortured by this rule for so many years; it seemed to be her only chance for transformation.
So, Han Xing asked, "Is there anything I can help you with?"
In the void, the figure of the Painful Empress suddenly appeared.
Her body was under the shroud of pink mist, and her skin showed a pale pink hue.
She wore simple leather armor, covering her magnificent chest.
Smooth and slim waistlines were fully revealed.
Plus, that self-smoking effect from her makeup.
She was a dark beauty incarnate.
At this moment, she looked at Han Xing with endless allure.
Then nodded softly, "Master, you can help me."
"Oh? How to help?"
The Painful Empress showed a trace of shyness on her face and said softly, "I’ve now reached the final step of transformation."
"Striving to suppress the desire within me, preventing it from completely bursting out,
"Once burst, the Rule of Desire will disperse my Rule of Pain, leading to my total annihilation."
"So, I need to release some of the power of the Law of Desire to create a balance."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing confusedly asked, "How do you need me to do that?"
The Painful Empress lifted her eyes, "That means, Master and I... perform that act..."
Upon hearing that, Han Xing understood completely.
He looked at the Painful Empress with a somewhat strange expression.
At this moment, Madeleine’s delicate shoulders were slightly trembling.
Lowering her head, occasionally casting gentle and watery glances toward Han Xing.
Although Han Xing had been experienced with many beauties,
Doing such things with the Blood Spider Race... he had never thought of it.
Yet, as he had said before, ignoring the spider-like lower half of the Painful Empress’s body.
She was also a peerless beauty comparable to Elinora, the Dark Night Goddess.
At the moment, seeing Han Xing’s hesitant appearance.
The Painful Empress said sadly, "Master, do you dislike my spider body?"
Han Xing was stunned, then shook his head, "Not at all, if you don’t mind, then let’s do it."
Upon hearing this, the sadness on the Painful Empress’s face instantly disappeared, transforming into intense joy.
She opened her arms in a welcoming gesture.
Han Xing paused, sighing.
Then took the initiative to embrace the Painful Empress.
In the void, two powerful figures intertwined.
At this moment, with a ripping sound.
The leather armor on the Painful Empress shattered.
Revealing smooth, explosive, devilishly hot upper body.
Her two arms gently supported her chest; the weight was simply captivating.
Han Xing’s pupils widened instantly.
Though he had encountered several well-built women.
But a woman like the Painful Empress, having one larger than her head, he was seeing for the first time.
At the moment, she gently embraced Han Xing.
The skin of the two touched.
At this moment, Han Xing deeply felt the Painful Empress’s scorching skin.
That was almost a heat that would burn Han Xing.
Furthermore, at the moment of their contact, the Painful Empress seemed to be electrified, raising her swan-like jade neck.
Emitting a ethereal and prolonged sigh.
"Hmm—"
After a long sigh, the Painful Empress encircled Han Xing with six arms.
Han Xing only felt warm and soft sensations from the front.
Coupled with the occasional desire dust.
Han Xing didn’t know if it was the influence of the power of desire at times.
But at this moment, he was completely immersed.
After some intense entanglement, the Painful Empress’s eyes blurred.
The two progressed directly to the last step.
At this moment, Han Xing only felt a strong heat rushing to his whole body.
He looked at the Painful Empress in amazement.
He never imagined that the spider’s body could be so hot.
That was a completely different sensation.
The Painful Empress chuckled softly, "Master, what do you think of my taste~"
Han Xing remained speechless for a long time before he could only say: "Impressive."
"Hee hee hee~"
After receiving Han Xing’s affirmation, the Painful Empress let herself go even more.
And led Han Xing, time and time again, to experience intensely strong impacts.
Fortunately, this was near her Tree of Rules.
Plus, as the Painful Empress shifted toward the Desire Empress, the powerful rule fluctuations already shielded all perceptions.
Even the True God of Yellow Sand didn’t know what was happening in this mist.
Time quickly passed fifteen minutes.
Due to the outside battle between the True God of Radiance and the True God of Yellow Sand.
This entanglement was not suitable to last long...

sentences.text: Upon hearing the question, the Painful Empress remained silent for a moment.
Then, she chuckled softly once again, "Master, do you know?
Pain has its limits~"
"This rule has accompanied me all my life, granting me power yet bringing endless torment."
"Many times, I was tortured by this rule so much that I even wanted to end myself..."
"But at that time, I remembered that I was the only Blood Spider left in the world, and I had to survive."
After Han Xing listened, he looked at the Painful Empress again.
It turned out that Madeleine was not as crazy as she appeared.
Many times, she even wanted to end herself through suicide.
The Painful Empress continued, "As I grew stronger, the pain brought by the power of that rule intensified."
"Every night, I was tortured by this force of pain to the point of being unable to endure."
"I wanted to vent, wanted to kill everything!"
"To prevent myself from being completely devoured by this pain, I could only transform pain into desire."
"If I were to break through to become a True God, the pain would be even more intense, and I might not be able to carry on."
"It’s likely I would be tortured to suicide by the Rule of Pain first..."
Madeleine completely unveiled her inner thoughts to Han Xing.
Han Xing was momentarily stunned, then realized and nodded.
Indeed, who would want to always accompany pain?
The Painful Empress had been tortured by this rule for so many years; it seemed to be her only chance for transformation.
So, Han Xing asked, "Is there anything I can help you with?"
In the void, the figure of the Painful Empress suddenly appeared.
Her body was under the shroud of pink mist, and her skin showed a pale pink hue.
She wore simple leather armor, covering her magnificent chest.
Smooth and slim waistlines were fully revealed.
Plus, that self-smoking effect from her makeup.
She was a dark beauty incarnate.
At this moment, she looked at Han Xing with endless allure.
Then nodded softly, "Master, you can help me."
"Oh?
How to help?"
The Painful Empress showed a trace of shyness on her face and said softly, "I’ve now reached the final step of transformation."
"Striving to suppress the desire within me, preventing it from completely bursting out,
"Once burst, the Rule of Desire will disperse my Rule of Pain, leading to my total annihilation."
"So, I need to release some of the power of the Law of Desire to create a balance."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing confusedly asked, "How do you need me to do that?"
The Painful Empress lifted her eyes, "That means, Master and I... perform that act..."
Upon hearing that, Han Xing understood completely.
He looked at the Painful Empress with a somewhat strange expression.
At this moment, Madeleine’s delicate shoulders were slightly trembling.
Lowering her head, occasionally casting gentle and watery glances toward Han Xing.
Although Han Xing had been experienced with many beauties,
Doing such things with the Blood Spider Race... he had never thought of it.
Yet, as he had said before, ignoring the spider-like lower half of the Painful Empress’s body.
She was also a peerless beauty comparable to Elinora, the Dark Night Goddess.
At the moment, seeing Han Xing’s hesitant appearance.
The Painful Empress said sadly, "Master, do you dislike my spider body?"
Han Xing was stunned, then shook his head, "Not at all, if you don’t mind, then let’s do it."
Upon hearing this, the sadness on the Painful Empress’s face instantly disappeared, transforming into intense joy.
She opened her arms in a welcoming gesture.
Han Xing paused, sighing.
Then took the initiative to embrace the Painful Empress.
In the void, two powerful figures intertwined.
At this moment, with a ripping sound.
The leather armor on the Painful Empress shattered.
Revealing smooth, explosive, devilishly hot upper body.
Her two arms gently supported her chest; the weight was simply captivating.
Han Xing’s pupils widened instantly.
Though he had encountered several well-built women.
But a woman like the Painful Empress, having one larger than her head, he was seeing for the first time.
At the moment, she gently embraced Han Xing.
The skin of the two touched.
At this moment, Han Xing deeply felt the Painful Empress’s scorching skin.
That was almost a heat that would burn Han Xing.
Furthermore, at the moment of their contact, the Painful Empress seemed to be electrified, raising her swan-like jade neck.
Emitting a ethereal and prolonged sigh.

After a long sigh, the Painful Empress encircled Han Xing with six arms.
Han Xing only felt warm and soft sensations from the front.
Coupled with the occasional desire dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 1007 - 509: Han Xing’s Second True God Subordinate
paragraphs: The Painful Empress hugged Han Xing, her whole body starting to tremble violently.
This tremor was so intense that even Han Xing almost got sucked into her.
After a high-pitched sigh from the Painful Empress, all movement subsided.
And on Han Xing’s side, a system notification popped up.
[Due to unknown reasons, you have received the Painful Empress’s overflowing Power of Rules, Divine Power Value +5000]
Han Xing’s eyes widened. "Damn, it can actually increase Divine Power Value?"
At this moment, after several minutes of panting, the Painful Empress also gradually calmed down.
Han Xing could clearly feel that the aura on her body had shifted.
From the previous oppressive pain, it had turned into seduction and ethereality.
She shot Han Xing a charming smile, then said softly, "Master is amazing, this slave has succeeded~"
Hearing this, joy flashed in Han Xing’s eyes. "As long as you’ve succeeded."
"Now, start your breakthrough."
The Painful Empress licked her lips, looking like she still hadn’t had enough.
She said softly, "Master, after this, you must make time to satisfy this slave~"
Han Xing was speechless.
But he still nodded. "Go, go, I promise you."
Hearing Han Xing’s promise, the Painful Empress skipped away happily like a little girl who’d gotten candy.
Then, a set of Leather Armor once again covered the Painful Empress’s body, and in the next instant she directly merged into the Rules.
This time, because everything was ready.
The Painful Empress’s breakthrough was extremely fast.
That Tree of Rules rapidly grew stronger, and hundreds, thousands of fruits sprouted from it.
Rumble!
The Void began to quake violently.
The breakthrough might of the Painful Empress was in no way weaker than that of the God of Radiance.
At this moment.
The True God of Radiance, who was struggling against the True God of Yellow Sand, had been fighting for nearly an hour and was already somewhat exhausted.
True Gods are very strong, with boundless stamina, undying and immortal.
But no matter how strong a True God is, they can’t stand this kind of high-intensity battle forever.
And just then, they suddenly felt the Void shaking like crazy.
Everyone looked up, staring in shock at the direction of that Tree of Rules in the Void.
"Hm? Did Madeleine succeed in breaking through?"
Cheng Jianyong and the others, along with the True God of Radiance, all showed delight on their faces.
Because in that case, they’d have another True God Level ally.
And at this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand sensed something different in this wave of Power of Rules.
He exclaimed in shock, "This is... the Rule of Desire. The Painful Empress actually managed to master the Rule of Desire!"
Not only the True God of Yellow Sand, but even those terrifying beings sealed within the entire Forbidden Star River were staring at the outside world in shock.
"Another True God of a Main Rule, and this time it’s the Rule of Desire?"
"Strange! Wasn’t it said that no Divine Spirit has mastered the Rule of Desire for tens of thousands of years?"
"What on earth is happening out there?"
These sealed True Gods all felt a strong surge of curiosity in their hearts.
At this moment, the Painful Empress gradually reappeared within that Power of Rules.
She spoke softly.
"Desire like the sea, passion like fire, the heart like a bright mirror, find the true self."
"Today, the Rule of Desire is formed."
"I decree: Under desire, indulging the true self can make one forget all pain."
"I decree: Under desire, all beings are equal."
"I decree: Desire can lead to hope..."
"I decree..."
As the Painful Empress laid down rule after rule.
The Void kept trembling without end.
Over at the Silent City, the four True Gods locked in fierce battle all sensed this terrifying disturbance.
The three-eyed man said in surprise, "Oh? Madeleine broke through too?"
"And it’s not the Law of Pain, but the Law of Desire?
"Gutsy!"
The three-eyed man gave a heartfelt exclamation of praise!
After all, giving up the Rules one is best at and switching to another Rule carries the risk of falling if one isn’t careful.
And yet the Painful Empress had really succeeded.
Calling her a Demon wouldn’t be an exaggeration.
At this moment, the three Divine Spirits besieging him all had intense shock in their eyes.
They hadn’t expected that in just one day, two more True Gods would appear.
At this rate, even the True God of Yellow Sand might not be able to take those humans down.
The three-eyed man chuckled. "You guys, still want to keep fighting?"
"The True God of Yellow Sand might be running into some trouble over there. You sure you don’t want to go help him out?"
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon and the Deep Sea Worm immediately retorted, "No way!"
"Yellow Sand is a Middle-tier True God. Even if two True Gods show up, they still can’t be a match for Yellow Sand!"
"That’s right. Aren’t you being besieged by the three of us and can’t fight back either?"
However, the three-eyed man just shook his head. "You still don’t understand the difference between Main Rules and Branch Rules."
"That man controls the Light Element Law, which is one of the world’s Basic Element Laws, so the moment he broke through he could fight the True God of Yellow Sand on even footing."
"And Madeleine has mastered the Law of Desire, which is even more wondrous than the Basic Element Law."
"Once these two Rule Masters of Main Rules go all out, even the True God of Yellow Sand will run into quite a bit of trouble."
The three-eyed man was not wrong.
On Han Xing’s side.
The Painful Empress, who had just emerged from the Void, waved her hand casually.
Countless Red threads filled the sky, completely shrouding the Void, actually trying to bind the True God of Yellow Sand.
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly. "With just this bit of Power, you think you can trap this True God?"
"Break for me!"
In an instant, a powerful Sandstorm Burst out from the True God of Yellow Sand’s body.
Yet the strange thing was, as a Middle-tier True God, his Power actually couldn’t tear open the Painful Empress’s great net right away.

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 509: Han Xing’s Second True God Subordinate (Part 2)
paragraphs: The True God of Yellow Sand’s sand particles passed through the Painful Empress’s powerful web without causing any obstruction.
The True God of Yellow Sand’s eyes were once again filled with shock, "How is this possible?"
Before he could react.
"Hehe~"
The Painful Empress chuckled lightly.
A huge web had already completely enveloped the True God of Yellow Sand.
Though in that instant, the True God of Yellow Sand split into tens of thousands of clones.
However, he was startled to discover that the clone trapped by the web instantly had his pupils turn bright red.
As if an invisible force was impacting his soul.
Even more bizarre, this phenomenon began to spread rapidly like a plague.
All the True Gods of Yellow Sand were infected by this terrifying force, losing their sanity.
Everyone only heard the True God of Yellow Sand suddenly let out a low growl.
"Roar! Roar!"
And deep within the heart of the True God of Yellow Sand, the desires buried at the bottom started to expand rapidly.
He continuously shouted in his heart!
"I want to refine the most powerful mummy, I want to find the immortal Pharaoh!"
"I also want to build the most magnificent temple until I become the greatest King of the Desert!"
Tens of thousands of clones of the True God of Yellow Sand trembled violently.
Yet this scene made Cheng Jianyong and the True God of Radiance’s eyes light up.
They almost without hesitation launched their strongest attacks.
"Old Sand, take this shot!"
"Divine Skill: Rain of Light!"
The Celestial Rail Strike Device and the True God of Radiance’s area-wide attack blasted simultaneously.
However, at this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand was still in a state controlled by desire, unable to break free.
Until the attack approached, the True God of Yellow Sand instantly felt a premonition of death!
The instinct for survival forced him to suppress that terrifying desire.
And the moment he regained clarity, he saw the terrifying attack was already close.
"Damn it!"
The True God of Yellow Sand was nearly scared out of his wits!
He once again transformed into a vast desert, even revealing the part of his Desert Temple that had been blown apart.
Boom!
Crash!
The light beams of the Celestial Rail Strike Device and the Feather of Light of the True God of Radiance fell simultaneously.
That desert instantly endured at least tens of thousands of hits.
Then, the terrifying energy fluctuations completely enveloped that area, from afar, everyone couldn’t even see what was happening.
And when the attack dissipated.
The True God of Yellow Sand spat out a mouthful of blood and was blown back tens of thousands of kilometers!
"You all..."
Before the True God of Yellow Sand could react.
The Painful Empress’s attack descended once more.
From her body, waves of infinite Seven-Colored Divine Power were released.
These Seven-Colored Divine Powers turned into intertwining circles.
And these circles symbolized the seven emotions and six desires of all beings.
Then, the True God of Yellow Sand was captured by the circle again.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand’s expression began to change rapidly.
Sometimes insane, sometimes angry, sometimes lewd, sometimes crying...
Even more horrifying, the aura of the True God of Yellow Sand was rapidly decaying.
As if in an instant, the True God of Yellow Sand had lived through tens of thousands of years.
Everyone watched this scene in shock, their eyes filled with fear.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Oh my... what kind of method is this Painful Empress using, it’s too bizarre!"
The True God of Radiance squinted, "Indeed, the Painful Empress’s method involves not just illusions but also the Time Law."
"It’s as if the True God of Yellow Sand is really experiencing the scenes in those illusions."
"If it were any top-tier divine spirit caught by this move, they might age instantly, trapped in hallucination until their death."
After hearing the True God of Radiance’s explanation.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun couldn’t help but shiver.
This is too wicked.
A single move to control one to death!
And just then.
The body of the True God of Yellow Sand began to shake violently.
He seemed to be exerting all his strength to break free from the controlling state.
"Damn it! This is all fake! It’s all fake!"
The True God of Yellow Sand shouted hoarsely, "Jenny, Gulira, you are all fake, all fake, arghhh!!"
"Break free for me!!"
Buzz!
An invisible wave of divine power spread from the True God of Yellow Sand’s body.
Crack!
With the sound of a crisp fracturing.
The True God of Yellow Sand seemed to have broken some kind of restraint, clarity returning to his eyes.
He immediately summoned the Tree of Rules, rapidly restoring his aged body.
Then, he looked at the Painful Empress with lingering fear.
"Madeleine, what exactly is this rule of yours? This isn’t desire at all!"
The Painful Empress chuckled lightly, "This is desire~"
"All beings suffer; only by sinking deeply into desire can one forget time, forget pain."
After listening, the True God of Yellow Sand looked at the Painful Empress with a complex gaze.
"Is the gap between mastering the main rule and controlling branch rules so huge?"
"My Rule of Yellow Sand originates from the Earth Element Rule, but the Earth Element Rule is already occupied by that one..."
"Is this really my limit?"
The True God of Yellow Sand seemed to begin doubting himself.
Being ravaged consecutively by two newly ascended true gods was enough to make him lose face.
Han Xing then asked, "Radiance, do we have any method to completely kill a true god now?"
Fighting until now, Han Xing realized how troublesome true gods were.
They were truly as hard to kill as cockroaches.
Even now, with the Painful Empress, the True God of Radiance, and his own Divine Demon Battleship, they could surely suppress the True God of Yellow Sand.
However, they couldn’t manage to eliminate the opponent.
The True God of Yellow Sand could instantly recover his injuries.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 509: Han Xing’s Second True God Subordinate (Part 3)
paragraphs: The God of Radiance shook his head and said, "No way, Master, true gods are very hard to kill."
"Unless we can directly attack his Tree of Rules and destroy it, this true god will lose his energy source."
"However, the Tree of Rules is an intangible existence. It might be a will or possibly an energy."
"So far, no one has been able to bypass the true god and directly attack the Tree of Rules."
Han Xing also fell into deep thought.

The God of Radiance continued, "However, if we can completely eradicate the True God of Yellow Sand’s body, he will return to the Tree of Rules and fall into a dormant state, unable to resurrect for at least a month."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up instantly.
"Oh? We can make him sleep for a month?"
"Well then, what the hell are we waiting for!"
"Madeleine, Radiance, go all out."
"It’s fine if we can’t kill him, just put him to sleep first!"
Upon hearing this, the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress unhesitatingly launched their attack.
The sky filled with Feathers of Light, and Divine Power Spider Webs filled the void.
The face of the True God of Yellow Sand turned ominous.
Although true gods can resurrect infinitely.
But such resurrection does not come without a cost.
Each time a true god resurrects, part of their consciousness is assimilated by the Power of Rules
Until the number of resurrections exceeds the limit, they become completely enslaved by the rules.
In that state, it’s not you controlling the rules but the rules controlling you.
However, as a middle-tier true god, the True God of Yellow Sand did not believe they could put him in a dormant state.
"Hmph! Mastering the Main Rule is powerful, but you far underestimate the gap between an initial-tier true god and a middle-tier true god!"
With those words.
The True God of Yellow Sand once again summoned the Tree of Rules.
At this moment, that exquisitely 3D-model-like Tree of Rules was emitting a faint yellow light in the void.
The True God of Yellow Sand extended his hand, and a terrifying power descended upon him.
At this moment, the momentum of the True God of Yellow Sand surged!
"Hoo—hoohoo—"
A terrifying sandstorm swept across, directly eroding the God of Radiance’s Feathers of Light, turning them into scattered light spots.
As for the Painful Empress’s webs, they began to show signs of breaking.
Moreover, the terrifying sandstorm rapidly expanded, seeming to sweep both true gods, along with the Divine Demon Battleship, into it.
Originally on the back foot, the Yellow Sand became lively once again because of this move.
Both sides engaged in a terrifying battle.
Han Xing returned to the Divine Demon Battleship, and under the protection of the two true gods, began recklessly firing the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
Columns of deathly light fired continuously, and even the True God of Yellow Sand did not dare to take them head-on.
The battle continued for another two hours.
True god-level battles are like this, taking years or even decades to determine a winner.
What Han Xing and the others were experiencing was considered a small skirmish.
However, through the combined efforts of Han Xing, the Painful Empress, and the God of Radiance, the aura of the True God of Yellow Sand weakened once more.
But this was of no use.
Unless Han Xing could strike him down in one blow, or directly use the Hunter’s Burning Blood Arrow for an instant kill.
Otherwise, the True God of Yellow Sand would soon recover.
Han Xing furrowed his brows, realizing this wasn’t a sustainable approach.
If he allowed the True God of Yellow Sand to stall here for months, it would not only waste his time.
But something might also go wrong.
As he knew, the Holy Spirit Realm was still resisting the Abyss Realm’s army.
This time, Han Xing and his group had already been away for months, and he decided that once he reached demigod, he would return immediately.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly came up with an idea.
He shouted, "Radiance, Madeleine, restrain the True God of Yellow Sand with all your might."
"I’m going to use my trump card."
"First, blow him up, and then no one in Silent City can stop us!"
"This time, we’re going to raid every race in Silent City!
Han Xing’s bandit-like statement made the True God of Yellow Sand feel disdainful.
"Ha... a mere legend dares to say he’ll blow up a true god like me?"
Yet, the God of Radiance and the Painful Empress immediately executed Han Xing’s command.
They summoned the Tree of Rules simultaneously, and limitless Power of Rules began to augment them.
Buzz!
From both true gods emanated unlimited mighty power, their strongest state!
The next moment, the sky filled with Chains of Light and thousands of Divine Power Spider Webs, plus the Reincarnation Circle all targeted the True God of Yellow Sand.
The True God of Yellow Sand’s expression changed drastically.
And at that moment, he seemed to recall something, during his battle with the God of Radiance, he suddenly felt a terrifying aura locking onto him.
That aura even made him feel a suffocating sense of death!
Could this be what that kid referred to as his trump card?
Just as this thought arose, a formless fear enveloped the mind of the True God of Yellow Sand.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand chose to follow his instincts.
"Hmph! Consider yourselves lucky!"
"I have important matters to attend to in Silent City, so I won’t continue to tangle with you here!"
However, everyone could tell that the True God of Yellow Sand was conceding, and he seemed ready to retreat.
Han Xing shouted, "Radiance, Madeleine, stop him!"
The two true gods followed Han Xing’s instructions and rushed forward immediately.
However, by then, the True God of Yellow Sand had already transformed into a mass of quicksand, rapidly disappearing from the spot.
Whoosh!
The countless Divine Power Spider Webs and Chains of Light missed their target.
At the same time, that mass of sand rapidly shrank, disappearing into the horizon at high speed.
So fast that even the God of Radiance and Madeleine struggled to keep up.
Moments later, the two true gods returned.
They looked at Cao Xing and said apologetically, "Sorry, Master, we let the Yellow Sand escape."

chapters.title: Chapter 1010 - 510: [Black Abyss Realm Creation: Lingxiao]
paragraphs: The Painful Empress also said with a face full of guilt, "It’s my fault, my Lord, please punish me~"
However, Han Xing smiled and said, "What are you thinking? I originally wanted the True God of Yellow Sand to escape on his own."
"Otherwise, do you really think I have the means to deal with a True God?"
The two True Gods looked at each other in disbelief, because they unconditionally trusted Han Xing.
Han Xing chuckled, "Alright, I was just trying to scare the True God of Yellow Sand earlier, and I didn’t expect to actually scare him away."
The group was stunned upon hearing this, then smiles appeared on their faces.
Of course, they didn’t let their guard down and remained vigilant.
It wasn’t until more than ten minutes later, when the presence of the True God of Yellow Sand was completely gone, that everyone breathed a sigh of relief!
At this time, the True God of Radiance and the Painful Empress also returned to the Divine Demon Battleship.
Looking at everyone’s expressions, Han Xing chuckled.
Then he said, "Now, let’s congratulate Radiance and Madeleine on their breakthrough to True God!"
"Wuhu!"
Cheng Jianyong was the first to respond, and the team cheered exuberantly.
Even the Samoyed and other Blood Spiders in the cabin were very happy.
After all, with two more True God level forces in the team, it was a huge boost!
In this way, they would no longer fear being hunted by True Gods.
The True God of Radiance and the Painful Empress also had joyful smiles on their faces.
Radiance said, "I owe it all to my Lord for giving me this opportunity."
"Otherwise, I might never have reached this level in my lifetime."
The Painful Empress beside him also nodded slightly, "Yes, if it weren’t for my Lord’s help, I would have failed this breakthrough."
After speaking, the Painful Empress looked at Han Xing with endlessly seductive eyes.
Han Xing suddenly thought of what happened in the fog and felt somewhat embarrassed.
The group didn’t know what happened inside and didn’t think much about it.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong said, "Brother Xing, our next step is to protect you during your breakthrough, right?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Upon hearing this, the group showed expressions of anticipation.
Even the two True Gods had never seen someone break through to Demigod by breaking the rules.
This was also a rare experience for them.
However, Han Xing said, "But, not breaking through now."
"Because I don’t know what will happen after breaking the rules."
"But I have a premonition that this breakthrough will bring a great fear, a great crisis."
"Especially when my Divine Power Value reaches ten thousand, I always feel a prickly sensation on my back."
"Whenever I have that thought, I get this unsettling feeling in my heart..."
"But now with Madeleine and Radiance, I have some assurance."
The team showed expressions of surprise.
This was the first time they heard Han Xing talk about this matter.
It also clarified why he insisted on waiting for the True God of Radiance and Madeleine to break through before his own breakthrough.
Cheng Jianyong asked, "Brother Xing, how about we wait a bit more?"
"Let’s go back to the Holy Spirit Realm first, use up our resources?"
The team generally agreed with Cheng Jianyong’s suggestion.
Han Xing shook his head, "No, I can’t wait that long."
"This time in the Void, I have to break through, otherwise if I wait, I might encounter even greater troubles later!"
"However, you’re right about one thing, I can use up the resources in my hands first, to enhance my strength.
Cheng Jianyong was taken aback, "Uh... but our Divine Demon Battleship doesn’t have enough space, and without Sky Island this time, we can’t build more Defense Towers?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing laughed and said, "Even though we didn’t bring Sky Island, doesn’t Samoyed have a Sky Island City?"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
That’s right! Samoyed had mentioned before that he led his Race in the Void, using a Sky Island as their base.
They just needed to place a territory core on it to claim the Sky Island as their own.
Han Xing said with a smile, "This time, we’ve acquired a lot of resources. If we can use some to build Defense Towers, it will greatly enhance our firepower."
The team was becoming excited.
They clearly knew how terrifying the haul was this time.
The materials alone were enough to set up twenty Celestial Rail Strike Devices!
Of course, lacking the World Will, they could only use some materials to build more Calamity Defense Towers.
And even just a small portion would bring a huge boost!
However, they still needed to seek Samoyed’s opinion, as the Sky Island belonged to him.
Yet, when Samoyed heard Han Xing wanted to requisition his Sky Island, not only did he have no objections, but he seemed very pleased.
Because he also cares deeply for his kind.
There are still many Blade Armor Demons on that Sky Island.
Since he left, it had been like a dragon without a head.
Now with Han Xing going there, and two True Gods present, at least there was no need to worry about safety.
Samoyed said excitedly, "My Lord, I have no objections, please feel free to use it."
Han Xing nodded, then said, "Alright, Samoyed, please lead us over."
Samoyed nodded respectfully, then led Han Xing and the others as they rushed back upstream in the Forbidden Star River.
A massive Blade Armor Demon, along with a huge Divine Demon Battleship, sped rapidly through the Void.
However, they weren’t moving on their own but were being propelled forward by the True God of Radiance.

chapters.title: Chapter 1011 - 510: [Black Abyss Realm Creation: Lingxiao]_2
paragraphs: After Radiance broke through to True God, the speed they moved at was almost equivalent to the non-stop teleportation speed of a Divine Demon Battleship.
Everyone only felt that the surrounding scenes were rapidly retreating.
It was as if they had entered a time-space tunnel, moving at an absurd speed.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "Wow... is this the speed of a True God level?"
"This is even more ridiculous than the teleportation of a Divine Demon Battleship!"
"No wonder that True God of Yellow Sand found our position so quickly!"
The team members nodded, they also experienced the terror of True God level.
At this time, Shen Yun thought of something.
"At this speed, even if we return to the Holy Spirit Realm, it would only take two or three days, right?"
Everyone remembered this matter as well.
After all, it took them a few months to travel from the Holy Spirit Realm to the Land of Divine War.
They originally thought it would take just as long to go back.
But now it seems, it might not be necessary?
Han Xing asked, "Radiance, how long would it take you to return to the Holy Spirit Realm from the Land of Divine War?"
At this moment, the God of Radiance, while leading everyone in movement, replied, "Master, with my current speed, it would take about three days."
"Once I adapt a bit more, and my understanding of the Light Element Rules deepens, it would take about one or two days to arrive."
"If I ascend to a Middle-tier True God, it would only take half a day to arrive."
Han Xing nodded in realization after hearing this.
Two or three days, the speed increased dozens of times.
Breaking through to True God is truly a powerful qualitative change.
The True God of Radiance continued to lead everyone on their journey.
In less than an hour, they returned near the Forbidden Star River.
From afar, they saw a pitch-black Sky Island.
The True God of Radiance dispersed his Divine Power, and everyone exited that time-space tunnel state.
Samoyed, seeing his own Sky Island, instantly beamed with joy.
He turned his head and squinted with a smile, "Master, we’ve arrived!"
"That is the Sky Island of our Blade Armored Demon Race!
Samoyed appeared extremely excited.
Because the presence of that Sky Island indicated that the Blade Armored Demon Race had not encountered any mishaps.
Han Xing nodded, "Lead the way, and then go arrange your clansmen."
"Alright, Master!" Samoyed appeared exceedingly enthusiastic.
Soon, they reached the pitch-black Sky Island.
As expected.
The Blade Armored Demons on it had not been targeted by other world creatures.
Perhaps because Han Xing and others moved too fast, those races from Silent City did not have time to react.
Perhaps, because Samoyed did not show up in the previous plan, they ignored the Blade Armored Demon Race.
At this moment, upon seeing Samoyed’s return, the Blade Armored Demons excitedly spread the news.
"The Clan Leader is back! The Clan Leader is back!"
"Brothers, come out and welcome the Clan Leader!"
"Honorable Clan Leader, we missed you so much!"
Tens of thousands of Blade Armored Demons emerged from those black buildings.
They excitedly knelt on the ground, extremely thrilled.
Cheng Jianyong laughed from the back, "Wow, Samoyed, you seem to be quite beloved by your clansmen."
Samoyed sheepishly said, "Oh, not at all, these guys, over these years, none have broken through to Divine Level again."
"Sorry for letting you see this."
Han Xing nodded, "Samoyed, go and arrange, as quickly as possible."
Samoyed immediately nodded eagerly.
He also understood that Han Xing was pressed for time.
He swiftly flew to the Sky Island and began issuing various instructions rapidly.
One of them was vacating their tribe’s habitat.
The shock in the hearts of those Blade Armored Demons was imaginable, each of them looked bewilderedly at the Blade Armored Demons and then at the Divine Demon Battleship in the sky.
It seemed they had no idea who or what was looming above, a single order actually had their Clan Leader agree to vacate their own territory.
However, since it was Samoyed’s command, this group of Blade Armored Demons did not dare to defy.
They quickly vacated the Sky Island.
He came to Han Xing’s side, respectfully saying, "Master, it has been arranged, now this Sky Island is yours."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he directly took out a core territory item and occupied the Sky Island.
A system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to merge the Sky Island Territory?]
"Yes."

[Merge successful, your territory area has expanded... acquired resources: Thermal Compression Cannon*172, acquired Obsidian Alloy*1.94 million, acquired High-tier Blade Armored Demon Race Residence*640,000, acquired...]
A plethora of resource acquisition prompts appeared, everything on this Sky Island now belonged to Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing parked the Divine Demon Battleship to the side.
He began preparing to construct various Defense Towers in batches.
However, before constructing these Defense Towers, Han Xing had to first build the [Lord’s Mansion] and the [Miracle Tower].
These two buildings are very important.
The [Lord’s Mansion] can greatly accelerate construction time,
The [Miracle Tower] can randomly generate four kinds of miracles, two of which are very helpful to Han Xing.
A system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume materials... build the Lord’s Mansion?]
[Do you want to consume materials... build the Miracle Tower?]
Han Xing clicked ’Yes’.
The system prompt appeared once more.
[Building in progress, remaining time 32 hours and 14 minutes...]
Building the Lord’s Mansion and the Miracle Tower requires a day and a half, until then, Han Xing can only wait silently.
Time slowly passed.
For these strong individuals, one or two days can pass very slowly.
Or it can pass in the blink of an eye.
