He turned his head and squinted with a smile, "Master, we’ve arrived!"
"That is the Sky Island of our Blade Armored Demon Race!
Samoyed appeared extremely excited.
Because the presence of that Sky Island indicated that the Blade Armored Demon Race had not encountered any mishaps.
Han Xing nodded, "Lead the way, and then go arrange your clansmen."
"Alright, Master!" Samoyed appeared exceedingly enthusiastic.
Soon, they reached the pitch-black Sky Island.
As expected.
The Blade Armored Demons on it had not been targeted by other world creatures.
Perhaps because Han Xing and others moved too fast, those races from Silent City did not have time to react.
Perhaps, because Samoyed did not show up in the previous plan, they ignored the Blade Armored Demon Race.
At this moment, upon seeing Samoyed’s return, the Blade Armored Demons excitedly spread the news.
"The Clan Leader is back!
The Clan Leader is back!"
"Brothers, come out and welcome the Clan Leader!"
"Honorable Clan Leader, we missed you so much!"
Tens of thousands of Blade Armored Demons emerged from those black buildings.
They excitedly knelt on the ground, extremely thrilled.
Cheng Jianyong laughed from the back, "Wow, Samoyed, you seem to be quite beloved by your clansmen."
Samoyed sheepishly said, "Oh, not at all, these guys, over these years, none have broken through to Divine Level again."
"Sorry for letting you see this."
Han Xing nodded, "Samoyed, go and arrange, as quickly as possible."
Samoyed immediately nodded eagerly.
He also understood that Han Xing was pressed for time.
He swiftly flew to the Sky Island and began issuing various instructions rapidly.
One of them was vacating their tribe’s habitat.
The shock in the hearts of those Blade Armored Demons was imaginable, each of them looked bewilderedly at the Blade Armored Demons and then at the Divine Demon Battleship in the sky.
It seemed they had no idea who or what was looming above, a single order actually had their Clan Leader agree to vacate their own territory.
However, since it was Samoyed’s command, this group of Blade Armored Demons did not dare to defy.
They quickly vacated the Sky Island.
He came to Han Xing’s side, respectfully saying, "Master, it has been arranged, now this Sky Island is yours."
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he directly took out a core territory item and occupied the Sky Island.
A system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to merge the Sky Island Territory?]
"Yes."

[Merge successful, your territory area has expanded... acquired resources: Thermal Compression Cannon*172, acquired Obsidian Alloy*1.94 million, acquired High-tier Blade Armored Demon Race Residence*640,000, acquired...]
A plethora of resource acquisition prompts appeared, everything on this Sky Island now belonged to Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing parked the Divine Demon Battleship to the side.
He began preparing to construct various Defense Towers in batches.
However, before constructing these Defense Towers, Han Xing had to first build the [Lord’s Mansion] and the [Miracle Tower].
These two buildings are very important.
The [Lord’s Mansion] can greatly accelerate construction time,
The [Miracle Tower] can randomly generate four kinds of miracles, two of which are very helpful to Han Xing.
A system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume materials... build the Lord’s Mansion?]
[Do you want to consume materials... build the Miracle Tower?]
Han Xing clicked ’Yes’.
The system prompt appeared once more.
[Building in progress, remaining time 32 hours and 14 minutes...]
Building the Lord’s Mansion and the Miracle Tower requires a day and a half, until then, Han Xing can only wait silently.
Time slowly passed.
For these strong individuals, one or two days can pass very slowly.
Or it can pass in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 1012 - 510: [Black Abyss Realm Creation: Lingxiao]_3
paragraphs: The group silently waited.
The True God of Radiance and Madeleine both merged into their own Trees of Rules, beginning to familiarize themselves with their Powers of Rules.
Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and others were also inventorying the various resources on the Blade Armor Demon Sky Island, and transporting those resources back to the Divine Demon Battleship.
They began dismantling the various constructions on the Blade Armor Demon race’s Sky Island, leaving space for building the Calamity Defense Towers.
Because he had received Han Xing’s directive, Cheng Jianyong was nearly unrestrained.
He grabbed the [Immortal Giant] and began rampaging destructively.
Rumble!
One by one, black constructions were cleaved by Cheng Jianyong’s axe.
They then collapsed with a crash.
The Blade Armor Demons beside looked on with pained expressions.
After all, these were houses they had painstakingly built, their home.
Now this human came and slashed them down with a single blow!
The group of Blade Armor Demons looked to Samoyed with aggrieved eyes.
Samoyed coughed twice, then began comforting his tribesmen, promising that he would lead them to create a better territory in the future.
The Blade Armor Demon’s emotions were soothed.
However, Cheng Jianyong below was in high spirits.
He kept swinging his axe, toppling black high-rises under it one after another.
"Wuhu!"
Cheng Jianyong shouted excitedly, "Xiaoyunzi, come down and be the City Destroyer King with me!"
"Not having to be responsible, just demolishing, feels really great!"
Shen Yun rolled her eyes at him, then also picked up her warhammer and joined the destruction crew.
Rumble!
Amidst the rumblings.
Soon, two days passed.
A system notification appeared.
[Your territory building: Lord’s Mansion, Miracle Tower construction successful.]
At this point, Han Xing suddenly opened his eyes.
He saw that on the previously black Sky Island, those buildings had all disappeared.
Only some black Energy Cannons remained.
These things are called Thermal Compression Cannons, with an Attack Power of only 300,000, even after being enhanced by the Sun Crown Stele, they barely reach the threshold of Divine Level.
But there were over a hundred of them, benefitting from the sheer number; Han Xing decided to keep these Energy Cannons.
At the same time, a Lord’s Mansion also appeared above.
And next to it, a tall tower with a Dwarf statue.
Han Xing approached the tower and clicked [Sacrifice].
[Sacrifice successful, random Blessing effect in progress.]
[Randomization successful: Miracle effect is a 20% reduction in construction costs]
Seeing the system notification, Han Xing’s face lit up with joy.
"Great, this is the miracle effect I needed most!"
Han Xing hadn’t expected to randomly obtain the miracle he wanted instantly.
This way, he could save considerable expenses.
But upon considering his high Luck Value, randomly obtaining this miracle wasn’t so surprising either.
"With everything ready, we can start building the Defense Towers now."
Han Xing opened the construction interface and began frantic building.
[Do you want to consume materials... to build Calamity Defense Tower: Silent Annihilation Lightning*1000?]
[Do you want to consume materials... to build Calamity Defense Tower: Withered Snowflakes*600?]
[Do you want to consume materials... to build Calamity Defense Tower: Fury Heart Storm*400?]
[Do you want to consume materials... to build Frozen Star Cannon*1000?]
[Do you want to...]
A massive array of system notifications appeared.
Han Xing directly clicked ’yes’
At the same time.
This massive black Sky Island was immediately enshrouded in a variety of colorful mists.
The Blade Armor Demons floated in the void, their eyes filled with astonishment.
Even though those Defense Towers were just built, they could also sense a miraculous change occurring on the Sky Island where they lived.
Even from such a distance, this group of Blade Armor Demons felt an intense sense of foreboding!
He directly erected 2000 Calamity Defense Towers of three types.
As for the four types of Energy Cannon Towers, Han Xing constructed a total of 6000.
A total of eight thousand High-tier Defense Towers were simultaneously set into construction!
Once construction was completed.
The firepower on this Sky Island would leap beyond that of Ten Thousand Stars City!
Plus, the Divine Demon Battleship.
Han Xing’s firepower intensity was increased six or seven times once again!
And this consumable was roughly only one-eighth of Han Xing’s reserves.
He now was truly wealthy and affluent.
Even those races possessing True Gods did not have such terrifying resources.
After all, this time, they pillaged the treasure vaults of so many races.
The team members watched the aura on the Sky Island, faces brimming with delight.
Cheng Jianyong laughed, saying, "Once Brother Xing successfully breaks through this time, we will return to the Holy Spirit Realm."
"With just the firepower on this Sky Island, it’s enough to flatten those invading Demon armies!"
"Then we will invade the Abyss Realm, turn the Alternate Space upside down, break through the Divine Spirits, and it’s just around the corner!"
The team members all rolled their eyes at him.
Who knows how Cheng Jianyong linked everything this far.
Meanwhile, Han Xing was also satisfied seeing this mist-covered Sky Island.
Though the Lord’s Mansion hastened some construction time, these Defense Towers still required two to three days to be fully built.
Once all tasks were completed, Han Xing clapped his hands.
Then, he looked at the blueprints interface, at a black blueprint.
This was also what he planned to construct earlier, but due to lack of materials, it had been on hold.
[Black Abyss Realm Creation: Lingxiao]
[Create a War Mecha with Celestial King Level (Divine Level) battle strength.]

[Construction materials required: Black Abyss Stone*1 million, Ancient Elf Secret Ingot*200,000, Philosopher’s Stone*1 million, Void Demon Stone*500,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*300,000, Power of Complete Rules*1 (Note: any Divine-level Energy Core such as Demon God’s Heart, Insect Emperor Core etc. can be used instead...)]
Previously, because he didn’t have enough [Power of Rules], Han Xing was reluctant to create it.
But now, he had no less than 65 complete Powers of Rules at his disposal; indeed a case of opulence!

chapters.title: Chapter 1013 - 511: Reinforced King Mecha
paragraphs: With so much power of rules, whether absorbed by oneself or used for construction, they bring a massive enhancement.
Hence, Han Xing decided to take out five and build the Lingxiao!
Although he didn’t know the strength of these war mechas.
The system just mentioned that the mechas possess divine-level combat power.
But it’s important to know that even within divine levels, there are initial and high tiers.
The gap between each tier is enormous.
If the mechas possess ordinary divine spirit strength, they won’t be much help to Han Xing.
It might be better to use these materials to construct a few more calamity defense towers.
Han Xing pondered: "Let’s build five Lingxiao first to test the waters."
"We’ll check the attributes first, and if they’re terrible, we won’t build them."
After making his decision, Han Xing directly clicked on construction.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume materials... to construct Lingxiao War Mecha *5?]
"Yes."
Han Xing confirmed.
However, unlike before, the system did not show a building prompt.
Instead, another message appeared.
[Detected survivor: Han Xing, possessing high-strength materials like Calamity Beast Scales; can add 20 scales, cover them on Lingxiao Mecha significantly to increase its defense, add them?]
Upon hearing this system prompt, Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"Goodness, I can actually add Calamity Beast Scales to Lingxiao?"
"That’s fantastic!"
Because Han Xing’s Calamity Beast Scales had almost reached ten thousand pieces, not knowing what to do with them.
And now the system tells him they can be added to the Lingxiao!
Han Xing is well aware of the enormous defense these things contain!
Even attacks from top-tier divine spirits may not be able to punch through!
By then, the constructed Lingxiao Mecha will undergo a qualitative change in defense.
Moreover, only 20 scales need to be added per mecha.
In terms of Han Xing’s reserves, it’s merely a drop in the bucket.
Thus, Han Xing directly responded: "Add them for me!"
The system prompt appeared.
[Successfully added Calamity Beast Scales *100, constructing Lingxiao; remaining time 55 hours and 32 minutes...]
More than fifty hours.
This was roughly as Han Xing expected.
Once Lingxiao is constructed, the other defense towers should also be nearly completed.
By now, Han Xing mused: "Since these mechas can add Calamity Beast Scales, they shouldn’t be weak."
"To be safe, build five more."
Han Xing made up his mind and consumed five more powers of rules, constructing five more mechas.
Now, ten Lingxiao units are being constructed.
Everyone continued to wait.
Since the battle with the True God of Yellow Sand, Forbidden Star River hasn’t had much commotion.
And the True God of Yellow Sand, after escaping from Han Xing, returned to Silent City with some injuries.
From his mouth, the three True Gods learned that the True God of Radiance and the Painful Empress mastered the main rule.
Moreover, even the True God of Yellow Sand had no way to deal with them.
For a moment, strong shock appeared in the eyes of these three True Gods.
They hadn’t expected that the newly broken-through Painful Empress would possess such combat power.
And Celestial Fall, upon seeing Yellow Sand retreat, smiled with narrowed eyes.
The True God of Yellow Sand’s face was grim, engaging Celestial Fall in battle again.
The four True Gods besieged the three-eyed man Celestial Fall, causing him to get injured.
However, as previously mentioned, upon reaching True God Level.
You can defeat the opponent, you can crush them.
But it’s very difficult to kill them.
After a round of battle, they couldn’t deal with Celestial Fall.
And Celestial Fall calmly withdrew from the battle group and left Silent City, with no one knowing his destination.
And the races whose resources were stolen, upon seeing the return of the True God of Yellow Sand.
Also realized that their stolen resources might not be recoverable!
Silent City was in chaos.
Dozens of races despaired painfully.
Of course, Han Xing and the others were unaware of these occurrences.
And the True God of Yellow Sand didn’t expect that those humans would dare to come near Silent City again after barely repelling him.
It’s important to know, with the movement speed of a middle-tier True God, it takes less than ten minutes to reach Samoyed’s Sky Island from Silent City.
Initial-tier True Gods might be slower, but they could arrive in just one or two hours.
In fact, Han Xing had thought about staying further from Silent City.
But the defense tower being constructed above entered a true-god-level movement state, with unstable energy.
And the system warned of a risk of construction failure.
Thus, Han Xing abandoned this idea and could only wait on site.
Time flew by, and three days passed.
In the void, a group stood inside the battleship, silently watching.
They saw that the various buildings on the Sky Island had fully taken shape.
Nearly eight thousand high-tier defense towers were completed.
The crowd stared at the differently colored, differently designed energy cannons above.
These energy cannon muzzles uniformly pointed toward the sky.
Each one possessed extremely terrifying destructive power.
Just standing outside could feel the dreadful firepower contained on this Sky Island.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing also transferred the Sun Crown Stele from inside the Divine Demon Battleship to this Sky Island.
They couldn’t help it; only through the boost provided by the Sun Crown Stele could these defense towers unleash multiplied power to genuinely threaten divine spirits.

chapters.title: Chapter 1014 - 511: Enhanced King-Class Mecha! (Part 2)
paragraphs: When everything was done.
Han Xing nodded with satisfaction.
"Very good, eight thousand high-tier defense towers, plus over a thousand defense towers on the battleship, and the Celestial Rail Strike Device."
"Now, with the firepower on this Sky Island alone, we can at least deal with two True Gods!"
Everyone was very excited.
Compared to before, they could only use the Celestial Rail Strike Device to threaten True Gods.
And now, relying on sheer firepower, they once again had the power to rival True Gods, a qualitative enhancement.
Even Han Xing felt waves of security in his heart.
Previously, he was always in a state of unease.
Even with Madeleine and the True God of Radiance, he just had a bit more confidence.
He had a premonition that the commotion from his breakthrough this time would be significant.
Then, he might encounter some unexpected situations.
For example, in Silent City, it was highly likely that the four known True Gods would come over to stop him.
If Han Xing were to break through and these four True Gods came to attack.
Just Yellow Sand alone could hold off the True God of Radiance and Madeleine.
No one could stop the remaining three True Gods.
And Han Xing’s breakthrough would have to be declared a failure...
Now with these defense towers, he had more confidence.
Then, Han Xing turned his gaze to the adjacent Void.
There stood ten mechanical creatures over seven hundred meters tall, entirely covered in gray Giant Beast Scales, filled with a sense of technology!
These are the "Lingxiao."
Han Xing glanced at their attributes!
[Black Abyss Realm Technology: Lingxiao (Enhanced Version)]
[Level: Level 75 (Middle-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Armor: 86792+200000 (Extra bonus from True God Scale)]
[Durability: 76.4 million]
[Attack Power: 13.42 million~14.17 million]
[Core Power: Rule of the Snake]
[Skills: Enhanced Pulse Aggregation Cannon (Raise right hand, release a destructive energy cannon, causing attack power *150% damage to enemies)
Enhanced Particle Beam (Raise both hands, release a destructive particle beam, causing attack power *110% damage to all enemies along the path)
Instant Movement (Comprehend the power of space, able to perform instant movement, maximum distance of 1 million kilometers, 100-second cooldown)
High-Energy Particle Shield (Condense a layer of particle shield, automatically negating damage when attacked, particle shield equals 100% of durability)
Divine Memory Metal (Automatically recover its own durability after being attacked, recover 1% durability per second)
War Emperor Form (Switch to melee form, increase all attributes by 50%, transform left-hand weapon to Emperor Slayer Blade, right-hand weapon to Celestial King’s Shield)

Super·Lingxiao Light Wave Cannon (Charge for 3 seconds, activate Lingxiao Light Wave Cannon at the chest area, release all energy, causing attack power *1888% destructive attack to the enemy, after use, enter a state of low energy for one minute, possess only simple combat awareness during low energy state)]
[Introduction: A mecha with extremely strong combat awareness, possessing the ability to rival middle-tier Divine Spirits, underwent some special enhancement, greatly boosting its defense!]
Goodness, a bunch of skills!
Han Xing glanced over, and it was evident how comprehensive the skills of this mecha were.
Combining attributes of melee, ranged, burst, recovery, mobility, and defense into one.
It was a powerful mecha with no shortcomings in all aspects!
Moreover, the key was that the Giant Beast Scale multiplied this mecha’s armor several times over!
Nearly 300,000 armor, not inferior to those high-tier Divine Spirits.
Han Xing was thrilled.
To know, these mechas were infused with just ten Initial-tier Divine Level Powers of Rules.
But they gained high-tier Divine Spirit combat strength, no matter how you calculated it, it was a profitable deal.
"Good, good, good! Ten high-tier Divine Spirit mechas, this wave is truly profitable!"
"If these mechas can also receive the bonus from the Sun Crown Stele, then they’ll be even stronger!
At this point, it was time to test Han Xing’s biggest concern.
That was whether Lingxiao could receive the bonus from the Sun Crown Stele.
If not, then these Lingxiao couldn’t complete their qualitative transformation.
Thus, Han Xing decided to conduct an experiment.
He pointed to a Lingxiao and said: "You, perform an attack action."
The mecha emitted a synthesized mechanical voice, "As you command, master..."
It raised its right arm and began to activate the enhanced pulse aggregation cannon.
At this moment, a burst of Holy Power descended onto this mecha.
Han Xing witnessed as this mecha’s momentum underwent a qualitative transformation in an instant!
From the original middle-tier Divine Spirit Level, it directly elevated to high-tier Divine Spirit Level!
An even more obvious sensation for Han Xing.
He saw all of Lingxiao’s attributes surge by twofold!
Attack Power reached 40 million!
Armor reached 830,000!
Durability also arrived at 230 million!
These attributes have completely exceeded those of average high-tier Divine Spirits.
Defense reached the level of top-tier Divine Spirits.
At this moment, Lingxiao seemed puzzled as well, "Master... I feel an additional force within me..."
"I seem to have become much stronger..."
Han Xing nodded, "That’s right, continue maintaining this form and move towards the distance. I want to see the maximum amplification distance of the Sun Crown Stele!"
This Lingxiao followed the order.
Quickly started to move towards the distance.
Under Han Xing’s watchful gaze, it soon surpassed 10,000 kilometers.
This was also the limit distance for the Divine Demon Battleship to receive augmenting effects.
However, Lingxiao continued to be shrouded in white light and seemed to still be receiving the Sun Crown Stele’s bonus.

chapters.title: Chapter 1015 - 511: Enhanced King-Class Mecha! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Han Xing’s eyes lit up with delight!
Unexpectedly, the amplification range that this Lingxiao Mecha could receive was even farther than that of the Divine Demon Battleship!
This was an enormous surprise!
But on second thought, it made sense too.

The Lingxiao was a free-fighting type Mecha. If it could only receive boosts within the vicinity of the Sky Island, then its Divine Spirit Level combat strength would become nothing more than decoration.
Next, Han Xing was going to verify the extreme amplification distance of this Mecha.
Han Xing commanded, "Continue advancing!"
The Lingxiao Mecha continued to advance into the distance.
Fifty thousand kilometers, one hundred thousand kilometers, two hundred thousand kilometers!
The amplification state was still active.
Only after breaking through one million kilometers did Han Xing finally sense that the aura of Lingxiao had significantly decreased.
Han Xing pondered, "Is the maximum distance one million kilometers?"
This distance was almost the combat range of Divine Spirit-level creatures, which wasn’t bad.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction, then commanded the Lingxiao to return.
Later, Han Xing returned to the central area of the Black Sky Island.
All around, eight thousand high-tier defense towers surrounded him.
In the sky over the Sky Island, ten Mechas with top-tier Divine Spirit combat power safeguarded his safety.
Nearby the Sky Island.
A Divine Demon Battleship, with its Celestial Rail Strike Device on it, was always in a charging state.
Moreover, in the distance, there were the True God of Radiance and the Painful Empress, both True God-level beings!
It could be said that Han Xing had prepared everything to its utmost extent.
He looked at the two True Gods and asked, "Radiance, Madeleine, how are your current states?"

Radiance turned his head and replied, "Master, I’m in great condition. Over the past few days, I have been immersed in the Tree of Rules, and my understanding of the Light Element Rules has become much stronger."
"Compared to five days ago, I’ve roughly improved my combat power by 50%."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was overjoyed, "Radiance, a 50% improvement in five days, could you truly be a once-in-a-millennium Light Element genius?"

The True God of Radiance chuckled and said, "Master, Radiance’s aptitude is dull. This improvement is just from a process of accumulating knowledge and thin breakthroughs. Now, I’ve exhausted my foundation, making further improvement difficult."
Han Xing nodded.
Next to him, Madeleine also reported, "Master, I’ve not improved as much as Radiance, only about a 20% increase~"
Han Xing encouraged, "It’s alright, a 20% improvement for you True Gods is also tremendously powerful."
"Radiance achieved his improvement through accumulation; you’ll catch up soon enough."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s encouragement, Madeleine’s face immediately showed a bashful expression.
"Hmm, I’ll work hard, Master~"
Han Xing nodded, looking around, almost everything was ready.
"So now, I’m going to start the breakthrough."
Upon hearing these words, everyone’s gaze became fixed.
Even Cheng Jianyong and others on the Divine Demon Battleship were very serious.
The atmosphere instantly turned solemn.
Meanwhile, the Blade Armor Demon on the Sky Island also saw its Clan Leader transforming into its true form and entering the void.
With crocodile-like pupils, it swept across the entire void with a dangerous gleam.
According to the oath, if Han Xing died, it wouldn’t survive either.
So this time, Samoyed was also prepared to fight desperately.
Seeing their tense expressions, Han Xing smiled and said, "No need to be so serious."
"As I said, if a True God comes to attack, if you can withstand it, help me hold it off."
"If you can’t hold it, don’t force it. We will retreat immediately."
"Madeleine and Radiance, you’ll be responsible for leading us all to escape, even if it means abandoning the Divine Demon Battleship and the Sky Island, it’s a small price."
"Everyone’s life is what’s most important."
Upon saying this, Han Xing’s tone changed, "Understood?"
In the void.
Two True Gods, a high-tier Divine Spirit, and Cheng Jianyong and others responded simultaneously.
"Understood!"
Han Xing nodded.
Then, he waved his hand.
Directly taking out one hundred pieces of Divine Formats from his backpack.
Hundreds of Divine Formats floated in front of him, shimmering with various divine radiances.
Just a look could make one feel the powerful divine power emanating from them.
These Divine Formats were from ordinary Divine Spirits.
The added Divine Power values ranged from 2000 to 3500.
Now, Han Xing was going to absorb them all.
And this was his most lavish, most excessive absorption of Divine Formats to date.
According to estimates, he could boost his Divine Power Value by at least 250,000!
Han Xing’s current Divine Power Value was already close to 110,000.
Although the Old Tree mentioned that just reaching a Divine Power Value of 200,000 would break the rules,
Han Xing always felt that 200,000 wasn’t his limit.
He could do better!
Better than the Hunter, better than the Demon Emperor.
The next moment, Han Xing directly swept out his divine power!
Hundreds of Divine Formats shattered simultaneously.
Crack! Crack!
The terrifying divine power instantly burst forth,
even causing the energies in this void to become agitated.
The next moment, Han Xing directly absorbed it all.
Hundreds of system prompts appeared.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format - Red, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format - Silence, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format - Color, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format - Spell, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format - Lake, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully...]
At this moment, Han Xing only felt a power within himself that was more terrifying than any previous time!
This force almost exploded his body!
Everyone saw Han Xing’s body suddenly expand to five meters!
His skin turned incredibly red.
And at this moment, Han Xing took a deep breath.
"Inhale—"
The pure divine power was instantly digested by him with great speed.
Simultaneously, the column for his Divine Power Value rapidly changed.
[Divine Power Value: 135,235]
[Divine Power Value: 145,235]
[Divine Power Value: 160,235]
When the Divine Power Value broke through 200,000, a system prompt appeared.
[Detected survivor Han Xing, breaking through 200,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm, achieved achievement: Creator!]
[Infinite Domain skill upgrade, current level: Level 2]

chapters.title: Chapter 1016 - 512: Achievement Unlocked: Second in History
paragraphs: The thoughts in Han Xing’s mind flashed swiftly.
"So, the enhancement of divine power value can also upgrade the Infinite Domain skill."
Without a doubt, Infinite Domain is an extremely heaven-defying divine skill!
Han Xing checked to see what changes there are in the level 2 Infinite Domain.
[Infinite Domain Level 2: Special Hidden Skill]

[Effect 1: With oneself as the center, within a range of 200,000 meters, activate a layer of Infinite Domain. All allied units (including defense towers, territory buildings, pets, servants, etc.) within the domain gain a 20% increase in all attributes (including divine power value), and the user gains an additional 20% damage reduction effect.]

[Effect 2: Within the Infinite Domain, you possess infinite creative ability. You can simulate once, after activating the domain, the recorded strongest attack, and deal 20% of the attack’s damage with a cooldown time of 11 hours.]
Han Xing took a deep breath.
"Wow, the effects have increased significantly again!"
This time, the upgrade not only expanded the radiation range but also increased the magnitude.
Even the simulated attack’s damage has been greatly enhanced.
Han Xing had a premonition that if he continued to upgrade Infinite Domain, it could be increased again!
Meanwhile, the system prompts continued to ring.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Black Mountain, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Formless, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Grass, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format·Silver Fox, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully absorbed...]
The divine power value broke through 300,000, and the system prompt appeared again.
[Detected that survivor Han Xing has broken through 300,000 divine power value at the legendary realm.]
[Infinite Domain skill has been upgraded, current level: Level 3]
"As I predicted, every 100,000 divine power value upgrades the Infinite Domain by one level."
Han Xing glanced at the attributes of level 3 Infinite Domain.
As he expected, the range increase, the intensity increase, and simulated attack all increased by 10%.
Even the cooldown time for the simulated attack became 10 hours.
The system prompts for divine power value enhancement were still refreshing continuously.
Until Han Xing’s divine power value reached 370,235, it finally stopped!
What Han Xing didn’t anticipate was, this time, not only increased by 200,000, but directly increased nearly 270,000 divine power value!
Han Xing smiled and said, "This wave is profitable!"
Now, his divine power value has completely surpassed a high-tier demigod, almost reaching the level of a top demigod.
It’s worth noting that he is still just a legendary.
Once he breaks through, he will receive multiple attribute enhancements.
As long as he breaks through to a demigod, the divine power value could easily surpass a million!
What does this mean?
A divine power value of one million, which typically only divine spirits can possess!
And Han Xing, his current divine power strength has already violated certain laws.
Unseen, it seemed there was some force trying to stop Han Xing from breaking through.
Because Han Xing’s current divine power value attribute has already broken the bounds of legendary level.
Possibly, even Hunter and Demon Emperor, at the legendary realm, did not reach such high values.
Han Xing saw, above the crowd, suddenly gathering massive energy masses.
Boom! Rumble!
Muffled thunder sounds rang out.
The crowd could feel the extremely terrifying destructive power contained within the energy masses.
In a blink, these energy masses gradually transformed into void cosmic disasters!
Moreover, each cosmic disaster’s scale was no less than a million kilometers!
Besides Silent Annihilation Lightning, Withered Snowflakes, Fury Heart Storm.
The crowd also saw Ghost Wind, Scorching Celestial Fire, Space Collapse, and such nearly impossible to encounter cosmic disasters above them.
The True God of Radiance furrowed his brow, "What’s going on?"
"Hasn’t the Master started the breakthrough yet? How would these terrifying cosmic disasters be triggered?"
Han Xing was equally puzzled.
He couldn’t figure out what had happened either.
The cosmic disasters above were itching to move.
Han Xing had a feeling that next, if he dared to absorb any more Divine Format.
These cosmic disasters would crash down like a hurricane!
Yet, Han Xing also felt that he hadn’t reached his limit.
He could continue to absorb divine power value.
"Should I continue?"
Han Xing fell into thought.
At this moment, the God of Radiance seemed to also see Han Xing’s current worry.
He directly said, "Master, do what you need without worry. I will bear these cosmic disasters for you."
The God of Radiance displayed great confidence.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing no longer hesitated.
If he chooses to act, he must become the strongest!
Hunter and Demon Emperor have broken the rules but ultimately failed!
Only by performing better, stronger than them, can one overcome all!
The next moment, Han Xing decisively took out a hundred Divine Formats.
This is also the limit he could absorb at once.
Absorbing more would burst his body.
Divine power swept over, the sound of shattering glass appeared.
Crack! Crack!
These Divine Formats all shattered.
And Han Xing, without hesitation, swallowed the divine power overflowing from these Divine Formats.
Meanwhile.
The crowd only saw space around Han Xing suddenly collapsing like a mirror.
The terrifying Scorching Celestial Fire, Silent Annihilation Lightning, plummeted down at a speed that even a divine spirit couldn’t capture!
The change happened too quickly.
Almost in the instant Han Xing absorbed these Divine Formats, space collapse, Scorching Celestial Fire, and other cosmic disasters immediately bombarded him.
The crowd didn’t have time to react.
"Damn! Brother Xing!"
"Damn it!"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s eyes were bloodshot!
They mobilized all their divine power, madly rushing forward.

This is also the limit he could absorb at once.
Absorbing more would burst his body.
Divine power swept over, the sound of shattering glass appeared.
Crack!
Crack!
These Divine Formats all shattered.
And Han Xing, without hesitation, swallowed the divine power overflowing from these Divine Formats.
Meanwhile.
The crowd only saw space around Han Xing suddenly collapsing like a mirror.
The terrifying Scorching Celestial Fire, Silent Annihilation Lightning, plummeted down at a speed that even a divine spirit couldn’t capture!
The change happened too quickly.
Almost in the instant Han Xing absorbed these Divine Formats, space collapse, Scorching Celestial Fire, and other cosmic disasters immediately bombarded him.
The crowd didn’t have time to react.
"Damn!
Brother Xing!"
"Damn it!"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s eyes were bloodshot!
They mobilized all their divine power, madly rushing forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 1017 - 512: Achievement Unlocked: Second in History! (2)
paragraphs: However, their inability to react does not mean that the True God of Radiance cannot!
At this moment.
An endless Power of Radiance suddenly bursts from the location of Han Xing!
"Suppress them for me!" the God of Radiance shouted in anger.
Buzz!
Divine Light overflowed, restoring the fragmented space to its original state.
The terrifying sea of plasma, Scorching Celestial Fire, including the Fury Heart Storm and Withered Snowflakes overhead.
All were forcefully suppressed by the God of Radiance!
Cheng Jianyong and the others saw Han Xing’s figure standing there unharmed and simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
At this moment, Han Xing, after being caught off guard and hit by that wave of disaster attacks, was momentarily stunned.
However, upon seeing the True God of Radiance eliminate the effects of these disasters with unimaginable means and speed, his heart rejoiced.
The God of Radiance does what he says.
If he says he can withstand these disasters, he indeed can.
And Han Xing believes in him.
Han Xing then accelerated his absorption of this terrifying Divine Power.
System prompts continuously appeared.
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: Green, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: Great River, Divine Power Value +3500]
[Successfully absorbed: Divine Format: White Bone, Divine Power Value +2500]
[Successfully...]
Han Xing’s Divine Power continues to soar.
However, the recent actions of the True God of Radiance seemed to have angered some will within the Void.
Those Disaster Energy Groups became utterly enraged and began attacking the Sky Island where Han Xing was crazily.
Its diameter quickly expanded from a million kilometers to ten million kilometers!
This firepower intensity almost rivals the Defense Towers in Han Xing’s territory!
"Boom! Boom!"
Wave after wave of terrifying attacks madly bombarded towards Han Xing.
Had it been an ordinary High-tier Divine Spirit, they would have been devoured by such a violent attack by now, dead beyond measure.
However, under the Divine Power of the God of Radiance, all these disasters were blocked entirely, without harming Han Xing in the slightest.
In five seconds.
These disasters, finding themselves helpless against the God of Radiance, suddenly fell into tranquility.
However, these disasters did not disappear but returned to hover over Han Xing’s head.
The Disaster Energy Group continued to expand rapidly, seemingly brewing a terrifying attack.
In the blink of an eye, this Disaster Energy Group had already reached the size of Han Xing’s Sky Island.
These disasters seem to be preparing to blow up this Sky Island in one go.
Shen Yun frowned and said, "This doesn’t look good. If such a massive Energy Group strikes all at once, it feels like even this Sky Island would be directly shattered."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong also realized this point.
He hastily reminded, "Old Guang, you can’t let that Energy Group expand further."
The God of Radiance nodded.
He snorted coldly, rushing directly into the sky.
Then, the God of Radiance pointed with one finger, and thousands of Radiant Spears appeared around him.
"Buzz!"
All the Radiant Spears erupted instantly.
From bottom to top, they attacked the Energy Group.
"Boom! Boom!"
The spears plunged into the Energy Group, triggering a series of violent Energy Storms.
The interior of the Energy Group became extremely chaotic and stopped expanding further.
Moreover, due to the Radiant Spear’s attacks, the energy within this disaster was continuously canceled out.
Above the Sky Island, the terrifying Energy Group was shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Apparently annoyed by the relentless bombardment from the God of Radiance.
That Disaster Energy turned all its attacks towards the God of Radiance himself.
"Crack!"
The strongest disaster attack they’ve ever witnessed suddenly appeared!
It was an energy beam with a diameter exceeding tens of thousands of kilometers.
This energy beam contained six kinds of disasters.
If it fell, Han Xing’s Sky Island would undoubtedly be destroyed in an instant.
Shen Yun exclaimed in surprise, "My goodness... Fortunately, Radiance interrupted that Energy Group, otherwise, if it continued to expand, it might be many times more terrifying than it is now!"

Cheng Jianyong also nodded, gazing at the Energy Group overhead, stating in shock, "Indeed, this thing is freaking scary. It feels like even High-tier Divine Spirits would be struck dead by this wave."
Watching the energy beam descend.
The True God of Radiance snorted coldly, "Just in time!"
As he spoke, a pair of golden wings extended from his back, transforming his entire being into a Golden Crow headed towards the Sun, actively charging at the energy beam.
"Buzz!"
Two terrifying energies met mid-air.
Scorching white light exploded, plunging the Void into chaos.
Everyone on the scene fell into a temporary state of blindness.
Of course, this didn’t include Han Xing.
Han Xing continued watching his surging Divine Power Value, eyes revealing a look of ecstatic joy.

[Successfully absorbed Divine Format, Divine Power Value +2000]
[Detected that Survivor Han Xing has surpassed 400,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm.]
[Infinite Domain Skill Upgrade, current level: Level 4]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Format, Divine Power Value +3500]
[Successfully absorbed Divine Format, Divine Power Value +4000]
[Detected that Survivor Han Xing has surpassed 500,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm.]

[Detected that Survivor Han Xing has surpassed 600,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm.]
[Infinite Domain Skill Upgrade, current level: Level 6]
The Divine Power Value continued its frenzied surge.
It didn’t stop until it reached 620,325 Divine Power Value.
The Infinite Domain Skill changed once again.
[Infinite Domain Level 6: Special Hidden Skill]

[Effect 1: Centered on oneself, within a range of 600,000 meters, activate 1 layer of Infinite Domain, increasing All Attributes of all friendly units within the domain (including defense towers, territory buildings, pets, servants, etc.) by 60% (including Divine Power Value) and adding an additional 60% damage reduction effect to oneself.]

chapters.title: Chapter 1018 - 512: Achievement Unlocked: Second in History! (Part 3)
paragraphs: [Effect 2: Within the Infinite Domain, you possess limitless creation ability. You can simulate once recording the strongest attack after activating the domain, causing 60% of the attack’s damage, with a cooldown of 6 hours.]
"Level 6!"
Han Xing was exhilarated.
This was what the Ancient Tree had told him, requiring three times the Divine Power Value!
To reach 600,000 Divine Power Value in the Legendary Realm is almost inconceivable in the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
Once Han Xing breaks through to become a Demigod, his Divine Power Value will easily exceed one million.
However, since his Divine Power Value had already completely exceeded the limit of the Legendary Level, it seemed to have triggered some kind of forbidden power.
Above Han Xing’s head, silently, appeared a red energy orb again.
This energy orb didn’t look large.
Yet it gave Han Xing a feeling even more terrifying than those apocalyptic threats.
"What is... that?"
Everyone looked at the sky, an expression of confusion appeared in their eyes.
The True God of Radiance, who was struggling against the apocalyptic threats, saw the red energy orb, his eyes narrowed.
After a moment, he seemed to remember something, and said with a shocked expression: "Master, that is the Destruction Red Lotus!"
"A Destruction Red Lotus that can cause top-tier Divine Spirits to fall!"
Upon hearing the True God of Radiance’s explanation, everyone’s expressions immediately turned very serious.
The ability to cause top-tier Divine Spirits to fall means the attack has infinitely reached a True God Level.
Cheng Jianyong gritted his teeth and said very indignantly: "Damn it, using True God Level power to deal with a Legend, isn’t this bullying?"
Everyone deeply empathized.
This time, if Han Xing hadn’t elevated both Radiance and Madeleine to True God Level, passing this stage would have been extremely difficult.
Han Xing asked: "Radiance, can you hold it?"
"If not, I’ll have Madeleine help you."
The Painful Empress’s task is to guard the Void.
She’s making haste to weave more Divine Power Spider Webs, completely transforming this area into her main battlefield.
This is her battle style.
When fighting in her home ground, the Painful Empress’s combat strength can increase significantly.
In the air, the True God of Radiance shook his head and said: "Master, let the Painful Empress continue to lay out the spider web, I can handle this."
Han Xing nodded.
The True God of Radiance saying he can handle it, means he certainly can.
He did not doubt and continued to produce a hundred divine formats!
Although Han Xing’s Divine Power Value has now reached 620,000.
But he felt he could continue to improve.
However, this time, as soon as Han Xing took out the divine formats, before he started absorbing them.
Above his head, those energy orbs seemed to have some sort of sensing.
Snap!
A red blood lotus falls from the Void.
The lotus appears slow but is incredibly fast.
Along the way, as it passes, space collapses piece by piece.
This attack that can cause top-tier Divine Spirits to fall even reached the amplified strength of the Celestial Rail Strike Device.
The True God of Radiance took a deep breath, directly expanding his Divine Power Domain.
Then forcibly devoured that red lotus.
"Buzz!"
The Radiant Domain, filled with a sacred aura, enveloped it.
Then, the red lotus appeared with dense cracks.
As if a terrifying power is about to pour forth.
Then, extremely mysterious energy, even surpassing the strength of the Celestial Rail Strike Device, exploded within the True God of Radiance’s domain.
The glaring white light reappeared, people could only vaguely see that the Radiant Domain had turned blood-red.
Meanwhile, Han Xing began absorbing the divine formats the moment the Radiant Domain swallowed the red lotus.
The immense divine power was absorbed by Han Xing.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
In the sky, the trembling didn’t stop.
The domain of the True God of Radiance, after that wave of explosion, was blown with a huge hole.
But he still held it.
And as promised, didn’t let those apocalyptic threats affect Han Xing one bit.
Half a minute passed.
The divine power contained in the 300th divine format was also absorbed directly by Han Xing.
He saw his Divine Power Value become: 860325.
And the Infinite Domain reached Level 8.
"Whew...
Han Xing let out a long breath, "860,000."
"This number should be a degree that neither the Hunter nor the Demon Emperor managed to achieve."
"And I also feel I’m nearing my limit."
Indeed, Han Xing felt a saturation sense within his body.
Though he could continue absorbing, he couldn’t absorb 100 divine formats all at once anymore.
Thus, Han Xing took out ten divine formats.
Then crushed them directly.
Snap!
[Successfully absorbed divine format, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed divine format, Divine Power Value +3500]
[Success...]
Every time he absorbs, it causes the apocalyptic threat energy orbs above him to riot.
"Boom! Snap!"
Time after time they unleash various attacks, trying to interrupt Han Xing.
However, the True God of Radiance blocked all of those attacks.
Han Xing glanced at the top and focused his attention on the breakthrough ahead.
He glanced at the Divine Power Value.
[Divine Power Value: 895325]
Han Xing anticipates that 900,000 should be his limit.
Thus, he took out two more divine formats and absorbed them.
[Successfully absorbed divine format, Divine Power Value +3000]
[Successfully absorbed divine format, Divine Power Value +2500]
A system prompt appeared.
[Your Divine Power Value has reached the current Level Limit!]
Simultaneously, a second system prompt appeared.
[Survivor Han Xing, in the Legendary Realm, has exceeded a Divine Power Value of 900,000, achieving: Second in history!]

[Congratulations: You are the second strongest in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, even the entire Void, reaching a Divine Power Value of 900,000. In the Holy Spirit Realm’s billions of years of history, only one eternal existence has achieved such greatness, and now, you too will touch that mysterious realm...]

chapters.title: Chapter 1019 - 513: Hunter’s Last Words
paragraphs: [Infinite Domain Skill Upgraded, Current Level: Level 9]
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing frowned slightly.
A look of shock appeared in his eyes.
"The second person in history, am I really just the second one ever?"
"Who was the first to reach 900,000?"
Previously, Han Xing had thought that the Hunter and Demon Emperor should have broken through once their Divine Power Value exceeded 200,000.
But now, the system told Han Xing.
Before him, someone else had reached a Divine Power Value of 900,000.
Along with the shock, a strong sense of crisis suddenly arose in Han Xing’s heart.
He had a premonition that this person who reached 900,000 in the Legendary Realm was definitely not the Hunter, nor the Demon Emperor.
But another, more terrifying existence!
According to the system’s introduction, this existence had survived for billions of years!
At this moment, Han Xing’s heart was already churning with waves!
"The old tree guessed wrong!"
"Or perhaps the entire Holy Spirit Realm, even the entire Void, guessed wrong!"
"There is an exceedingly terrifying existence that has transcended everything, who reached this realm even before the Hunter and Demon Emperor, and did it better than they did!"
"Oh my god, who is that guy?"
"Does the Hunter and Demon Emperor know of that guy’s existence?"
A heap of questions arose in Han Xing’s heart.
And at the moment he reached 900,000 Divine Power Value.
In the depths of the endless Void, within an unknown area.
This place is perpetually shrouded by all kinds of terrifying cosmic calamities.
Any random cosmic calamity’s power here is more terrifying than the True God of Radiance using the [Radiant Ten Thousand Me] state, easily able to annihilate a True God.
And here, one can see small worlds perish and new ones emerge every second.
This place seems like the end of the Void.
Those small worlds are like bubbles that are born and then burst in the blink of an eye.
And in this terrifying environment, there exists a completely transparent, boundless luminous giant tree whose trunk is impossible to fathom.
A single leaf is as large as a whole world.
A single branch can stretch out billions of kilometers.
If Han Xing were here, he would surely discover that this tree is what the Elf King referred to as the true World Tree!
Its trunk connects countless worlds, providing them with the power of life.
This is a place no one has ever reached since the Void was born.
Yet, beside the vast, endless World Tree’s body.
Sits a shadowy figure cross-legged, whose appearance and gender are indiscernible.
It had been asleep for countless years.
But on this day, it seemed to sense something, suddenly opening its eyes.
Irradiating from its pupils was a sudden brilliance.
"After billions of years... has the second one, who reaches the Void’s ultimate limit finally appeared?"
At this moment, a branch of the World Tree gently swayed.
An obscure wave of will emerged.
"It seems you finally have a rival?"
The shadowy figure pondered for a moment, gazing towards the depths of the Void, with pupils seeming to see time rapidly passing.
Then, it shook its head and said: "Still too weak... just barely reaching the Void’s ultimate limit..."
Another wave of will appeared, "Is that so? Will you act this time?"
The figure did not answer.
After a long silence, it suddenly said: "World Tree, for billions of years, only you have been by my side."
"You should understand, I have been invincible for far too long..."
"For billions of years, countless geniuses have been born in the Void, only the one wielding the Bow and Arrow was once high upon my regard."
"His talent was so strong, he could achieve permanence in his achievement."
"His power was clearly only half of mine, yet he opposed me with profound comprehension."
"In the same realm, I was inferior to him."
The World Tree said: "Is that so? But in the end, you still killed him.
The shadowy figure nodded, "Yes, his resolve was too firm, I could not convince him, so I had to kill him."
"World Tree, is this what you meant when you said some lives are born free, unable to be changed by any power?"
The World Tree replied softly: "I don’t know. I can grant life, but cannot understand the thoughts of these lives."
"Like you, I have existed for far too long..."
"This is the last time. After this, the Void will undergo collapse."
"Our contest will also decide the outcome in this era..."
Meanwhile.
The True God of Radiance in the Void is still frantically entangled with those rapidly growing energy masses.
Not allowing a single strand of energy to spill out and interfere with Han Xing.
And those energy masses have already completely reached the Top-tier Divine Level, transitioning towards the True God Realm.
At this moment, Han Xing feels the explosive growth of power within him, throwing aside the thoughts in his mind.
No matter who that existence reaching 900,000 Divine Power Value is.
No matter how strong it truly is.
At least, Han Xing has now reached the same realm as it.
"First match, then surpass!"
"As long as I continue to progress, I will surpass it!"
Perhaps influenced by the Hunter, a strong sense of belief emerged within Han Xing’s heart.
Confidence returned to his eyes, followed by a deep breath.
Han Xing said solemnly: "Then now, I shall use the Power of Rules to advance towards the Demigod!"
Just as Han Xing prepared to extract the Power of Rules to break through to the Demigod.
A sudden intense tremor emerged from his backpack.
In the next moment, from his backpack, a palm-sized rhombic crystal, emitting infinite radiance, flew out.

Before him, someone else had reached a Divine Power Value of 900,000.

He had a premonition that this person who reached 900,000 in the Legendary Realm was definitely not the Hunter, nor the Demon Emperor.
But another, more terrifying existence!
According to the system’s introduction, this existence had survived for billions of years!
At this moment, Han Xing’s heart was already churning with waves!
"The old tree guessed wrong!"
"Or perhaps the entire Holy Spirit Realm, even the entire Void, guessed wrong!"
"There is an exceedingly terrifying existence that has transcended everything, who reached this realm even before the Hunter and Demon Emperor, and did it better than they did!"
"Oh my god, who is that guy?"
"Does the Hunter and Demon Emperor know of that guy’s existence?"
A heap of questions arose in Han Xing’s heart.
And at the moment he reached 900,000 Divine Power Value.
In the depths of the endless Void, within an unknown area.
This place is perpetually shrouded by all kinds of terrifying cosmic calamities.
Any random cosmic calamity’s power here is more terrifying than the True God of Radiance using the [Radiant Ten Thousand Me] state, easily able to annihilate a True God.
And here, one can see small worlds perish and new ones emerge every second.
This place seems like the end of the Void.
Those small worlds are like bubbles that are born and then burst in the blink of an eye.
And in this terrifying environment, there exists a completely transparent, boundless luminous giant tree whose trunk is impossible to fathom.
A single leaf is as large as a whole world.
A single branch can stretch out billions of kilometers.
If Han Xing were here, he would surely discover that this tree is what the Elf King referred to as the true World Tree!
Its trunk connects countless worlds, providing them with the power of life.
This is a place no one has ever reached since the Void was born.
Yet, beside the vast, endless World Tree’s body.
Sits a shadowy figure cross-legged, whose appearance and gender are indiscernible.
It had been asleep for countless years.
But on this day, it seemed to sense something, suddenly opening its eyes.
Irradiating from its pupils was a sudden brilliance.
"After billions of years... has the second one, who reaches the Void’s ultimate limit finally appeared?"
At this moment, a branch of the World Tree gently swayed.
An obscure wave of will emerged.
"It seems you finally have a rival?"
The shadowy figure pondered for a moment, gazing towards the depths of the Void, with pupils seeming to see time rapidly passing.
Then, it shook its head and said: "Still too weak... just barely reaching the Void’s ultimate limit..."
Another wave of will appeared, "Is that so?
Will you act this time?"
The figure did not answer.
After a long silence, it suddenly said: "World Tree, for billions of years, only you have been by my side."
"You should understand, I have been invincible for far too long..."
"For billions of years, countless geniuses have been born in the Void, only the one wielding the Bow and Arrow was once high upon my regard."
"His talent was so strong, he could achieve permanence in his achievement."
"His power was clearly only half of mine, yet he opposed me with profound comprehension."
"In the same realm, I was inferior to him."
The World Tree said: "Is that so?
But in the end, you still killed him.
The shadowy figure nodded, "Yes, his resolve was too firm, I could not convince him, so I had to kill him."
"World Tree, is this what you meant when you said some lives are born free, unable to be changed by any power?"
The World Tree replied softly: "I don’t know.
I can grant life, but cannot understand the thoughts of these lives."
"Like you, I have existed for far too long..."
"This is the last time.
After this, the Void will undergo collapse."
"Our contest will also decide the outcome in this era..."
Meanwhile.
The True God of Radiance in the Void is still frantically entangled with those rapidly growing energy masses.
Not allowing a single strand of energy to spill out and interfere with Han Xing.
And those energy masses have already completely reached the Top-tier Divine Level, transitioning towards the True God Realm.
At this moment, Han Xing feels the explosive growth of power within him, throwing aside the thoughts in his mind.
No matter who that existence reaching 900,000 Divine Power Value is.
No matter how strong it truly is.
At least, Han Xing has now reached the same realm as it.
"First match, then surpass!"
"As long as I continue to progress, I will surpass it!"
Perhaps influenced by the Hunter, a strong sense of belief emerged within Han Xing’s heart.
Confidence returned to his eyes, followed by a deep breath.
Han Xing said solemnly: "Then now, I shall use the Power of Rules to advance towards the Demigod!"
Just as Han Xing prepared to extract the Power of Rules to break through to the Demigod.
A sudden intense tremor emerged from his backpack.
In the next moment, from his backpack, a palm-sized rhombic crystal, emitting infinite radiance, flew out.

chapters.title: Chapter 1020 - 513: Hunter’s Last Words_2
paragraphs: Staring at this divine format, Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Of course, he recognized this crystal, because it belonged to Hunter’s divine format.
This was also the first divine format he obtained.
As he later acquired more and more treasures, he almost forgot about this divine format.
He didn’t even think about absorbing it when he broke through to demigod.
"Why? Why would it appear at this moment?"
Han Xing was a bit puzzled.
And just at this moment.
A voice suddenly sounded in Han Xing’s mind.
"Inheritor... I am Hunter, also the Wild Ranger."
"By the time you hear this message, I must have already dissipated."
"And being able to hear this message indicates that you’ve already reached the void limit, and surely understand some secrets."
"Before you, there was an entity who also reached the void limit. I don’t know his name, or his background."
"I only know he was the first to break the rules in the void, and he’s called the Original Being."
"Many events occurring now in the Holy Spirit Realm, and even in the void, are related to him."
"Whether it be those divine spirits, or those evil gods, his figure is behind them all."
"And this entity, is truly our ultimate enemy."
"When I broke the rules, and set out on my own path, I became aware of such a formidable existence."
"I started trying every method to improve myself, and spent thousands of years to also reach the void limit."
"However, when I attempted to make contact with that formidable existence, I found myself so insignificant."
"I realized that reaching the void limit cannot defeat that terrifying entity."
"Thus, I left everything behind, condensed within this divine format."
"This divine format contains all my life’s insights. Absorbing it will help you break the void limit, becoming the first transcender ever."
"Yet, once you become a transcender, you will bear the same mission as me."
"The entire burden of the Holy Spirit Realm will fall upon your shoulders."
"All choices lie with you. I have no authority to demand you accomplish what I couldn’t.
After listening to this message, Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Hunter knew everything really.
He knew the void limit, he knew there was another Original Being in history.
He tried to enhance himself, and even reached the void limit.
However, Hunter still couldn’t defeat that terrifying entity.
Hence, he chose death, leaving everything behind, hoping to fulfill the successors.
Looking at the divine format before him, Han Xing’s eyes were filled with hesitation.
He didn’t know what the mission Hunter referred to was.
But Han Xing knew his friends and important people were all in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Moments later, Han Xing suddenly chuckled lightly: "I damn well understand now, when I switched professions to Wild Ranger, you already had your eye on me."
"Now you say I have the power to choose, do I really have a choice?"
With those words, Han Xing decisively crushed the divine format.
Crack!
A surge of divine power, even more potent than the forgotten, erupted.
This divine power was stronger than the three hundred divine formats absorbed before!
Intense surprise appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
"Wow... Is this really the divine power contained within one divine format?"
"Isn’t this more terrifying than the power of rules of a true god?"
Simultaneously, that pure divine power automatically entered Han Xing’s body.
In an instant, Han Xing felt his body rapidly expanding, reaching eight meters in height.
His form, which had barely returned to normal, started becoming like a giant once again.
Eight meters...
Nine meters...
Ten meters...
Han Xing’s form swelled to fifteen meters.
If not for his impressive constitution now, he would have exploded and died already.
Yet despite that, Han Xing still felt his entire body swelling in pain, unbearably uncomfortable.
As if about to explode at any moment.
"Hiss!"
Han Xing gasped for air.
The terrifying pain continually eroded his whole body.
And after enduring this wave of pain, he suddenly found the world before him had changed somewhat.
He saw numerous intersecting white lines surrounding him.
These lines pierced through the entire void, passing through everyone’s bodies.
They connected with all substances, limiting the void of all things.
Even when Han Xing raised his hand, he could feel these lines connecting to him.
Furthermore, Han Xing saw those disasters connected to him were also linked by numerous lines.
However, those lines were black.
At this moment, Han Xing finally understood something.
"So that’s it, these lines are the rules?"
"Rules are everywhere, all things are under the constraints of rules."
"From the moment of birth, spirits are bound by these rules."
Meanwhile, Han Xing saw more black lines appearing on his body too.
These black lines were even more terrifying than the quantity connected on those disasters.
And rapidly approaching him.
An inexplicable sensation suddenly arose in Han Xing’s heart.
This feeling was similar to divine spirits’ precognitive abilities, but even more profound than premonition.
Han Xing could sense the other end of the black lines were intended to deal with him.
"Radiance, be careful, it seems something else is coming from the void."
The God of Radiance, engaged in battle against the disasters, was somewhat puzzled.
For he, as a true god, hadn’t perceived anything approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 1021 - 513: Hunter’s Last Words_3
paragraphs: But Han Xing had not yet broken through to demigod, yet he sensed it, which was indeed somewhat strange.
However, less than ten seconds later.
In the void, a cluster of deep blue energy suddenly appeared.
From that energy cluster, the sound of waves faintly emanated.
"Splash... splash..."
The God of Radiance’s pupils contracted sharply and exclaimed, "This is... this is the Sea of Fallen Stars, enough to make True Gods fall!"
"My god, even such extinct natural disasters have appeared, is the master’s breakthrough this terrifying?"
Han Xing heard the God of Radiance’s introduction and also felt a bad premonition in his heart.
Sea of Fallen Stars...
Damn, why does this name feel so ominous?
Han Xing frowned and asked, "Radiance, can you handle it?"
The True God of Radiance took a deep breath, "If it were me just after breaking through, perhaps not confidently."
"But now, I can handle it."
"However, I might not be able to focus on anything else then."
Hearing this, Han Xing felt a bit more at ease in his heart.
In times like this, the True God of Radiance would not boast.
He said he could handle it, and he definitely could handle it.
Even if it was the Sea of Fallen Stars, enough to make True Gods fall.
Thus, Han Xing continued to focus on the matter at hand.
He continuously guided the divine power within his body to circulate throughout, then absorbed it.
His body was undergoing this strange transformation, as if a deep layer of remodeling.
This change, reflected clearly on the panel.
He saw his divine power value continuously changing.
Faintly approaching the breaking point of 900,000.
Sometimes it was 910,000, sometimes it reverted to 900,000.
However, the power of rules entwining him increased, virtually constraining him from head to toe.
At least hundreds of thousands of rules were restraining him.
Han Xing could even see the attributes of these powers of rules.
[Moon], [Sun], [Catastrophe], [Calm Chaos], [Suppression], [Exorcism] etc...
These powers of rules seemed to be restricting Han Xing from breaking this limit.
However, that divine spark left by the Hunter wasn’t just imbued with massive divine power.
It also had a special power.
Buzz!
In Han Xing’s surprised gaze.
An intangible aura burst from within him.
The strength of this aura even directly diluted the Sea of Fallen Stars in the sky, the Destruction Red Lotus.
More critically.
Those rules uncontacted by anything, at this moment, surprisingly melted like spider silk encountering flames.
Han Xing only felt, that oppressive force against him completely disappear.
Ease, a feeling of unprecedented ease rose in his mind.
He even couldn’t help but shout joyfully, "Wuhu!"
His divine power value also reached 900,001.
Though it was only a one-point breakthrough.
However, this signified Han Xing stepping forward under the extreme limits of the entire void!
This was a groundbreaking step!
Since the birth of the void, never had there been a lifeform reaching this realm, now broken by Han Xing!
Rumble!
At this moment, not only the Forbidden Star River, but including the Void Worlds!
The Holy Spirit Realm, alternate space, Abyss Realm all sensed something.
Even the small worlds hidden for countless years were directly shaken out at this moment.
Billions upon trillions of beings all felt a tremor in the sky above them!
In alternate space.
The endless sea of blood still rolled, boiling!
Blood waves thousands of meters high surged into the sky.
Countless hairless bizarre birds, the army of evil gods, were devoured by the blood wave, without even making a sound.
Even ancient beings lurking in the sea of blood for years awoke.
A creature with a body extending millions of kilometers, resembling a dragon but more like a fierce flood snake, surfaced from the sea of blood.
It suddenly opened its eyes and stared into the endless depths of the void.
Then, a trace of fear appeared in its pupillary gaze.
"The rules... the rules have cracked..."
"What happened?"
"Blood, curse, disaster, plague, calamity... come to me quickly!"
It called out hundreds of names in succession, its voice spreading throughout the alternate space.
The next moment, beside it appeared a group of horror creatures with no specific shapes, bodies twisted.
This ancient presence swiftly scanned around, "Why are several evil gods missing, where is Blood?"
One of them with a sinister aura, exuding infinite curse energy, replied, "Blood is dead, encountered the Hunter in the Holy Spirit Realm, both form and spirit are extinguished."
"Several other guys also encountered some accidents."
Hearing this, this ancient presence again frowned.
But now was not the time to consider these.
It directly asked, "Is the passage connecting alternate space to the void still there?"
Those ancient evil gods replied, "Still there."
The eyebrows of this flood snake gradually eased, "Good, now, quickly send out three ancient evil gods to the void, ascertain the cause of the tremor!"
"Yes."
Among them, three twisted life forms, each with different auras but equally filled with negative energy, rapidly disappeared from the scene.
Abyss Realm.
The endless sea of lava also began to boil due to this tremor, waves surged, raising magma waves tens of thousands of meters high.
The grand Demon Royal City began to tremble violently!
Countless intermediate demons, even the Great Demon Monarch, revealed looks of shock.
"What happened?"
"Is this an earthquake? How can there be an earthquake in our Abyss Realm?"
Rumble!
The tremor continued, growing stronger.
Deep within the Demon Royal City, a towering figure on a black throne suddenly stood.
His eyes like netherworld ghost fires penetrated through endless world barriers, seeing the scene in the void.
"Interesting! It’s been thousands of years, someone attempts to break the rules again, condensing their own divine format for breakthrough?"
