chapters.title: Chapter 1022 - 514: One Million Divine Power, Breaking Through the Limit
paragraphs: The Demon Emperor felt a hint of something unusual from this breakthrough.
At the same time, he reached out his hand.
It seemed as if he were touching something.
"The rules have cracked, which means the origin of the rules has been destroyed..."
"This is not breaking the rules; this is shattering the void!"
The majestic figure’s pupils suddenly shrank!
"Someone is actually trying to break the limits of the void!"
Because of the shock, the power within him became uncontrollable, spreading throughout the Abyss Realm.
The tremors, more terrifying than before, appeared.
The land showed horrifying cracks.
Billions of abyssal monsters and the Demon Army sank into these fissures.
Moreover, the more terrifying thing was that his power caused the Sea of Lava to riot.
The lava began to backflow, invading the Abyss Realm.
Countless demon cities were swallowed by the lava, causing chaos throughout the Abyss Realm!
The wails of demons echoed continuously.
However, the majestic figure remained unmoved.
His entire focus was on what he sensed.
"I need to take a look in the void."
"I must know who it is that breaks through the void’s limits?"
"And what method is he using!"
Yet, when he attempted to step out of the Abyss Realm, he was immediately blocked by a terrifying force.
Boom! Boom boom!
His gaze revealed unprecedented determination as he faced that terrifying power, continuously breaking the world barrier.
However, after advancing a certain distance, he was forced back.
The majestic existence muttered, "Is it still not time?"
"I thought that with the rules damaged, I could break through the restraints in one go."
"It seems that fellow really has been watching me all along."
The majestic existence returned to the Demon Royal City.
Yet, with a casual wave of his hand.
The tremors in the Abyss Realm instantly subsided.
The cracks on the ground began to quickly repair, even the Sea of Lava calmed down in an instant.
Then, with a casual gesture.
In the next moment, four terrifying entities with horns appeared before him.
These four terrifying entities had been scattered across the corners of the Abyss Realm.
In the blink of an eye, they uncontrollably appeared inside the Demon Royal City, expressing great surprise.
However, when they saw the majestic figure sitting on the throne, they simultaneously knelt down.
"Greetings, Emperor!"
The Demon Emperor nodded lightly, "Next, I will give you a mission."
"I will teleport you into the void, then follow your senses to find the one affecting the rules."
"If I’m not mistaken, many divine spirits and true gods are moving toward him now."
"Your mission is to capture him for me."
"Remember, alive!"
The four Ancient Demon Gods simultaneously accepted the orders.
The Demon Emperor waved his hand the following moment.
He began to forcibly tear the space, attempting to emulate what was done a millennium ago by forcibly opening a space passage.
However, thousands of powers of rules began pressing against him.
The Eternal body of the Demon Emperor showed cracks of demon blood.
Splat! Splat splat!
Terrifying demon blood began to spill, and the pure blood energy agitated the entire Abyss Realm.
However, the Demon Emperor did not retreat in the slightest,
He held the space rift with both hands, struggling to widen the rift.
As he exerted force, the backlash of the rules became increasingly terrifying.
Splat splat splat!
At this moment, the demon blood flowing from the Demon Emperor had formed a small river.
Then, with a ’crackle,’
A space passage was finally opened,
The Demon Emperor turned around, speaking with difficulty, "Now, quickly enter."
"After reaching the void, do not attempt to approach the Holy Spirit Realm.
"The power of rules in that great realm will attack you, leaving an imprint on you."
"And I will not be able to summon you back."
The four Ancient Demon Gods respectfully replied, "As you command, Emperor!"
As the words fell, they simultaneously entered the space rift.
At this moment, not only the Abyss Realm and Alternate Space.
Even those long-sealed Great Worlds in the void dispatched terrifying beings, rapidly approaching where Han Xing was.
These existences carried different purposes.
Meanwhile, Han Xing saw that his divine power value finally broke the limit, his face lit up with joy.
"Good, the divine format left by the Hunter still has immense divine power."
"Next, I need to absorb these divine power values to fully reach the limit!"
As Han Xing continued to operate and absorb, his personal panel showed a rapid increase in divine power values.
[Divine Power Value: 910,000]
[Divine Power Value: 920,000]
[Divine Power Value: 930,000]
This time, without any stagnation.
He surged directly to 1,000,000!
Then, an unprecedentedly formidable aura burst from Han Xing’s body.
That aura even affected the rules.
Han Xing saw that the thousands of lines of rules originally connected to him suddenly snapped.
Even more terrifying, even the connections of disasters to Han Xing were directly severed.
At this moment, the energy mass in the void, as if losing its target, momentarily paused in place.
The True God of Radiance continued to release divine power, countering these disasters.
Suddenly calm, he felt somewhat strange.
And at this moment, the True God of Radiance suddenly sensed that Han Xing’s aura had vanished.
"Master!"
The face of the True God of Radiance instantly changed dramatically.

sentences.text: The Demon Emperor felt a hint of something unusual from this breakthrough.
At the same time, he reached out his hand.
It seemed as if he were touching something.
"The rules have cracked, which means the origin of the rules has been destroyed..."
"This is not breaking the rules; this is shattering the void!"
The majestic figure’s pupils suddenly shrank!
"Someone is actually trying to break the limits of the void!"
Because of the shock, the power within him became uncontrollable, spreading throughout the Abyss Realm.
The tremors, more terrifying than before, appeared.
The land showed horrifying cracks.
Billions of abyssal monsters and the Demon Army sank into these fissures.
Moreover, the more terrifying thing was that his power caused the Sea of Lava to riot.
The lava began to backflow, invading the Abyss Realm.
Countless demon cities were swallowed by the lava, causing chaos throughout the Abyss Realm!
The wails of demons echoed continuously.
However, the majestic figure remained unmoved.
His entire focus was on what he sensed.
"I need to take a look in the void."
"I must know who it is that breaks through the void’s limits?"
"And what method is he using!"
Yet, when he attempted to step out of the Abyss Realm, he was immediately blocked by a terrifying force.
Boom!
Boom boom!
His gaze revealed unprecedented determination as he faced that terrifying power, continuously breaking the world barrier.
However, after advancing a certain distance, he was forced back.
The majestic existence muttered, "Is it still not time?"
"I thought that with the rules damaged, I could break through the restraints in one go."
"It seems that fellow really has been watching me all along."
The majestic existence returned to the Demon Royal City.
Yet, with a casual wave of his hand.
The tremors in the Abyss Realm instantly subsided.
The cracks on the ground began to quickly repair, even the Sea of Lava calmed down in an instant.
Then, with a casual gesture.
In the next moment, four terrifying entities with horns appeared before him.
These four terrifying entities had been scattered across the corners of the Abyss Realm.
In the blink of an eye, they uncontrollably appeared inside the Demon Royal City, expressing great surprise.
However, when they saw the majestic figure sitting on the throne, they simultaneously knelt down.
"Greetings, Emperor!"
The Demon Emperor nodded lightly, "Next, I will give you a mission."
"I will teleport you into the void, then follow your senses to find the one affecting the rules."
"If I’m not mistaken, many divine spirits and true gods are moving toward him now."
"Your mission is to capture him for me."
"Remember, alive!"
The four Ancient Demon Gods simultaneously accepted the orders.
The Demon Emperor waved his hand the following moment.
He began to forcibly tear the space, attempting to emulate what was done a millennium ago by forcibly opening a space passage.
However, thousands of powers of rules began pressing against him.
The Eternal body of the Demon Emperor showed cracks of demon blood.
Splat!
Splat splat!
Terrifying demon blood began to spill, and the pure blood energy agitated the entire Abyss Realm.
However, the Demon Emperor did not retreat in the slightest,
He held the space rift with both hands, struggling to widen the rift.
As he exerted force, the backlash of the rules became increasingly terrifying.
Splat splat splat!
At this moment, the demon blood flowing from the Demon Emperor had formed a small river.
Then, with a ’crackle,’
A space passage was finally opened,
The Demon Emperor turned around, speaking with difficulty, "Now, quickly enter."
"After reaching the void, do not attempt to approach the Holy Spirit Realm.
"The power of rules in that great realm will attack you, leaving an imprint on you."
"And I will not be able to summon you back."
The four Ancient Demon Gods respectfully replied, "As you command, Emperor!"
As the words fell, they simultaneously entered the space rift.
At this moment, not only the Abyss Realm and Alternate Space.
Even those long-sealed Great Worlds in the void dispatched terrifying beings, rapidly approaching where Han Xing was.
These existences carried different purposes.
Meanwhile, Han Xing saw that his divine power value finally broke the limit, his face lit up with joy.
"Good, the divine format left by the Hunter still has immense divine power."
"Next, I need to absorb these divine power values to fully reach the limit!"
As Han Xing continued to operate and absorb, his personal panel showed a rapid increase in divine power values.
[Divine Power Value: 910,000]
[Divine Power Value: 920,000]
[Divine Power Value: 930,000]
This time, without any stagnation.
He surged directly to 1,000,000!
Then, an unprecedentedly formidable aura burst from Han Xing’s body.
That aura even affected the rules.
Han Xing saw that the thousands of lines of rules originally connected to him suddenly snapped.
Even more terrifying, even the connections of disasters to Han Xing were directly severed.
At this moment, the energy mass in the void, as if losing its target, momentarily paused in place.
The True God of Radiance continued to release divine power, countering these disasters.
Suddenly calm, he felt somewhat strange.
And at this moment, the True God of Radiance suddenly sensed that Han Xing’s aura had vanished.
"Master!"
The face of the True God of Radiance instantly changed dramatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 1023 - 514: One Million Divine Power, Breaking the Limit! (2)
paragraphs: He suddenly turned around, only to find Han Xing standing there in good condition.
At this moment, the terror in the True God of Radiance’s eyes turned to bewilderment.
Not only the True God of Radiance, but everyone else also sensed Han Xing’s aura disappear.
However, when their eyes turned to him, they found Han Xing still standing in the same spot.
Everyone was amazed by the scene before them.
It was as if Han Xing had transcended the rules, unable to be sensed by any aura.
However, the rules soon reconnected to Han Xing.
And Han Xing’s aura once again appeared in everyone’s senses.
This scene did not concern Han Xing.
Because at this moment, a system notification appeared by his ear.
[Detected: Survivor Han Xing, breaking through 1 million Divine Power Value at the Legendary Realm, achieving the achievement: Unprecedented!]
[Congratulations: You are the only one in the void, reaching 1 million Divine Power Value at the Legendary Realm, unlocking a special title: Transcender]
[Infinite Domain Skill Upgrade, Current Level: Level 10]
"Finally, Level 10!"
Han Xing exclaimed excitedly, "Let me see what changes Level 10 Infinite Domain has!"
[Infinite Domain Level 10: Special Hidden Skill]

[Effect 1: Centering on oneself, within a radius of 10 million meters, activate 1 layer of Infinite Domain, all friendly units within the domain (including Defense Towers, Territory Buildings, Pets, Subsidiaries, etc.) have all attributes increased by 100% (including Divine Power Value), and gain an extra 90% damage reduction effect (cap reached).]

[Effect 2: Within the Infinite Domain, you possess endless creative ability, you can simulate once the strongest attack recorded after activating the domain, causing 100% damage of this attack, with a cooldown time of 2 hours.]
"Indeed, just as I expected!"
"The amplification range has increased tenfold, the all attributes increase by 100%, already equivalent to the bonus of a Sun Crown Stele."
"Now, the attributes of my Territory Defense Towers can soar again."
"And the most crucial thing, previously the Sun Crown Stele could only affect Defense Towers and other technological constructs.
"But my Infinite Domain can affect everyone, including True Gods!"
The power of this enhancement is almost self-evident.
Thinking of this, a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
"Radiance, prepare yourself."
The True God of Radiance, who was fighting against the Disaster Energy Group, had a somewhat bewildered expression.
"Prepare for what, Master?"
Han Xing did not speak.
Instead, he instantly activated an invisible domain from within.
Upon being covered by the domain,
The True God of Radiance, already terrifyingly powerful, suddenly had his momentum doubled!
Not only that, but all Defense Towers on the field, team members, and even the Lingxiao Mecha in the void.
Even the Painful Empress was enhanced by this domain!
What does doubling the power of a True God mean?
Through the previous battles, Han Xing had already deduced.
The attributes of a Middle-tier True God are approximately three to four times those of an Initial-tier True God,
And Radiance improved by 50% over the past five days.
Now, with Han Xing’s 100% bonus,
It’s equivalent to nearly reaching the realm of a Middle-tier True God at once!
If Radiance took out that High-tier Divine Artifact Hammer, his strength could soar again.
In a single state, he could absolutely suppress the True God of Yellow Sand!
And the Painful Empress, focusing solely on defense, could at least fend off a Middle-tier True God.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun received system notifications.
[You are under Han Xing’s Infinite Domain coverage, all attributes increased by 100%.]
Cheng Jianyong looked at the system notification in shock, exclaiming in the team channel, "Wow! Wow! Wow!"
"Brother Xing, you’ve broken through to a Demigod, how do you have such a powerful domain?
Han Xing replied, "Not yet, just achieved an achievement."
Hearing this, the shock in Cheng Jianyong’s eyes intensified.
"Oh my... without breaking through to Demigod, it’s already this terrifying. If Brother Xing breaks through to Demigod, how strong will he be?"
Upon hearing this, everyone also showed an expression of anticipation.
However, Shen Yun beside them said worriedly, "I’m a bit concerned now, Brother Xing hasn’t started breaking through yet, and already such a terrifying disaster has appeared."
"If he starts breaking through to Demigod, what terrifying things will he encounter?"
"I’m afraid it won’t just be disasters?"
Indeed, Shen Yun’s concerns were valid.
In fact, with his current Level 10 Infinite Domain, Han Xing was already formidable enough.
He himself is equivalent to a Sun Crown Stele.
Next, he just needs to continue developing Defense Towers and build more Celestial Rail Strike Devices.
Even against True Gods, he can fend off and possibly defeat them.
Han Xing will become the first in history to defeat and kill a True God.
However, will he simply stop at the Legendary Realm?
That’s impossible!
Han Xing already learned that in the void there is an exceptionally powerful and terrifying existence.
Its specific strength cannot be described.
Even the Hunter who reached the void limit doesn’t consider themselves this enemy’s match.
Thus, relying solely on Defense Towers, Han Xing knows he cannot defeat it.
He must possess even greater power and reach a realm no one else has reached to conquer everything.
To become the true Transcender!
So, Han Xing took a deep breath and said directly, "Prepare, I’m going to start breaking through!"
At this moment, the strength-surging God of Radiance was easily suppressing a pile of disasters, including the Sea of Fallen Stars.

chapters.title: Chapter 1024 - 514: One Million Divine Power, Breaking the Limits!
paragraphs: Upon hearing Han Xing speak, the True God of Radiance’s expression immediately turned solemn.
He directly extended his hands, seemingly peeling something off himself.
Moments later, a glowing humanoid figure suddenly appeared.
The humanoid figure had no features, no hair, and appeared to be merely a luminous object.
However, it also possessed the fluctuations of a True God Level.
And it was equally capable of contending with these terrifying calamities.
"Clone Technique?"
Everyone was somewhat puzzled.

The True God of Radiance explained, "It’s not a Clone Technique. It’s an energy body created with my Divine Power, but under the amplification of the master, it can still have the combat power of a True God Level."
Cheng Jianyong laughed, "This is impressive, Radiance. Teach me this in the future."
The True God of Radiance chuckled, "Sure, once you reach the Divine Realm, you should be able to use this method."
At this moment, the True God of Radiance appeared incredibly composed after extracting his hands.
Simultaneously, ten nerve networks appeared in Han Xing’s hands.
He was about to officially begin his breakthrough.
"The Ancient Tree said that only ten nerve networks are needed to condense one’s Divine Format."
"But how exactly do I do it?"
While Han Xing pondered, a system prompt appeared.
[Survivor Han Xing is attempting a breakthrough using special means, checking conditions.]
[Condition 1: Reach Level 60 (Completed)]
[Condition 2: Divine Power Value reaches 20k/100k (Completed)]
[Condition 3: Possess 10 complete Powers of Rules (Completed)]
[All conditions are met, proceed with the breakthrough?]
Han Xing’s eyes lit up with realization.
"So that’s it, the system will help me break through once the conditions are met?"
There was no need to hesitate.
Han Xing directly pressed ’Yes’.
At the same time, all ten Powers of Rules shattered.
The majestic Divine Power within them gathered into a mass.
A rhombic crystal gradually took shape.
This was a completely unrestrained object unbound by the Powers of Rules.
Han Xing saw that those white lines in the Void, which were the Powers of Rules, would bend and avoid the rhombic crystal when they came into contact with it.
Yet the more that occurred,
the more Powers of Rules were attracted to try and bind the rhombic crystal.
Han Xing even saw that the Powers of Rules in the Void rushed toward the rhombic crystal before him.
Rumble!
At this moment, the Void plunged into an unprecedented rule upheaval!
Not only in the Silent City,
but even the entire Forbidden Star River sensed it!
Those slumbering True Gods and Divine Spirits opened their eyes.
In the depths of the Forbidden Star River, a majestic figure drenched in a bloody aura frowned, "Rule upheaval, what happened?"

In the far distance, an ancient aura responded, "Celestial Wolf, something has happened. It appears another entity is attempting to break the rules in the Void, and they’ve already caused a rule upheaval, possibly reaching the final step!"
The bloody aura-filled figure, known as the True God of Celestial Wolf, erupted upon hearing this.
"Breaking the rules? Could it be another Hunter or Demon Emperor emerging in the Void?"
Meanwhile, more ancient beings in the Forbidden Star River were awakening, all looking toward the True God of Celestial Wolf.
He seemed to be one of the most formidable existences here.
"Celestial Wolf, what do we do now? We can’t allow another Hunter to appear in the Void!"
The True God of Celestial Wolf retorted irritably, "You’re asking me? I’m just a Middle-tier True God, using all my strength to resist the Forbidden Star River’s erosion. What can I do?"
Upon hearing these words, many True Gods fell silent.
They knew they could not allow another rule-breaking entity to emerge in the Void.
However, trapped within the Forbidden Star River, they were powerless to go out.
Even if they knew someone outside was breaking the rules, they were helpless.
At this moment, the True God of Celestial Wolf said, "Don’t just stand there. Let’s go awaken the Nether Emperor, Sea Emperor, and the others!"
"These Emperors might have a solution."
Upon hearing this, the True Gods were about to act.
A mysterious voice emerged.
"No need, we have already awakened."
Simultaneously, an immensely vast and death-filled aura surged from the depths of the Forbidden Star River.
Rumble.
The Forbidden Star River quaked.
"Nether Emperor!"
Those who survived in the Forbidden Star River were at least True God Level beings.
However, they were extremely fearful of that aura.
Because only beings at the High-tier True God Level were awarded the title of Emperor!
And the gap between High-tier and Middle-tier True Gods was akin to heaven and earth.
Simultaneously, the voice spoke again.
"The rules are starting to upheave. I’ve already discussed strategies with the Sea Emperor and Spirit Emperor."
"The True Gods of Silent City have already taken action."
Upon hearing this, other True Gods were greatly astonished, "Nether Emperor, Silent City is your handiwork?"
The shadowy aura chuckled lightly, "Or else, who do you think sent out the White Wolf’s corpse three thousand years ago?"
All the True Gods were once again greatly astonished.
These Emperors had been preparing for three thousand years!
Could it be, they had foreseen the event unfolding today, three thousand years later?
If true, that would be utterly terrifying!
Meanwhile,
In the vast Silent City.
Those long-dormant entities were called to action.
In the Void, a renegade was attempting to break the rules, causing a rule upheaval.
Not only the Powers of Rules but several mysterious auras were issuing commands to them.
Dozens of terrifying auras rose at the same time!
These auras seemed utterly unfamiliar to creatures living in the Silent City all year round.
Ever since the establishment of Silent City,
these auras have never appeared.
Now, due to the rule upheaval and the call of the Emperors, these long-dormant existences awoke for the first time.
At least High-tier Divine Level auras, among which six even surpassed the Divine Level!

chapters.title: Chapter 1025 - 515: Seeds of Calamity, Gathering of True Gods
paragraphs: The inhabitants of Silent City exclaimed in astonishment.
"True Gods! Six True Gods!"
"My gosh, when did Silent City manage to conceal so many True Gods?"
This number completely exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Previously, they thought that there were four True Gods here.
But now, unbelievably, it had reached six True Gods.
Considering the previous three-eyed man, it seemed that there were at least seven True Gods in Silent City.
Ignoring the shocked residents of Silent City.
In the sky, a female who resembled a bee race yet had a human head spoke: "Yellow Sand, have you received the news?"
The True God of Yellow Sand replied, "Moon Shadow, I never expected that they could rally even you."
Being of the same middle-tier True God level, Yellow Sand seemed quite apprehensive of this Moon Shadow Bee Race.
The female voice chuckled softly: "Just happened to be secluded for too long and their will woke me up."
"In that case, let’s go out and see which audacious little one dared to break the rules."
The True God of Yellow Sand nodded upon hearing this, then turned his gaze toward the sky above Silent City, at those dozens of powerful presences.
"Well, let’s set off."
The next moment.
Dozens of figures vanished simultaneously, speeding toward Han Xing’s location.
So far, at least three waves of formidable beings were rapidly rushing toward Han Xing.
However, at the center of this rule uprising, Han Xing did not sense it.
Because those powers of rules were interfering with his judgment.
Black and white were all mixed together.
At this moment, Han Xing was sitting cross-legged, frantically absorbing the power of rules, as an invisible and colorless crystal without a definite shape appeared before him.
At this moment, the crystal was gradually forming.
And as the crystal was forming, a progress bar appeared before Han Xing’s eyes.
[Divine Format Condensation Progress: 1%]
[Divine Format Condensation Progress: 2%]
The progress bar was extremely slow.
Almost every minute, it increased by only 1%.
And the absurd part was, Han Xing was still suppressed by countless powers of rules.
At present, even moving a bit was incredibly difficult, essentially trapped here.
That is to say, aside from being able to release the Infinite Domain, he couldn’t perform any other actions.
Moreover, he had to maintain this state for over an hour.
Forget about an hour.
Even a minute and Han Xing could be killed ten thousand times by those True Gods!
And at that moment.
Suddenly, a massive rule thread appeared in the Void.
It belonged to Samoyed’s rule.
At the instant the rule thread emerged.
A black figure rapidly spun, rushing toward Han Xing!
Witnessing this scene, everyone’s pupils suddenly contracted.
Shen Yun exclaimed: "Samoyed, what are you doing?"
Cheng Jianyong drew his War Axe, shouting angrily: "Samoyed, do you seek death!"
He charged straight out, seemingly intending to slay that Blade Armor Demon.
Everyone was shocked by Samoyed’s sudden action.
For they thought, constrained by an oath, Samoyed would never betray.
However, the spectacle before their eyes overturned everyone’s imagination.
Moreover, even more terrifyingly, True God of Radiance and Painful Empress in the sky seemed to be encountering some issues.
They saw Samoyed attack Han Xing and unexpectedly didn’t stop it immediately.
"Damn it!"
Shen Yun cursed angrily.
The situation did not allow him much consideration.
The immediate urgent task was to intercept Samoyed, it definitely cannot be allowed to disrupt Han Xing’s breakthrough!
Shen Yun directly activated the Celestial Rail Strike Device, ready to blast Samoyed!
"Buzz!"
The terrifying energy instantly locked onto Samoyed.
However, midway through Samoyed’s advance, suddenly sensed a crisis of death.
The previously blood-covered pupils abruptly cleared up.
It hastily halted its advance and exclaimed: "Master! It’s not me!"
"Damn it! I was manipulated by the rules!"
At this moment, Shen Yun, who was about to fire the Celestial Rail Strike Device, stopped in place.
He asked in confusion: "Samoyed, what’s happening?"
Samoyed quickly explained: "I don’t know, all I know is the rules conveyed a message to me, kill the one breaking the rule!"
"Before I could react, I was manipulated by the rules itself!"
"I’ve been wronged!"
Samoyed cried out repeatedly.
Meanwhile, Shen Yun and others noticed something seemed off.
Because, even the True God of Radiance and Painful Empress’s Trees of Rules were appearing at this moment.
Though they did not attack, both remained in place as if engaged in some form of resistance.
Simultaneously.
Without hesitation, Shen Yun aimed the Celestial Rail Strike Device and the Defense Towers of the entire Sky Island at the two True Gods in the sky.
If they made any move to attack Han Xing, Shen Yun would not hesitate to activate the Defense Towers to attack Radiance and Painful Empress.
At this moment, the two Trees of Rules trembled lightly.
True God of Radiance and Painful Empress opened their eyes simultaneously.
Then, seeing thousands of Defense Towers aiming at them, their expressions froze and they realized something.
True God of Radiance shook his head and smiled: "Young friend Shen Yun, you might want to turn the cannons away, I won’t take action against the Master."
Shen Yun, still somewhat skeptical, asked: "Really?"
True God of Radiance nodded, "Certainly, compared to the Master, the Tree of Rules cannot sway my intent."
Beside him, Painful Empress also chuckled: "Hehe, it’s the same for me here."
"Hmph! Such a feeble Tree of Rules wishes to make me attack the Master, how naive~"

chapters.title: Chapter 1026 - 515: Seed of Calamity, True Gods Gather_2
paragraphs: Upon hearing these words, everyone simultaneously breathed a sigh of relief.
However, the recent scene still left them feeling shaken.
Even the Power of Rules transmitted information, instructing these divine entities to target Han Xing.
It can be imagined just how dangerous Han Xing’s situation is right now.
It’s likely not just the True God of Radiance and Samoyed.
In the Void, any divine entity who wields the Power of Rules has been given the same command.
That is, to kill Han Xing!
In fact, that’s precisely the case.
At this moment, Han Xing, suppressed by thousands of rules, only feels like there are tens of thousands of majestic mountains upon him.
Moreover, he can also sense that suddenly hundreds of strands of black Power of Rules have appeared on him.
These strands of rules seem to be connected to Han Xing.
Among them, dozens are rapidly approaching him.
The position is in the direction of Silent City.
Among these dozen black Power of Rules, Han Xing senses that there are six extremely vast strands.
He seemed to understand something and immediately exclaimed: "Damn it! So many are coming at once, and there are True Gods!"
Han Xing immediately felt his scalp go numb and quickly warned:
"Radiance, Madeleine, people are coming from Silent City, a total of six True Gods, over forty divine entities, be cautious."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s warning, everyone’s expression changed.
Cheng Jianyong angrily said: "Damn it, that’s outrageous?"
"Starting with six True Gods, is this really the lineup to deal with a legend?"
The team members also felt extremely furious.
Because this clearly shows that they aren’t giving Han Xing any chance to break through.
However, because they only possess strength at a legend, demigod level.
This level of battle is beyond their ability to intervene.
What can be relied upon now is the two True Gods, along with that thousands of Defense Towers, and ten mechas: Lingxiao.
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong, among others, internally made a decision that no matter what, they must ensure that Han Xing breaks through.
Everyone was ready for battle.
Here is not far from Silent City.
At the speed of True Gods, it can be reached in merely minutes.
Sure enough, less than five minutes passed.
In the void, six terrifying presences have already appeared.
It’s those six True Gods, who arrived first!
At this moment.
The True God of Radiance and Madeleine watched those six figures with vigilance.
The six True Gods from Silent City stopped near that black Sky Island.
Before making a move, they must first identify the enemy.
And when the True God of Yellow Sand saw Han Xing on that Sky Island, his pupils suddenly constricted, "It’s really you, brat!"
"You, in my Silent City, caused such a commotion, and took away so many treasures."
"And now you even want to break the rules!"
"You brat, you’re truly a natural disaster, stirring up trouble wherever you go!"
Han Xing glared at him.
Originally, he didn’t want to say much to the True God of Yellow Sand, but suddenly he had a different thought.
Thus, Han Xing, enduring the suppression of the rules, casually spoke: "Yellow Sand, we’re old friends, let’s forget it today."
"You can see my limitless potential."
"Once I break through to demigod, I’ll become an entity beyond the rules, follow me and you’ll have a prosperous future."
"In the future, I can even help you break through to a high-tier True God."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s promise, the True God of Yellow Sand’s eyes showed a hint of movement.
Although Han Xing is just a legend, he knows very well the extent of this guy’s abilities.
To see the True God of Radiance and Madeleine breakthrough to True Gods from top-tier divine spirits in a short time is evidence enough.
Moreover, he has many treasures in his hands, even technology weapons capable of injuring True Gods.
If it’s this guy, perhaps he really could help me breakthrough to a high-tier True God?
The True God of Yellow Sand just felt tempted, but suddenly realized something.
He furiously said: "Kid, you’re trying to use words to stall my time!"
"Let me tell you, this trick will no longer work."
However, Han Xing casually said: "I’m not stalling for time, I’m serious."
"I truly want to help you break through to a high-tier True God."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s sincere words, the True God of Yellow Sand once again felt tempted.
But he quickly snapped back, "Hmph! Brat, still trying to use words to stall for time? Do you think I’m that easy to fool?"
Han Xing sighed, not expecting the True God of Yellow Sand to suddenly smarten up.
The True God of Yellow Sand sneered and said: "However, there is something I can tell you."
"This time, it’s not me targeting you, but the Power of Rules providing us with the information."
"Do you understand what this means?"
"It means that across the entire void, any existence wielding the rules, whether divine entities or True Gods, will be guided by the rules to come and kill you."
"Kid, you’re in big trouble today!"
The True God of Yellow Sand looked gleeful.
However, everyone frowned.
Although they already knew that the entire void’s rules were targeting Han Xing.
But now hearing it from the True God of Yellow Sand himself still made them feel hard to understand.
Beside them, the True God of Moon Shadow Bee Race, a woman with face painted, said indifferently: "Yellow Sand, why waste so many words with him."
"Quickly take out this brat, then retrieve what he took from Silent City, so we can return and report."
The True God of Yellow Sand said: "No rush, let’s observe first."
Yet, the True God of Moon Shadow impatiently said: "Observe what?"
"He’s just a legend, and although there are two True Gods beside him, they’re not worth worrying about."

chapters.title: Chapter 1027 - 515: Seed of Calamity, True Gods Gather_3
paragraphs: "Yellow Sand, what are you doing? Being so cautious to deal with a mere Legend, are you regressing as you age?"
On the field, the other four True Gods also had peculiar expressions.
But they didn’t dare to speak as bluntly as the True God of Moon Shadow.
The True God of Yellow Sand was admonished.
He wanted to say, this kid’s tricks are very odd, we should be careful.
But he feared being ridiculed by these fellows, for being afraid of a Legendary Level kid.
Thus, the True God of Yellow Sand nodded and said, "Let’s go! I’ll deal with Radiance."
"Moon Shadow, you go deal with Madeleine."
"The other four True Gods, go kill that kid!"
It’s undeniable that the tactical arrangement of the True God of Yellow Sand was very reasonable.
Right at the start, he spared no effort, deploying four True Gods to strive to take down Han Xing immediately.
With those words, the six True Gods simultaneously transformed into streams of light and vanished.
And just at this moment, a woman’s light laughter came from the sky.
"You guys want to deal with my master, but it’s not going to work~"
With those words, she proactively rushed towards the six True Gods.
"Don’t even think about attacking my master!"
Meanwhile, the True God of Radiance also immediately charged towards those six True Gods.
Seeing Radiance and Madeleine rushing over,
the four True Gods on the opposite side sneered, "Overestimating yourself, two just-broke-through folks dare to proactively deal with us!"
"They even call this human kid their master, truly a disgrace to us True Gods!"
"Should we perhaps teach these two a little lesson first?"
Upon hearing the mockery from the opposite side, the Painful Empress and the True God of Radiance weren’t angered.
The Painful Empress gently laughed, "Gentlemen, would you like to play with me~"
Listening to Madeleine’s alluring voice, a lustful look appeared in the eyes of the True God of Shadow Demon on the opposite side.
"Madeleine, would you like to play with me? I’ll show you what ecstasy feels like!"
The Painful Empress giggled, "Really? Are you that impressive?"
The True God of Shadow Demon showed a confident expression, "Of course, you’ll know once you try!"
And just then, the True God of Yellow Sand bellowed, "Shadow Demon, don’t fall for this woman’s illusion technique!"
Dong!
The voice of the True God of Yellow Sand rang like a great bell, instantly waking up the Shadow Demon.

The lustful look faded from Shadow Demon’s eyes, replaced by a hint of fear as he said, "I actually got my mind influenced just now... Madeleine just broke through, and she’s already this frightening?"
The Painful Empress chuckled, "Oh, don’t say such things about me, I’m not that scary~"
Knowing the bizarre Rule of Desire of the Painful Empress, the True God of Yellow Sand urgently cautioned, "Don’t talk to this woman, don’t answer her questions!"
Looking at the solemn expression of the True God of Yellow Sand, the other True Gods on the field showed peculiar expressions.
It’s truly rare to witness a middle-tier True God so afraid of a newly ascended True God.
The True God of Moon Shadow, also a middle-tier True God, cast a disdainful look at the True God of Yellow Sand.
She directly asked, "Yellow Sand, what did you suffer from this woman that made you so scared?"
Upon hearing the question, the other True Gods curiously looked at the True God of Yellow Sand.
The severe, elderly face of the True God of Yellow Sand changed several times, but ultimately, he didn’t speak out, thinking mentioning it would be quite embarrassing.
Seeing his reluctance to answer, the True God of Moon Shadow didn’t press further.
Instead, she looked at the Painful Empress and sneered, "Madeleine, whatever means you have, feel free to try them on me, let me see what’s so peculiar about you!"
The Painful Empress covered her face, somewhat disappointedly saying, "Oh~ don’t say such things about me~ I really want to have a nice talk with you all."
Her voice seemed to carry a layer of invisible divine power waves, capable of silently infiltrating the minds of enemies.
Even among the four True Gods on the field, there were some who believed the words of the Painful Empress.
The True God of Moon Shadow slightly closed her eyes, her forehead decorated with dye slightly furrowed.
Moments later, the True God of Moon Shadow opened her eyes.
She returned to her original expression, "So that’s how it is, influencing my judgment from the root of thought? You do have some skill, but it won’t work on me."
The True God of Moon Shadow sneered, "Madeleine, you think that just breaking through to True God gives you the courage to face me?"
"Back then you came to Silent City, and I casually struck a tail spike at you, do you remember that incident?"
On the opposite side, Madeleine, seeing her Power of Laws ineffective against the True God of Moon Shadow, didn’t panic.
She simply chuckled, "Of course I remember, that stab from you back then pained me for years~"
The True God of Moon Shadow continued, "Good, so you remember it, and now, make way for me voluntarily, don’t obstruct our kill of that kid."
With those words, the True God of Moon Shadow made a gesture.
The other four True Gods understood, they quickly changed positions, intending to bypass the Painful Empress and the True God of Radiance, to assassinate Han Xing.
The Painful Empress naturally saw the movements of the four True Gods, "Oh my~ in such a hurry to leave?"
Saying this, the tone of the Painful Empress turned somewhat chilling, "Why don’t you all stay behind together, and play with me!"
With those words, an unprecedented terrifying aura erupted from Madeleine.
Buzz!
The horrific divine power spread.
It actually suppressed the other four True Gods on the field, nearing the height of the True God of Yellow Sand!
The six True Gods were startled.
The Deep Sea Worm exclaimed, "Madeleine, is she this strong just after breaking through?"
"How is it possible?"
Before they could react, an even more terrifying aura erupted from the True God of Radiance!
It even reached the intensity of the True God of Yellow Sand!
Not only that, as the True God of Radiance held a black warhammer in his hand, his aura continued to surge madly, even jumping to the intensity of the True God of Moon Shadow!

She returned to her original expression, "So that’s how it is, influencing my judgment from the root of thought?
You do have some skill, but it won’t work on me."
The True God of Moon Shadow sneered, "Madeleine, you think that just breaking through to True God gives you the courage to face me?"
"Back then you came to Silent City, and I casually struck a tail spike at you, do you remember that incident?"
On the opposite side, Madeleine, seeing her Power of Laws ineffective against the True God of Moon Shadow, didn’t panic.
She simply chuckled, "Of course I remember, that stab from you back then pained me for years~"
The True God of Moon Shadow continued, "Good, so you remember it, and now, make way for me voluntarily, don’t obstruct our kill of that kid."
With those words, the True God of Moon Shadow made a gesture.
The other four True Gods understood, they quickly changed positions, intending to bypass the Painful Empress and the True God of Radiance, to assassinate Han Xing.
The Painful Empress naturally saw the movements of the four True Gods, "Oh my~ in such a hurry to leave?"
Saying this, the tone of the Painful Empress turned somewhat chilling, "Why don’t you all stay behind together, and play with me!"
With those words, an unprecedented terrifying aura erupted from Madeleine.
Buzz!
The horrific divine power spread.
It actually suppressed the other four True Gods on the field, nearing the height of the True God of Yellow Sand!
The six True Gods were startled.
The Deep Sea Worm exclaimed, "Madeleine, is she this strong just after breaking through?"
"How is it possible?"
Before they could react, an even more terrifying aura erupted from the True God of Radiance!
It even reached the intensity of the True God of Yellow Sand!
Not only that, as the True God of Radiance held a black warhammer in his hand, his aura continued to surge madly, even jumping to the intensity of the True God of Moon Shadow!

chapters.title: Chapter 1028 - 516: Obstruction, Divine Battle Rekindled
paragraphs: The True God of Yellow Sand’s pupils shrank suddenly, "The radiant ones...what’s going on with you all?"
"How could you possibly break through to Middle-tier True God in just a few days?"
The True God of Radiance didn’t explain but solemnly said, "If you want to deal with the master, you must first pass me!"
As he spoke, he raised his warhammer high, and the radiant divine power suddenly erupted.
Like a burning sun.
The next moment, thousands of chains of light appeared from all directions, filling every inch of the void.
"Clang clang!"
And not just that, as the Painful Empress hooked her long leg.
Along with the chains of light, countless red spider webs appeared.
No one knows when these webs were laid down, but they are even denser than the chains of the True God of Radiance, almost sealing off every corner!
Except for the True God of Moon Shadow and the True God of Yellow Sand.
The other four True Gods seemed to have fallen into a quagmire, their ability to move greatly reduced.
"Damn it! Techniques that can trap True Gods!"
"These two have actually reached the strength of Middle-tier True Gods!"
At this moment, not just them, but even the True God of Moon Shadow and the True God of Yellow Sand were tremendously shocked.
Especially the True God of Moon Shadow.
The little spider that she could easily crush in the past had grown to be this powerful in such a short time.
In her millions of years as a True God, she had not been this surprised in a long time.
However, the True God of Moon Shadow quickly regained her composure.
She sneered, "So what if you’re Middle-tier True Gods? In the face of absolute power suppression, your resistance is futile!"
"All of you, attack with me. Let’s put these two to sleep before dealing with that boy!"
As she spoke, this True God of Moon Shadow beckoned with her hand,
behind her appeared countless silver tail spikes.
Each of these spikes is filled with intense venom, enough to make top-tier divine spirits fall!
Crash!
Thousands of silver tail spikes fell like raindrops.
She intended to pierce through the Painful Empress’s divine power spider web.
And those spider webs snapped one by one upon contact with the spikes.
However, the Painful Empress wasn’t flustered in the slightest.
Because at this moment, the radiant divine power chain had already gone up to meet them.
"Purr! Purr, purr, purr!"
The chains clashed with the tail spikes.
Every second, numerous chains broke, and many tail spikes evaporated.
The tail spikes of the True God of Moon Shadow couldn’t restrain radiance, so what’s left is a contest of divine power intensity.
But clearly, the True God of Radiance, wielding a high-tier Divine Artifact and augmented by the Infinite Domain, showed no disadvantage in divine power intensity.
At this moment, a sandstorm swept in.
The True God of Yellow Sand was joining forces with the True God of Moon Shadow to tackle the True God of Radiance.
The Painful Empress chuckled lightly from the side, "You want to ally against my companion? Are you ignoring me?"
With those words, blood spiders suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
Upon appearing, the blood spiders immediately self-destructed.
The bloody aura was swept up by the sandstorm, instantly turning the yellow sandstorm blood-red.
At that very moment, the True God of Yellow Sand’s brow furrowed tightly.
In a brief moment, his expression turned extremely unpleasant.
Because he felt an acute pain suddenly arise from all over his body.
The pain wasn’t simple physical pain; it was like someone pulling out your guts with a fruit knife, then slowly shredding them.
Besides pain, there was a profound fear engulfing his mind.
So much so that the True God of Yellow Sand was compelled to halt the execution of Sandstorm.
He looked at the Painful Empress with shock all over his face.
This move was what Painful Empress had previously used against Zigu.
Now, after becoming a True God, she had refined it further.
Currently, she can directly transmit the feeling of pain to the enemy along with divine power, completely unavoidable.
Both the True God of Yellow Sand and the True God of Moon Shadow found themselves unable to overcome their opponent.
Not only that, but the other four True Gods were also trapped, unable to break free.
All six True Gods were held up by two newly-ascended True Gods.
The True God of Moon Shadow, in battle with radiance, frowned and said, "Don’t get bogged down with them; as per the original plan, go eliminate that human boy."
"These two True Gods, leave them to me and Yellow Sand."
With those words, the True God of Moon Shadow swung her hips.
Suddenly, from beneath her bee-like body, countless poisonous needles erupted.
She wanted to liberate the four True Gods.
Yet, the True God of Radiance coldly snorted at this moment, "I told you, to deal with the master, you have to pass through me first!"
"Divine Feather! Annihilate!"
The golden wings behind the True God of Radiance suddenly burst forth, transforming into rain-like density, blocking all those poison needles.
"Damn it!"
For the first time, anger flared on the True God of Moon Shadow’s face.
She was truly infuriated by this radiant guy!
The next moment, the True God of Moon Shadow rushed forward fiercely,
However, the battle of True Gods isn’t about who has the stronger momentum.
It is about the intensity of divine power value.
The True God of Radiance was by no means inferior to her at this moment.
The two sides clashed again.
As time slowly passed.
The True God level battle continuously shook the void but did not affect Han Xing here.
From Han Xing condensing divine format to now, nearly half an hour has passed.
And the progress bar before him had reached 31%.
Seeing that the divine format gradually gained color from transparency.
The six True Gods of Silent City also felt the urging from the Tree of Rules to expedite their actions.
However, they were all held up by Radiance and the Painful Empress, unable to overcome their opponents for the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1029 - 516: Obstruction, Divine Battle Rekindled! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "Damn!"
The True God of Yellow Sand and the True God of Moon Shadow were becoming impatient.
They hadn’t expected that, despite being just two Initial-tier True Gods, they would be able to hold them off for so long.
The True God of Moon Shadow angrily shouted, "Madeleine, get out of my way, you wench!"
The Painful Empress remained unruffled.
She chuckled softly, "Hmm? Moon Shadow, are you in a rush?"
"Being a Middle-tier True God, yet held back so long by a mere Initial-tier True God like me, don’t you feel like a worthless fool?"
"Tsk tsk, let me see, your chest is so flat, and your waist is so thick, no wonder you’ve been alone all these years."
"In my view, you’re only slightly older than me, aren’t you?"
The Painful Empress’s tone was calm, yet her words were piercing.
For a woman, such remarks carried a significant impact.
No matter how good the True God of Moon Shadow’s disposition was, being mocked by someone she could easily crush in the past caused her composure to shatter.
"Ah, damn Madeleine, I will kill you!"
The Painful Empress still chuckled gently, constantly weaving Divine Power spider webs to envelop the four True Gods, making them weary from dealing with her.
Furthermore, she continued to verbally incite the True God of Moon Shadow’s anger.
The True God of Yellow Sand noticeably observed the True God of Moon Shadow’s eyes turning extremely red, showing signs of losing control.
He seemed to realize something and his face changed immediately.
The True God of Yellow Sand hurriedly reminded, "Moon Shadow, don’t let the Painful Empress provoke you. She wields the power of desire; if you continue this way, you’ll fall into her trap!"
Nonetheless, the True God of Yellow Sand’s reminder was to no avail.
The True God of Moon Shadow had fully succumbed to rage, her entire being engulfed in a state of fury.
"Yellow Sand, shut up! How could I fall into the hands of this worm!
"Today, I will capture this worm, tear her mouth apart bit by bit, and break all her legs, leaving her in eternal torment!"
The True God of Moon Shadow continued to curse relentlessly.
Yet the Painful Empress chuckled softly, "Oh my, I’m so scared~"
"Moon Shadow, don’t just talk, act~ I hope your skills match your mouth, I’m looking forward to it~"
"By the way, Moon Shadow, I suggest not wiping off the doodles on your face. You’re already quite old, and wiping them off makes you look even worse, like an old hag~"
Upon hearing the latter sentence, the True God of Moon Shadow paused in her breath.
Her eyes turned entirely red, "Madeleine! You’re dead for sure today!"
Boom!
Terrifying silver Divine Power erupted from the True God of Moon Shadow, and she plunged completely into madness.
The True God of Radiance, constantly using Divine Power to combat, was faced with full helplessness against the True God of Moon Shadow.
Every provocation from the Painful Empress pushed the woman further into madness, and the primary pressure was borne by Radiance, who had suffered several wounds from Moon Shadow’s strikes.
Meanwhile, seeing the situation unfolding, the Painful Empress deemed it was the right moment.
With a wave of her hand, a ring imbued with Seven Emotions and Six Desires landed directly on the True God of Moon Shadow.
The next moment, this powerful Middle-tier True God was fixed at one spot, seemingly oblivious to everything around her.
"Moon Shadow! Wake up!"
The True God of Yellow Sand exclaimed anxiously, having experienced the Painful Empress’s technique before and knew its terror.
Furthermore, the Painful Empress had grown stronger now, making the eerie move even more dreadful!
He wanted to rush to the True God of Moon Shadow’s side.
Yet, in the next instant, he was swarmed by countless Blood Spiders.
These Blood Spiders commenced self-destructing the moment they appeared, while Madeleine sprayed waves of red Venom with her tail.
The Venom engulfed the Void where the True God of Yellow Sand resided, making him hesitate to approach recklessly.
At this moment, the True God of Moon Shadow, caught by the Painful Empress’s Seven Emotions and Six Desires Ring, seemed trapped by an Illusion Technique, perceiving nothing of the external world.
The True God of Yellow Sand’s desperate calls did not reach her.
Moreover, the True God of Moon Shadow’s expressions shifted between anger, laughter, pain, and affection.
The rapid changes in her expressions left all True Gods on the scene dumbfounded.
The even more terrifying fact was that the aura from the True God of Moon Shadow was rapidly aging.
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand braved the Painful Empress’s terrifying Venom to reach the True God of Moon Shadow’s side.
Then he shook her body violently.
"Moon Shadow! Wake up quickly!"
"Wake up!"
His voice echoed through the Void, but there was no response from the True God of Moon Shadow.
The Painful Empress chuckled lightly, "It’s useless~ She’s completely immersed in the world I wove for her."
"This world, composed of Seven Emotions and Six Desires, closely resembles reality, and once enveloped, there’s no escaping."
"No matter what action you take on her body now, she won’t respond~"
Upon hearing this, the other True Gods on the scene, including the True God of Radiance, couldn’t help but shudder.
Everyone involuntarily updated their understanding of the methods of this alluring Mother Spider.
The Painful Empress’s maneuver had truly stunned all True Gods present.
The True God of Blood Demon anxiously said, "Yellow Sand, the intelligence was off! Madeleine suddenly became so powerful, at this rate we’re going to be dragged to death right here!"
The nearby Deep Sea Worm was equally urgent, "Yellow Sand, do you have any other options?"
The True God of Yellow Sand wanted to say, you guys deserve it.
Previously, it was advised that the human’s methods were peculiar, and these True Gods were not easy to handle.

chapters.title: Chapter 1030 - 516: Obstruction, Divine Battle Resumes! (Part 3)
paragraphs: Each one is more arrogant than the last.
Now, having fallen into this situation, they suddenly remember themselves!
Although he thinks this way, True God of Yellow Sand knows now is not the time for such thoughts.
He must rescue these four True Gods.
If not, entangled by Painful Empress and this radiant True God, he might end up following the footsteps of True God of Moon Shadow.
As he finished speaking, True God of Yellow Sand once again employed his signature move.
In the Void, a vast desert appeared out of nowhere, with a Divine Hall towering inside.
That desert directly covered the entire area, including the four True Gods and True God of Moon Shadow.
But True God of Radiance and Madeleine were already guarding against this move.
Next moment.
True God of Radiance and Madeleine simultaneously made a gesture.
Buzz!
The Divine Power Spider Web suddenly contracted.
And the Feather of Light from True God of Radiance also descended at this moment.
The full burst of the two True Gods could be described as a mighty divine force!
At the same time, the desert in the Void quickly became extremely fragmented.
True God of Yellow Sand was forced to reveal his true form,
"Puff!"
He spat out a mouthful of Blood of the True God.
His complexion turned incredibly pale.
That strike just now inflicted serious injuries on True God of Yellow Sand, and even with the Tree of Rules, he couldn’t fully restore his strength.
For at least one or two months in the future, the strength of True God of Yellow Sand would be weaker than other Middle-tier True Gods.
Although he paid such a heavy price,
he was fortunate to rescue the other four True Gods.
And he also saved the true form of True God of Moon Shadow.
"Yellow Sand!"
"Yellow Sand City Lord!"
The Deep Sea Worm and Blood Demon exclaimed.
Seeing True God of Yellow Sand suffer such severe injuries to rescue them, they couldn’t help but feel touched.
Before they could say more.
True God of Radiance and Painful Empress had already come to attack again.
True God of Yellow Sand took a deep breath and said, "Quickly recover from your injuries, we will hold them off together!"
It seemed that none of the True Gods on the field expected this scene.
Their initial plan was to deal with Han Xing.
But now, they were being hunted by the True Gods under his command in return.
This also related to True God of Moon Shadow’s carelessness.
If Moon Shadow had not been provoked by Painful Empress, they wouldn’t have ended up like this!
Meanwhile, these True Gods quickly summoned the Tree of Rules, continuously drawing divine power to heal their injuries.
True God of Yellow Sand prepared to single-handedly hold off Painful Empress and True God of Radiance to gain them recovery time.
And just at this moment.
A large number of Divine Spirits appeared in the Void.
At the very least, they were High-tier Divine Spirits, including at least seven Top-tier Divine Spirits.
True God of Yellow Sand revealed a delighted expression, "Finally here!"
Although entities below the level of True God couldn’t threaten them.
However, the sheer number was a problem!
These High-tier Divine Spirits and Top-tier Divine Spirits were equivalent to the power of two True Gods!
And now, the two True Gods by that human’s side were on their side.
There was no way to stop the power of these High-tier Divine Spirits!
True God of Yellow Sand shouted directly, "Adolf, Valent, go and kill that human who is breaking through!"
"We are being held up by two True Gods!"
Upon hearing True God of Yellow Sand’s voice, the newly arrived High-tier Divine Spirits all showed puzzled expressions.
They hadn’t expected that powerful entities like True God of Yellow Sand, True God of Moon Shadow, combined with four other Divine Spirits, would also be held up.
This indicated that the enemy was exceptionally formidable!
These High-tier Divine Spirits exchanged glances, then nodded, "Let’s go, take down that kid first!
They locked onto Han Xing, who was breaking through at the center of a black Sky Island.
There, the Power of Rules was extremely chaotic, as if it was about to turn into the chaotic center of the Void.
Whoosh!
Dozens of Divine Spirits aggressively charged towards the Sky Island.
This development made Cheng Jianyong and others, who were watching from the Divine Demon Battleship, feel a bit tense.
Their task was to eliminate the Divine Spirits missed by Radiance and Painful Empress.
And now, there were just too many Divine Spirits appearing!
At this moment, a Blade Armor Demon manifested his true form, blocking the path of all the Divine Spirits.
It was Samoyed!
Now, with its body stretching over a million meters, it looked like a gigantic starry beast standing before numerous Divine Spirits.
Samoyed achieved the limit of High-tier Divine Spirit, under Han Xing’s Infinite Domain Amplification, but had not yet reached the level of Top-tier Divine Spirit.
Regardless, it dared block the path of this many Divine Spirits.
This sight left the Divine Spirits and even True Gods on the field puzzled.
One Top-tier Divine Spirit of the Black Dragon Elephant Race wondered, "Is that... Samoyed?"
"Its aura seems to be that of a High-tier Divine Spirit, it looks like the breakthrough was real."
"Does this guy intend to block us alone?"
At this moment, Samoyed gave them a provocative smile, "Divine Spirits, do you want to experience the big drill of my Blade Armor Demon Race? I guarantee it will make you want to die for pleasure!"
"And male Divine Spirits, stay back, I’m not into that."
The Divine Spirits opposite had bizarre expressions; they had lived for thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
Of course, they wouldn’t be provoked easily by Samoyed’s simple taunt.
A High-tier Divine Spirit of the Purgatory Fire Deer Race asked, "Moya, are you okay?"
"By the looks of it, you’re planning to help this legendary human block us?"
"What did he offer you, making you so willing to fight?"
Samoyed sneered, "You’re overthinking, I, Samoyed, will not be swayed by any benefit. I just don’t want you guys to interrupt my master’s breakthrough, that’s all."
Upon hearing this, the group of Divine Spirits had even more bizarre expressions.
"Moya, are you mistaken, that Legendary Level ant is your master?"

sentences.text: Each one is more arrogant than the last.
Now, having fallen into this situation, they suddenly remember themselves!
Although he thinks this way, True God of Yellow Sand knows now is not the time for such thoughts.
He must rescue these four True Gods.
If not, entangled by Painful Empress and this radiant True God, he might end up following the footsteps of True God of Moon Shadow.
As he finished speaking, True God of Yellow Sand once again employed his signature move.
In the Void, a vast desert appeared out of nowhere, with a Divine Hall towering inside.
That desert directly covered the entire area, including the four True Gods and True God of Moon Shadow.
But True God of Radiance and Madeleine were already guarding against this move.
Next moment.
True God of Radiance and Madeleine simultaneously made a gesture.
Buzz!
The Divine Power Spider Web suddenly contracted.
And the Feather of Light from True God of Radiance also descended at this moment.
The full burst of the two True Gods could be described as a mighty divine force!
At the same time, the desert in the Void quickly became extremely fragmented.
True God of Yellow Sand was forced to reveal his true form,
"Puff!"
He spat out a mouthful of Blood of the True God.
His complexion turned incredibly pale.
That strike just now inflicted serious injuries on True God of Yellow Sand, and even with the Tree of Rules, he couldn’t fully restore his strength.
For at least one or two months in the future, the strength of True God of Yellow Sand would be weaker than other Middle-tier True Gods.
Although he paid such a heavy price,
he was fortunate to rescue the other four True Gods.
And he also saved the true form of True God of Moon Shadow.
"Yellow Sand!"
"Yellow Sand City Lord!"
The Deep Sea Worm and Blood Demon exclaimed.
Seeing True God of Yellow Sand suffer such severe injuries to rescue them, they couldn’t help but feel touched.
Before they could say more.
True God of Radiance and Painful Empress had already come to attack again.
True God of Yellow Sand took a deep breath and said, "Quickly recover from your injuries, we will hold them off together!"
It seemed that none of the True Gods on the field expected this scene.
Their initial plan was to deal with Han Xing.
But now, they were being hunted by the True Gods under his command in return.
This also related to True God of Moon Shadow’s carelessness.
If Moon Shadow had not been provoked by Painful Empress, they wouldn’t have ended up like this!
Meanwhile, these True Gods quickly summoned the Tree of Rules, continuously drawing divine power to heal their injuries.
True God of Yellow Sand prepared to single-handedly hold off Painful Empress and True God of Radiance to gain them recovery time.
And just at this moment.
A large number of Divine Spirits appeared in the Void.
At the very least, they were High-tier Divine Spirits, including at least seven Top-tier Divine Spirits.
True God of Yellow Sand revealed a delighted expression, "Finally here!"
Although entities below the level of True God couldn’t threaten them.
However, the sheer number was a problem!
These High-tier Divine Spirits and Top-tier Divine Spirits were equivalent to the power of two True Gods!
And now, the two True Gods by that human’s side were on their side.
There was no way to stop the power of these High-tier Divine Spirits!
True God of Yellow Sand shouted directly, "Adolf, Valent, go and kill that human who is breaking through!"
"We are being held up by two True Gods!"
Upon hearing True God of Yellow Sand’s voice, the newly arrived High-tier Divine Spirits all showed puzzled expressions.
They hadn’t expected that powerful entities like True God of Yellow Sand, True God of Moon Shadow, combined with four other Divine Spirits, would also be held up.
This indicated that the enemy was exceptionally formidable!
These High-tier Divine Spirits exchanged glances, then nodded, "Let’s go, take down that kid first!
They locked onto Han Xing, who was breaking through at the center of a black Sky Island.
There, the Power of Rules was extremely chaotic, as if it was about to turn into the chaotic center of the Void.
Whoosh!
Dozens of Divine Spirits aggressively charged towards the Sky Island.
This development made Cheng Jianyong and others, who were watching from the Divine Demon Battleship, feel a bit tense.
Their task was to eliminate the Divine Spirits missed by Radiance and Painful Empress.
And now, there were just too many Divine Spirits appearing!
At this moment, a Blade Armor Demon manifested his true form, blocking the path of all the Divine Spirits.
It was Samoyed!
Now, with its body stretching over a million meters, it looked like a gigantic starry beast standing before numerous Divine Spirits.
Samoyed achieved the limit of High-tier Divine Spirit, under Han Xing’s Infinite Domain Amplification, but had not yet reached the level of Top-tier Divine Spirit.
Regardless, it dared block the path of this many Divine Spirits.
This sight left the Divine Spirits and even True Gods on the field puzzled.
One Top-tier Divine Spirit of the Black Dragon Elephant Race wondered, "Is that...
Samoyed?"
"Its aura seems to be that of a High-tier Divine Spirit, it looks like the breakthrough was real."
"Does this guy intend to block us alone?"
At this moment, Samoyed gave them a provocative smile, "Divine Spirits, do you want to experience the big drill of my Blade Armor Demon Race?
I guarantee it will make you want to die for pleasure!"
"And male Divine Spirits, stay back, I’m not into that."
The Divine Spirits opposite had bizarre expressions; they had lived for thousands or even tens of thousands of years.
Of course, they wouldn’t be provoked easily by Samoyed’s simple taunt.
A High-tier Divine Spirit of the Purgatory Fire Deer Race asked, "Moya, are you okay?"
"By the looks of it, you’re planning to help this legendary human block us?"
"What did he offer you, making you so willing to fight?"
Samoyed sneered, "You’re overthinking, I, Samoyed, will not be swayed by any benefit.
I just don’t want you guys to interrupt my master’s breakthrough, that’s all."
Upon hearing this, the group of Divine Spirits had even more bizarre expressions.
"Moya, are you mistaken, that Legendary Level ant is your master?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1031 - 517: Bombarding the Gods!
paragraphs: Samoyed immediately shouted angrily: "Shut up! If you dare to speak disrespectfully to the master again, I will make sure you have no place to bury your body!"
Seeing Moya’s intense reaction, the divine spirits were puzzled,
but they understood one thing.
Moya had really acknowledged this legendary level human as her master.
"Pffft..."
It’s unclear which divine spirit first laughed, but soon all the other spirits burst into laughter.
Faced with their mockery, Samoyed remained unfazed.
"Laugh all you want, you fools. You have no idea how great my master truly is!"
Upon hearing this, the spirits laughed even harder.
"Hahahaha! My master... so great... talking about a legend being great, it’s killing me with laughter!"
"Has Moya suffered some shock, or has she gone insane?"
"I think that’s very possible."
The spirits all agreed.
And right at this moment, a high-tier divine spirit from the Fire-winged Cat Race asked, "Come on, Moya, tell us, what’s so great about this human kid?"
Samoyed glanced at him, "Blind fools!"
"Do you think an ordinary legend would warrant action from a high-tier divine spirit like me?"
"Or do you really think a legend could command the two true gods over there?"
The spirits gradually ceased their laughter upon hearing this.
Because what Samoyed said was indeed true.
Originally, they thought the True God of Yellow Sand and his arrival meant the battle was over.
Yet now, all six true gods were actually held back, which was indeed strange.
According to the True God of Yellow Sand, at least two true gods were aiding this human’s breakthrough.
How could an ordinary human possess such great energy?
"Samoyed, what do you mean?"
Samoyed chuckled lightly, "What do I mean?
"Obviously, including myself, the True God of Radiance and the Painful Empress are the master’s most genuine guardians!"
Upon hearing this, the divine spirits’ faces instantly showed shock.
They did not doubt the truth of Samoyed’s words.
The reality before them had already proven everything.
What they did not expect was that besides Samoyed, those two true gods also recognized this human as their master!
How terrifying must one’s ability be to achieve all of this at the legendary realm?
Watching their stunned expressions, Samoyed said proudly, "Now you see why I say the master is the greatest existence in the entire Void, right?"
"After I pledged allegiance to the master, in just less than ten days, I broke through from middle-tier divine spirit to high-tier divine spirit."
"And the Painful Empress also broke through from top-tier divine spirit to true god!"
"All of this is evident to everyone!"
"If you guys are willing to pledge allegiance to the master, you can achieve like me and gain countless opportunities!"
"In the future, whether top-tier divine spirit or true god realm, they will no longer be a mere wish!"
Samoyed praised Han Xing to the skies.
However, the spirits remained a bit skeptical.
"Samoyed, is this legendary human really that amazing?"
"If he can help people achieve true god, why is he still just a legend?"
Samoyed sneered, "You fools can never understand the greatness of the master!"
"The master has not broken through yet because he is accomplishing an unprecedented feat!"
"Once the master succeeds, there will be no existence in the entire Void that can compare to him!"
At this moment, some of the divine spirits began to waver.
After all, the allure of being a true god was excessively great.
Even high-tier divine spirits, top-tier divine spirits face the risk of dying.
Only by becoming a true god can one truly achieve immortality!
Among them, a spirit from the Fire-winged Cat Race asked again, "Moya, is this true? If I pledge allegiance to him, can he help me breakthrough to true god?"
As soon as this was said, most spirits on the scene looked at Samoyed with a hopeful expression.
Samoyed did not answer directly.
"Don’t you guys understand? Even the power of rules is sending you messages to kill the master!"
"What does that tell you?"
"It tells you the rules fear him!"
"And tell me, since your birth, have you ever heard of any existence that the rules fear?"
"Even those high-tier true gods, emperor-level existences, or those above emperor-level, cannot provoke fear in the rules!"
"So, consider this—"
Samoyed’s words struck the point!
You should know that even the Hunter or Demon Emperor did not cause such a situation when they broke the rules.
The rules transmitting their will, forcing the spirits to take action to obliterate a certain existence.
This might be the first time in the Void’s history.
They looked at each other in bewilderment.
And just at this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand who had been using divine power to monitor this side shouted angrily: "Don’t listen to the deceitful words of Samoyed."
"You must know, this is the will directly descended upon us by the power of rules!"
"If we defy the power of rules at this time, we might be punished by the rules."
"These few have somehow escaped the rule’s punishment, but if you dare to betray the rules, you will definitely face severe consequences!"
The gods also realized this point.
A top-tier True God from the Buena Sea Monster Race said, "Samoyed, indeed you speak reasonably."
"However, this kid is ultimately just a legend."
"A dead legend, no matter how great the future achievements, is still just that."

chapters.title: Chapter 1032 - 517: Bombarding the Gods! (Part 2)
paragraphs: "We can never betray the Rules because of the empty promises you draw."
"Everyone, charge!"
With those words, dozens of Divine Spirits rushed simultaneously towards Samoyed.
Samoyed snorted coldly, "You audacious fools who dare to offend the master, today I’ll show you my might!"
"Taste my Heaven-Piercing!"
In an instant, Samoyed’s body began spinning rapidly, transforming into a black spinning top.
A terrifying whirlpool of Divine Power appeared, seemingly sweeping the surrounding Void.
Those Divine Spirits narrowed their eyes instantly, even preparing for defense.
But at that moment, Samoyed suddenly spun his body and then fled swiftly backwards.
They all realized at that moment, it seemed they had been played by Samoyed.
"Damn it! This guy’s trying to escape!"
"Catch him!"
A group of High-tier and Top-tier Divine Spirits charged madly at Samoyed.
Samoyed, fleeing while laughing madly, said, "A bunch of idiots!"
"I’m just a High-tier Divine Spirit. I’d have to be out of my mind to fight you head-on!"
"Hahaha!"
Listening to Samoyed’s mocking laughter made that group of Divine Spirits quite embarrassed.
They chased madly after Samoyed,
yet Samoyed, seemingly insane, continuously kept the Heaven-Piercing form, moving at high speed.
And he led this group of High-tier and Top-tier Divine Spirits in circles crazily.
Meanwhile, the True God of Yellow Sand, who was resisting the True God of Radiance’s attack, saw this scene and urged, "What are you guys doing?"
"Forget Moya, kill that human!"
Upon hearing the reminder from the True God of Yellow Sand, the group of Divine Spirits reacted.
"Damn it, we’ve been played by Moya!"
"Ignore him, let’s go kill the human!"
They immediately stopped chasing Samoyed and turned towards the Sky Island below.
And at this moment, a voice rang out by the True God of Yellow Sand’s ear.
"Yellow Sand, you should worry about yourself instead."
A Light Spear from the True God of Radiance suddenly burst forth!
Poof!
The body of the True God of Yellow Sand was instantly pierced through.
That Light Spear exploded, causing the Void to tremble frantically.
His injuries became even more severe.
Just as the True God of Radiance was preparing to go all-in and directly destroy the True God of Yellow Sand’s essence, putting him into a sleep state,
another attack from four True Gods came at him.
The combined strike of four True Gods, even the True God of Radiance dared not take head-on.
Now it was a five-on-two situation.
Re-entered a stalemate.
And that group of Divine Spirits rushed towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was!
The closer they got, the more they felt the Power of Rules kept transmitting intent.
"Quickly kill that kid!"
"Kill him, and you will be richly rewarded."
This was the thought transmitted by the Power of Rules in their minds.
All the Divine Spirits’ eyes gradually became slightly unfocused.
They seemed to be influenced by the Power of Rules.
With only one thought remaining in their hearts, and that was to kill Han Xing!
Two million kilometers!
One million kilometers!
Eight hundred thousand kilometers!
At the next moment, they were only half a million kilometers away from the black Sky Island.
This was the attack range for most Divine Level beings.
As Divine Spirits, they had a natural intuition for danger.
That black Sky Island gave them a sense of fatal crisis.
So, out of caution, these Divine Spirits did not recklessly approach Han Xing.
And at this moment, the Power of Rules kept urging them to hasten to kill the boy destroying the Rules.
Among them, a top-tier Divine Spirit from the Scarlet Witch clan shouted loudly, "Go all out! Destroy that human and this bizarre Sky Island together!
Upon hearing this, the other Divine Spirits realized something.
Although they sensed deadly danger from the Sky Island,
as long as they didn’t get close to the Sky Island, they could blow up that Sky Island and the human together from tens of thousands of kilometers away.
No matter what methods were hidden on that Sky Island, it couldn’t deal with them.
With those words, dozens of Divine Spirits struck simultaneously.
Their attack was like a violent tsunami, with wave after wave of energy sweeping through the Void!
Crash!
The combined strike of dozens of Divine Spirits was comparable to the attack power of two True Gods.
The Void surrounding the Sky Island quickly fell into a state of temporal and spatial distortion.
At this time, even True Gods could not save Han Xing.
Everyone tensely watched this scene, watching the Divine Spirits’ attack engulf the Sky Island.
However, normally, the attack that would have arrived instantly now seemed endlessly prolonged.
The scale of time was stretched infinitely.
And right at that moment.
The black Sky Island suddenly changed color in the blink of an eye.
An aura of sanctity covered the entire Sky Island.
At the same time, thousands of High-tier Defense Towers on the Sky Island moved their cannon muzzles.
"Boom!"
A total of eight thousand High-tier Defense Towers.
Enhanced by the addition of two Sun Crown Steles, reaching the power to severely wound True Gods.
And now, further enhanced by the Infinite Domain.
The strength of this wave of attacks reached the level capable of making True Gods perish!
So many Divine Spirits on the scene, including the True Gods, witnessed a sudden dazzling white light before their eyes.
Thousands of Energy Shells, Silent Annihilation Lightning, and Withered Snowflakes all appeared.
Within the Divine Demon Battleship, Cheng Jianyong, who was controlling the Sky Island’s attacks, showed a grim expression on his face.
"Die, all of you!"
