chapters.title: Chapter 1033 - 517: Bombarding the Gods! (3)
paragraphs: "Buzz!"
The attack hadn’t truly arrived yet.
Yet an energy fluctuation comparable to the True God of Radiance using the move "Radiant Ten Thousand Me" had already appeared.
Fear appeared in the eyes of all the divine spirits.
They didn’t even have time to think.
Because the attack came too fast.
"Quick... escape..."
Then, on the field, only a few top-tier divine spirits reacted.
The other high-tier divine spirits seemed to be fixed in place by a terrifying power.
They could only watch, eyes wide open, as space collapsed inch by inch and then enveloped them!
Crack! Crack!
At this moment, the True God of Yellow Sand, who had been observing the battle, had a horrified expression in his eyes.
He hadn’t expected such a horrifying attack from that Sky Island!
Far beyond their previous battle.
"Damn, how is it possible? It has only been a few days, and this human has already built so many terrifying energy cannons?"
The True God of Yellow Sand was incredulous.
He had a premonition that if the wave of attacks hit.
Then most of the divine spirits from Silent City would be dead or wounded!
This is an unimaginable loss!
The reaction speed of True God Level is terrifyingly fast.
Though it seemed long, less than 0.0001 milliseconds had actually passed.
And in this very short time, the True God of Yellow Sand made the most correct judgment.
In the next moment, he gritted his teeth, and a spatial rift appeared out of nowhere.
He then took the risk of enduring a strike from the True God of Radiance, and threw the True God of Moon Shadow into the spatial rift.
At the next moment.
The figure of the True God of Moon Shadow suddenly appeared in front of those divine spirits, immediately bearing the concentrated attack from Han Xingkong Island.
The energy shells that can cause the fall of True Gods contacted the body of the True God of Moon Shadow.
Her body was instantly covered with dense cracks.
And at that moment, the True God of Moon Shadow appeared to be provoked somehow.
Her body rapidly expanded.
In the blink of an eye, it became a black and gold-striped bee exceeding tens of millions of kilometers in height, with its abdomen covered in dense wings!
This was the true form of the True God of Moon Shadow.
All of this happened in an extremely brief span of time.
From dozens of divine spirits launching an attack to Cheng Jianyong using the Sky Island’s energy cannon to counterattack.
Then to the True God of Yellow Sand tossing over the True God of Moon Shadow as a shield.
Altogether, less than half a second had passed.
The rapid change in the situation exceeded everyone’s expectations.
Those divine spirits who initially thought they were doomed suddenly had a glimmer of hope for survival.
Most of the energy cannons on the Sky Island and Catastrophe Level attacks were blocked by the body of the True God of Moon Shadow.
But some of it still spread out.
Crack! Crack!
This was the largest and most terrifying strike ever launched by Han Xing and others.
Buzz!
The violent energy storm swept through a radius of tens of millions of kilometers, devouring all the divine beings.
Terrifying vibrations lasted nearly three to four seconds.
"Crack! Crack!"
"Boom!"
A series of scalp-numbing explosion sounds appeared.
Above, dozens of extremely thick glowing nerve networks appeared, all covered in dense cracks.
When all disturbances settled.
More than thirty figures with terror on their faces rushed out from the energy storm.
Then, these divine spirits stared blankly at the Sky Island.
Around the Sky Island.
Space had completely collapsed over an area of at least a million kilometers.
On the field, only the massive form of the True God of Moon Shadow remained.
As for the other divine beings who did not escape, not even a trace could be seen.
Their outcome was self-evident.
Even more terrifying was that even the large bee body of the True God of Moon Shadow, at this moment, was also covered in dense cracks.
Crack! Crack!
The True God of Moon Shadow’s body retreated several million kilometers.
Her brows furrowed tightly.
However, eerily, despite enduring such a terrifying attack, the True God of Moon Shadow still did not awaken.
As if she had completely fallen into a state of slumber.
The bizarre methods of the Painful Empress once again refreshed the cognition of all the strong ones on the field.
However, what shocked everyone even more was the firepower of that Sky Island.
In just one strike, at least a dozen high-tier divine spirits fell!
Everyone looked up, seeing cracks in over ten glowing nerve networks in the sky.
Among them, there were even two extremely thick nerve networks.
That belonged to the Power of Rules of top-tier divine spirits!
One attack wave.
Took away twelve high-tier divine spirits, plus two top-tier divine spirits!
Those divine spirits who luckily survived had bewilderment in their eyes.
The scene before them was beyond their imagination.
At this moment, someone suddenly said, "The sky is falling..."
In the next moment.
The ten-plus nerve networks exploded instantly.
Simultaneously, the death of fourteen powerful divine spirits scattered infinite blood energy, dyeing the violent energy in this void blood-red.
And this blood energy continued to spread rapidly, even turning the waters of the Forbidden Star River red.
A true river of blood!
Silent City ushered an unprecedented spectacle on this day!
In the state of breakthrough, Han Xing also had a strong expression of delight in his eyes.
Because he heard eighteen system notifications!
[Successfully killed Blood Soul Illusion Fish Race: Sillilo (High-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Due to your excellent performance in this battle, an extra 10 layers of World Willpower are rewarded.]
[Note: Kills by Defense Tower do not yield Experience Value, Divine Power Value, or Legendary Points rewards.]
[Successfully killed Bone-eating Scorpion Lion Race: Hilbert (High-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Due to your excellent performance in this battle, an extra 10 layers of World Willpower are rewarded.]
[Successfully killed Count Greed: Nagati (Top-tier Divine Spirit Level)]
[Due to your excellent performance in this battle: an extra 20 layers of World Willpower are rewarded.]
After a series of system notifications, Han Xing’s World Willpower directly increased by 200 layers!

chapters.title: Chapter 1034 - 518: The Terrifying Painful Empress
paragraphs: Counting the previous kill of Zigu which earned 50 layers, Han Xing now has 250 layers of World Will.
It’s already enough for him to construct two more Celestial Rail Strike Devices.
Han Xing felt a surge of joy in his heart.
He didn’t expect that using Defense Towers to blast this group of high-tier divine spirits and top-tier divine spirits would also yield World Will.
Though it wasn’t as much as if he killed them with his own hands, it was still extremely satisfying!
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong’s wild laughter echoed.
"Hahaha! This kind of firepower suppression is so damn thrilling!"
"Directly crossing several levels to obliterate this group of high-tier divine spirits and top-tier divine spirits!"
"If Defense Tower kills gave experience, I would have soared straight to Level 70 by now!"
The divine spirits, hearing the laughter, simultaneously fixed their gaze on that divine demon battleship.
"Over there!"
"It’s this human kid who attacked us!"
"I sensed it, there are only some demigods and legends in there."
Upon hearing this, anger flickered in the eyes of the divine spirits.
Because, against these demigods and legendary level ants, they had suffered a great loss!
"Damn it! Let’s go over and kill him!"
As soon as the words fell, several divine spirits attempted to rush forward.
But Cheng Jianyong smirked coldly, "Come on, let me see who still wants to find death!"
Buzz!
On that Sky Island, including all Defense Towers on the divine demon battleship, activated simultaneously.
And aimed at those few high-tier divine spirits ready to charge.
They instantly felt their scalps tingle and began retreating quickly!
You must be kidding!
Having already witnessed the horror of those Energy Towers, if it weren’t for the True God of Moon Shadow’s main body blocking most of the energy cannon’s bombardment just now.
In that just past wave, at least half of these divine spirits would have fallen!
Watching this group of divine spirits avoid like snakes and scorpions, not daring to get close.
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily.
"Hahaha! Everyone behave!"
"Stay put and I won’t bombard you. Anyone who dares come close, I’ll blast them directly!"
Cheng Jianyong threatened.
The scene was like a child holding a machine gun, threatening a group of vicious bandits.
Although it was an immature threat, it was indeed very effective.
The divine spirits actually stayed put, not daring to approach.
The situation fell into a temporary stalemate.
And just at that moment, near Han Xingkong Island.
Above the head, fourteen energy conduits, due to losing their controller, began to quickly crack.
Then, all fourteen nerve networks collapsed.
Meanwhile, on the field, the divine spirits’ eyes expressed a heart-moved look.
After all, those were the rules of fourteen high-tier divine spirits.
Including two rules of top-tier divine spirits.
Just those things alone could allow two top-tier divine spirits to have the qualification to break through into true gods!
Among them, a few high-tier divine spirits boasting impressive movement speed transformed instantly into glowing streams rushing over.
Although aware of the terror of that Sky Island.
Yet for the breakthrough to true god, they decided to gamble.
And it was at this moment.
On that Sky Island, a quarter of the energy cannons launched an attack.
The terrifying energy pillars instantly reached those high-tier divine spirits’ faces.
In their fearful gazes, they were directly engulfed by this energy pillar.
After a desperate shout, intense energy waves emerged.
Meanwhile.
In the sky, the shattered rule conduits increased from fourteen to eighteen.
This nearly made those high-tier divine spirits on the field rejoice while feeling profoundly fearful!
Yet another fall of four high-tier divine spirits.
Made them thoroughly understand that Sky Island’s terrors!
That was truly a force capable of obliterating true gods!
At this point, despite the constant urging of the Power of Rules, those divine spirits dared not get closer.
And Cheng Jianyong leisurely maneuvered the divine demon battleship to approach.
Meanwhile.
Above the head, the eighteen nerve conduits, already shattered, transformed into thousands of light dots and descended.
These light dots are the Divine Formats.
The next moment, Cheng Jianyong, wielding a war axe, appeared within the Void.
At the moment of his appearance, all divine spirits fixed their gaze on him.
They seemed to realize it was this human manipulating those energy cannons, annihilating a full eighteen divine spirits!
Their hearts boiled with killing intent!
Cheng Jianyong naturally sensed their murderous intent, but he didn’t mind, and instead looked leisurely at that group of divine spirits, lightly chuckled, "Does anyone want to kill me?"
"I have no true god protection by my side, with your top-tier divine spirits’ movement speed, absolutely you can slay me before I attack."
"Is there any divine spirit willing to try?"
The divine spirits on the field glanced at each other, then fell into silence.
Seeing no response, Cheng Jianyong chuckled.
Then, he leisurely walked over and collected all those Divine Formats.
And recombined them into eighteen complete rules.
This scene, not only made the top-tier divine spirits envy, but also the True God of Yellow Sand along with four other true gods next to him showed a coveting look.
All eighteen rules!
If absorbed by one initial-tier true god, it might even let him advance to middle-tier true god.
However now, these precious Power of Rules all got controlled by a demigod level human kid.
And more irritatingly, Cheng Jianyong didn’t even stash away these Power of Rules.
Intead, he shrank them down and floated them in front of his chest to show off.
"Tsk, tsk! Sixteen rules of high-tier divine spirits, two rules of top-tier divine spirits, this is indeed an incredible haul X."

chapters.title: Chapter 1035 - 518: The Terrifying Painful Empress (Part 2)
paragraphs: "If someone can kill me, breaking through to True God wouldn’t be just a dream!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, occasionally glancing at the remaining thirty or so Divine Spirits.
"Doesn’t anyone want to kill me?"
"If you miss this opportunity, it will be difficult to kill me later!"
Cheng Jianyong kept tempting, intending to lure all these Divine Spirits over and eliminate them.
However, the Divine Spirits in the field were not fools.
Having suffered twice already, they would certainly not fall for it again.
They all stood their ground.
Cheng Jianyong shook his head regretfully seeing they weren’t taking the bait.
Then, he withdrew all those threads of Rules.
Both sides were directly stuck in a stalemate.
Time slowly slipped away.
The human breaking through seemed increasingly ethereal, as if he were about to completely vanish from this world.
The Power of Rules kept urging.
True God of Yellow Sand showed an anxious expression.
And at this moment, True God of Moon Shadow, whose body was blown into dense cracks, was trembling violently, seemingly awakening from that controlled state.
Seeing this, True God of Yellow Sand’s eyes lit up.
He bellowed, "Moon Shadow, wake up!!!"
"Wake up!!"
True God of Yellow Sand’s voice echoed through the Void like a bell from the Desert Temple.
At the same time, True God of Moon Shadow, who had been controlled for over ten minutes, finally opened her eyes!
Upon awakening, her eyes showed various complex emotions.
Then, she also saw her severely wounded body.
Her injuries were such that she couldn’t instantly recover.
True God of Moon Shadow appeared confused.
She didn’t know what had happened during her controlled time.
She only knew she was enraged by Painful Empress and fell into her trap.
In the Illusion Realm, True God of Moon Shadow seemed to have passed millennia; thinking about the experiences there made her both ashamed and angry!
Painful Empress had turned her into a prostitute of myriad worlds, serving males or genderless beings of different races and fetishes daily.
And she wasn’t even given time to rest, constantly in a state filled with desire.
Even though True God of Moon Shadow realized it was a false world.
The relentless assaults made her succumb endlessly.
At this moment, Painful Empress’s meaningful laughter echoed.
"Moon Shadow, how does it feel to wallow in desire?"
"Isn’t it your first time experiencing the joys of being a woman?"
Hearing Painful Empress’s voice, True God of Moon Shadow felt a rush of Anger.
"Ma! De! Lai! Na!"
She nearly ground the words out, "I’m going to tear you to pieces!"
True God of Moon Shadow stormed forward almost madly.
At this moment, True God of Yellow Sand’s angry voice came, "Moon Shadow! Don’t come to this battlefield, go kill that human!"
But at this time, True God of Moon Shadow was filled with anger, completely ignoring True God of Yellow Sand’s words.
True God of Yellow Sand scolded, "Moon Shadow! You fool! Do you want to fall into Painful Empress’s tricks again?"
"If that’s all you can do, death is what you deserve!"
Hearing the scolding, True God of Moon Shadow abruptly stopped.
She seemed to understand something, her eyes gradually clearing.
"Interesting, so that’s your goal, is it? Madeleine."
"You want to lure me over to buy time for that human breaking through, don’t you?"
Hearing this, Painful Empress didn’t reply.
Because what True God of Moon Shadow said was true.
Seeing this, True God of Moon Shadow sneered, "So it seems I was right, Madeleine, your plan has failed!"
"Thank you for the reminder, Yellow Sand."
"I will kill this human immediately!"
Upon finishing her words, True God of Moon Shadow turned and rushed toward the Sky Island behind her.
True God of Yellow Sand’s voice came again, "Moon Shadow, be careful of the energy cannons on that Sky Island, those shells can bring down a True God!"
"Yellow Sand! Are you really eager to die fast?"
True God of Radiance’s voice brimmed with killing intent.
Painful Empress’s voice followed, "Moon Shadow, aren’t you coming to deal with me?"
"I’m waiting for you to show me what you’ve got~"
However, the more True God of Radiance and Painful Empress reacted this way, the more determined True God of Moon Shadow became to kill Han Xing immediately.
She sneered, "I get it, Yellow Sand, an energy cannon capable of bringing down a True God, is that right? Indeed impressive."
"But, as long as I don’t get close, what can it do to me?"
True God of Moon Shadow regained composure, her logic became exceptionally clear.
She knew well her advantage.
That’s the terrifying attack range exclusive to True Gods.
Capable of wiping out enemies across millions of kilometers.
In the next moment, under the gaze of the dozens of Divine Spirits present, as well as Cheng Jianyong and others.
True God of Moon Shadow suddenly straightened her tail, and from it, a large needle-like spike shot forth.
This spike contained a terrifying Piercing Law, already more destructive than the Beast’s Tail Spike.
Approaching it induced a stinging sensation all over to those present.
This is a full-force attack of True God Level.
Even if the Defense Towers above unleashed a salvo, they would likely be pierced by this spike.
Because it had condensed all Divine Power into a single point.
Unlike Han Xing, who only relied on brute force when using these Sky Islands.

paragraphs: The attack by the True God of Moon Shadow is clearly more deadly and threatening.
And at this moment.
A stream of light suddenly shot from the divine demon battleship.
This stream distorted time, space.
Carrying a fluctuation not less than the tail spike of the True God of Moon Shadow, it instantly made contact.
This is an attack launched by the [Celestial Rail Strike Device].
After enhancement by two Sun Crown Steles and the Infinite Domain.
The Celestial Rail Strike Device has undergone a terrifying transformation.
In the bewildered gazes of many divine spirits present, including the True God of Moon Shadow, the two forces began to entangle madly, canceling each other out!
Although the tail spike of the True God of Moon Shadow still held the upper hand, making the energy beam retreat in defeat step by step.
However, the attack from the Celestial Rail Strike Device was cylindrical.
It could continuously counteract this tail spike and weaken the piercing law contained within.
Buzz!
Space collapsed inch by inch.
When still several thousand kilometers away from Han Xing’s Sky Island,
that tail spike seemed to have exhausted all its energy, weakly falling into the Endless Void.
Seeing this scene, an expression of disbelief appeared in everyone’s eyes.
"It was...an attack comparable to a Middle-tier True God."
"They actually have such terrifying technology weapons!"
The Celestial Rail Strike Device, as Han Xing’s hidden card, had not been used just now.
If it had been used together with the Celestial Rail Strike Device earlier, more divine spirits would have perished.
The divine spirits present felt a sense of fear in their hearts.
While also feeling some relief.
Relieved that the True God of Moon Shadow had sobered up and forced them to reveal such a horrific weapon!
At this moment, the True God of Moon Shadow was also somewhat shocked, "Interesting...a True God-level energy cannon?"
"I have ventured through so many Great Worlds and have not seen such powerful technology, it seems you carry many secrets!"
"However, energy cannons like these all have cooldown times."
"And how will you resist my upcoming attack?"
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and others felt a bit heavy-hearted.
This is the gap between energy weapons and the True God level.
Although their attack reached the Middle-tier True God level.
However, all these defense towers have extremely long charging times.
Even with the cooldown reduction from the Sun Crown Stele, it would still take several seconds, even tens of seconds to recharge.
And this time is enough for a True God to launch tens of thousands of attacks!
The True God of Moon Shadow opposite had a victorious smile in her eyes.
She looked toward the Painful Empress battling the True God of Yellow Sand in the distance.
"Madeleine, watch me carefully!"
"I’ll kill these humans first, then come to kill you!"
With these words, the True God of Moon Shadow prepared to attack again.
At this time, Cheng Jianyong glanced at Han Xing in the distance, and with his indication.
In the next moment, he directly took Shen Yun and used the teleportation function of the [Oracle Throne], appearing in the void.
Seeing Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun suddenly block their way.
The eyes of the True God of Moon Shadow showed slight surprise, but soon, she transformed this surprise into murderous intent.
"Ants! Do you think you can stop me?"
The True God of Moon Shadow launched an attack without hesitation!
A strike not inferior to the previous tail spike shot out instantly.
At this moment, time seemed to freeze.
All the divine spirits, watching Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun with a look as if seeing dead bodies.
Facing a True God-level attack, these two little ones, it’s inevitable they would die!
And at this moment, a dazzling green light suddenly appeared in Cheng Jianyong’s hand.
That green light carried a strong fluctuation belonging to a Holy Artifact’s aura.
Moreover, more terrifying, the moment this green light appeared.
The True God of Moon Shadow was already surrounded by countless vines.
"A Holy Artifact...an aura that reaches the Holy Artifact Level!"
The True God of Moon Shadow’s eyes showed a look of shock.
And the True God of Yellow Sand in the distance had already experienced the horror of this thing.
His voice was nearly pained and warning loudly: "Moon Shadow, run away!!!"
However, engulfed by [Endless Entanglement], even a True God cannot break free.
Previously dealing with the True God of Yellow Sand, this point had already been confirmed.
Cheng Jianyong’s mouth curled into a smirk.
"Ugly woman, die!"
Then, Shen Yun on that side again used [Oracle Throne], instantly teleporting back to the divine demon battleship.
In the terrified gaze of the True God of Moon Shadow.
She saw from that Sky Island and the battleship, at least nine thousand High-tier Energy Cannons all fired over!
Before approaching, she already felt a wave of fear!
She had a premonition that this strike, even if unable to blast her to her fall, could directly shatter her essence, then let her sleep for several months!
Buzz!
This was an even more terrifying attack than the previous bombardment.
The True God of Moon Shadow could almost only watch helplessly as those terrifying energy cannons devoured her.
Her body, already filled with cracks, shattered inch by inch at this moment.
Splat!
A massive burst of blood exploded!
This belonged to the essence of the True God.
The energy throughout the void, from its original blood red, completely turned into deep red.
The Forbidden Star River began to shake furiously, as if it were raising stormy waves.
The shaking even spread to Silent City, expanding into the depths of the Forbidden Star River!
Silent City descended into chaos!
Those hidden existences turned pale, trembling in fear!
They were very relieved that fortunately, they did not obey the will of the Rules to go kill that human.
Otherwise, they might also fall along.
In the Forbidden Star River, those terrifying existences were also awakened.
They opened their eyes one after another, observing the galaxies beyond with a gaze that could see through everything.
Several True Gods suddenly spoke solemnly: "Something happened outside, numerous Rules collapsed, even a True God was blasted into slumber!"
"Sure enough, there was an accident on Yellow Sand’s side!"
"All True Gods, wake up quickly!"
One after another, ancient True Gods awoke from their slumber state.
"Sea Emperor, Nether Emperor, Spirit Emperor, something happened!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1037 - 519: True Gods Emerging from the Forbidden Star River
paragraphs: At this moment, in the depths of the Forbidden Star River, three towering figures emerged.
An ancient voice, as if from the Barbaric Wilderness, spoke, "We are already aware that an unexpected incident occurred with the True God of Yellow Sand. This was anticipated, so do not panic."
Upon hearing these words, the awakened True Gods turned their attention.
"Nether Emperor, what do you mean?"
The ancient voice calmly explained, "For tens of thousands of years, those entities that break the rules often accompany great fortune."
"Though they appear weak, they often possess unimaginable powerful methods."
"Moreover, this time, this little fellow whom we have never met is doing something even more astonishing; even the rules have warned me, we must eliminate this person."
"I speculate that this little fellow might not only be breaking the rules, he is doing something even more terrifying, something perhaps no one has ever accomplished."
"Thus, such entities are the hardest to eliminate; with the power of the Silent City, it’s expected that we cannot deal with this little fellow."
After hearing the Nether Emperor’s explanation, the surrounding True Gods fell silent, seemingly contemplating.
An equally ancient voice asked, "Nether Emperor, as you said, this entity breaking the rules has already raised the vigilance of the rules."
"And we are the most ancient Rule Masters, destined to be enemies of this entity."
"Since the Silent City cannot deal with him, do any of you have other plans?"
The Forbidden Star River was enveloped in a moment of silence again, as if awaiting the response of those emperors.
The Nether Emperor said calmly, "Certainly, we already have a solution."
"To deal with such entities, we must deploy overwhelming power in one strike, resolving it in a thunderous manner."
"Otherwise, leaving any room will give such entities an opportunity for reversal."
"Therefore, we have decided to unite with the Sea Emperor and Nether Emperor, together sending a batch of True Gods out to decisively eliminate this powerful one!"
Upon hearing this, the True Gods were instantly shocked, questioning incredulously.
"Nether Emperor! Are you saying it’s true?"
"Can we really be sent out from the Forbidden Star River, back into the Void?"
They have been trapped here for too long, each eagerly wanting to escape from the Forbidden Star River!
Yet despite so many years, no True God has been able to walk out alive from the Forbidden Star River!
Not even those emperors, and beyond!
Thus, the words of the Nether Emperor excited them so much.
The voice of the Nether Emperor appeared once more.
"Of course, this time it is the rules that aided us, causing a slight loosening in the Sealing Power of the Forbidden Star River."
"If it were in the past, we couldn’t achieve this."
"Moreover, due to slight loosening, the strength of those who can go out is limited, only those up to Middle-tier True God Level, and there are only five slots."
"Additionally, once you go out, you must immediately fulfill the promise of the rules and eliminate the entity disturbing the rules."
"Otherwise you will face the punishment of the rules."
"Now, who wants to go out, just sign up."
Once the Nether Emperor’s words fell, a large group of True Gods signed up.
"Me! Let me go out! I’m already going mad stuck here!"
"And me! I’m the True God of Judgment, about to break through to the High-tier True God level!"
Those who could speak at least had the strength of a Middle-tier True God.
And because they are ancient True Gods, their combat power was more terrifying than that of the True God of Yellow Sand.
Each reached at least the level of the True God of Moon Shadow.
Amidst the voices of applications.
Three ancient auras had already chosen the slots.
"Very well, then this time, allow Judgment, Crystal, Storm, Night Demon, Mount Qun to go out first."
"The rules have conveyed to us that if this time we can eliminate the one disturbing the Void, we might be granted more slots."
"If the number of True Gods going out is sufficient, we might take down the Land of the Abandoned Gods in one sweep and prematurely start the Era of Extinct Gods!"
"Then we all can leave this hellish place!"
Upon hearing the Nether Emperor’s words, the gods became even more excited.
Meanwhile, the five selected True Gods sensed a glowing tendril appearing above their heads.
This tendril connected to their bodies, seemingly intending to absorb them.
The five True Gods did not resist, allowing this Power of Rules to devour their bodies.
In the next moment, the figures of the five True Gods vanished from the original place.
Simultaneously.
The area where Han Xing was located.
When the gods saw the True God of Moon Shadow’s body explode and sink into the rules, a chill rose behind every Divine Spirit.
When the energy fluctuations subsided.
Cheng Jianyong reappeared in the Void.
He arrogantly shouted, "Anyone else!?"
The voice echoed tens of thousands of kilometers.
The Divine Spirits exchanged looks.
Now, they dared not rush to attack.
Previously, the deaths of a dozen Divine Spirits, alongside the destruction of a True God, had already made them realize.
With their strength, they could no longer deal with this group of humans.
For a moment, the gods remained in place.
At this point, the power of the Silent City had been thoroughly suppressed.
The True God of Yellow Sand and four other True Gods were held back by Radiance and Madeleine.
Other high-tier Divine Spirits no longer dared make rash moves.
As long as the situation stabilizes, they will inevitably last until the end!

chapters.title: Chapter 1038 - 519: True Gods Emerging from the Forbidden Star River (Part 2)
paragraphs: Han Xing seemed to be on the verge of victory.
Time slowly passed.
Another five minutes went by.
Up until now, since Han Xing’s breakthrough, about an hour has passed.
And the progress bar in front of Han Xing had reached 62%.
"Almost there, just hang on for 40 more minutes!"
Han Xing’s heart was filled with excitement.
And just at this moment.
He suddenly saw five red threads appear instantly on himself.
These threads were rapidly approaching him from the same direction.
And what’s more terrifying, these threads were incredibly thick, none weaker than those of the True God of Yellow Sand.
"Middle-tier True Gods? So many?"
Han Xing felt a chill on his scalp and quickly warned, "Radiance, Cheng Jianyong!"
"Prepare yourselves, five True Gods are coming, at least at middle-tier True God level!"
"True Gods, where did so many True Gods come from?"
Upon hearing this, not only Radiance and Cheng Jianyong.
Even the True God of Yellow Sand was perplexed.
Because this time, the True Gods in Silent City had basically all been deployed.
Now, where did these five True Gods suddenly come from?
However, they soon found out.
At this moment, the Forbidden Star River was trembling madly, the surface of the river stained red with blood seemed to stir up great waves.
The terrifying energy waves were constantly crashing, as if trying to prevent the existence inside from coming out.
However, this time it was the Power of Rules personally taking action.
Everyone saw, from that galaxy, several shiny tendrils suddenly emerging.
The next moment, five streams of light flashed by, quickly appearing in the void.
These streams of light landed and rapidly turned into ancient figures.
One of them took the form of the Golden Body Arhat from Buddhism, exuding a majestic presence of rules.
"I am the True God of Judgment, people see me as they would see true law!"
The second appeared as a crystal giant, completely transparent, even turning the surrounding void energy into crystal.
"I am the True God of Crystal, all crystals in this world are under my control!"
The third was a massive one-legged ape comparable in size to a star, holding a gray tornado in its hand.
"I’m the True God of Storm,"
The fourth was a giant bat, its deep eyes observing everything in the void.
"A bunch of ants, not worthy of knowing my name."
The fifth was a mountain range spanning the void, yet it had a sense of life.
"Haha, I, the True God of the Mountains, finally emerged!"
The five True Gods successively announced their names!
These were ancient True Gods that had existed for over ten thousand years!
The True God of Yellow Sand’s eyes showed a look of shock, "Judgment, Crystal, Storm, Night Demon, Mountains!"
"How did you come out?"
The five True Gods who emerged from the Forbidden Star River also looked at the True God of Yellow Sand.
The True God of Judgment snorted coldly, "Yellow Sand, you let us down."
"For so many years, we’ve supplied Silent City with so many resources, given you so many treasures, and you still can’t manage these guys."
Hearing this, the True God of Yellow Sand’s face showed a hint of helplessness.
He couldn’t really argue and had to accept the reprimand.
At this moment, the True God of Judgment was watching the True God of Radiance who was fighting against the True God of Yellow Sand.
"Interesting, the God of Radiance, are you the one who absorbed my divine format?"
The True God of Crystal agreed, "I also sensed the presence of my rules in him."
Seeing this, Han Xing twitched his lips.
Previously, to help Radiance break through to True God.
Han Xing didn’t care whose divine format was used; they all went to Radiance.
Now, these guys came for him.
But they were meant to face him anyway, so absorbing it was fine.
The True God of Radiance said nothing, focused intently on dealing with the enemies in front of him.
At this moment.
The giant bat said coldly, "Judgment, don’t waste so much time on him."
"Let’s take out that kid first, then make the God of Radiance submit!"
"If he disagrees, then just eliminate him!"
Hearing this, the True God of Judgment also expressed agreement.
The next moment.
He unleashed an endless Light of Judgment, rushing towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was, like a brilliantly dazzling new star.
And then.
Cheng Jianyong activated the attacks from all the energy towers on the Sky Island.
Buzz!
Terrifying energy waves erupted instantly.
Knowing that these guys might be stronger than the True God of Yellow Sand, Cheng Jianyong used full force from the start.
Even thousands of defense towers on the Divine Demon Battleship, plus the Celestial Rail Strike Device, were used together.
Nearly ten thousand high-tier defense towers’ intense energy fluctuations surpassed the strike that killed the True God of Moon Shadow!
Even making the True God of Judgment’s pupils contract sharply!
He had a premonition that if he directly received this blow, he might be severely injured!
Are you kidding?
He survived the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, seen countless powerful technologies in his life.
But those that could hurt him, were virtually non-existent.
The True God of Judgment shouted, "Take action, the energy cannon tower on this Sky Island has a mystery!"
With those words.
The True God of the Mountains and the True God of Crystal simultaneously took action.
In the next moment, a mountain range stretching countless miles suddenly appeared before everyone.
At the same time, the True God of Crystal waved his hand.
The mountain range instantly transformed into a crystal hue.
In addition, the True God of Judgment emanated a powerful divine power.
Three middle-tier True Gods exerted all efforts to jointly block this wave of bombardment.

At this moment, the True God of Judgment was watching the True God of Radiance who was fighting against the True God of Yellow Sand.
"Interesting, the God of Radiance, are you the one who absorbed my divine format?"
The True God of Crystal agreed, "I also sensed the presence of my rules in him."
Seeing this, Han Xing twitched his lips.
Previously, to help Radiance break through to True God.
Han Xing didn’t care whose divine format was used; they all went to Radiance.
Now, these guys came for him.
But they were meant to face him anyway, so absorbing it was fine.
The True God of Radiance said nothing, focused intently on dealing with the enemies in front of him.
At this moment.
The giant bat said coldly, "Judgment, don’t waste so much time on him."
"Let’s take out that kid first, then make the God of Radiance submit!"
"If he disagrees, then just eliminate him!"
Hearing this, the True God of Judgment also expressed agreement.
The next moment.
He unleashed an endless Light of Judgment, rushing towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was, like a brilliantly dazzling new star.
And then.
Cheng Jianyong activated the attacks from all the energy towers on the Sky Island.
Buzz!
Terrifying energy waves erupted instantly.
Knowing that these guys might be stronger than the True God of Yellow Sand, Cheng Jianyong used full force from the start.
Even thousands of defense towers on the Divine Demon Battleship, plus the Celestial Rail Strike Device, were used together.
Nearly ten thousand high-tier defense towers’ intense energy fluctuations surpassed the strike that killed the True God of Moon Shadow!
Even making the True God of Judgment’s pupils contract sharply!
He had a premonition that if he directly received this blow, he might be severely injured!
Are you kidding?
He survived the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, seen countless powerful technologies in his life.
But those that could hurt him, were virtually non-existent.
The True God of Judgment shouted, "Take action, the energy cannon tower on this Sky Island has a mystery!"
With those words.
The True God of the Mountains and the True God of Crystal simultaneously took action.
In the next moment, a mountain range stretching countless miles suddenly appeared before everyone.
At the same time, the True God of Crystal waved his hand.
The mountain range instantly transformed into a crystal hue.
In addition, the True God of Judgment emanated a powerful divine power.
Three middle-tier True Gods exerted all efforts to jointly block this wave of bombardment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1039 - 519: True God Emerging from the Forbidden Star River_3
paragraphs: "Buzz!"
That area was instantly filled with terrifying energy fluctuations.
The next moment, the three True Gods simultaneously retreated hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
Crash!
The True God of the Mountains was heavily smashed into the Void.
Then the figures of the True God of Crystal and the True God of Judgment appeared together.
Their eyes were shocked as they looked at the Sky Island, and the aura on the three True Gods’ bodies had somewhat declined.
However, they were not severely injured.
Upon witnessing this scene, Cheng Jianyong and his companions had their faces darkened.

The mountain range emitted a shocking voice, "What a terrifying technological turret! If it weren’t for the shield Crystal added and Judgment offsetting the impact, I would have been seriously injured!"
The other True Gods showed surprised expressions after hearing this.
The True God of Night Demon coldly said, "So that’s it, is this the method they’ve been using against True Gods?"
"It is indeed strong, no wonder they dare to break the rules."
"If the True God of Judgment hadn’t probed a bit, we might really have suffered a big loss today!"
The other True Gods also nodded in approval, "Indeed, they have some skills."
However, Cheng Jianyong and his companions were not pleased to hear their praise.
Because this was already their strongest attack.
Now it seems like it has been cracked by the three middle-tier True Gods working together!
At this moment, a large gap appeared on the True God of the Mountains, with strong divine power fluctuations lingering.
But as his aura oscillated, a glowing Tree of Rules appeared in the Void.
Then, a divine power fell from that Tree of Rules.
The injuries on the True God of the Mountains quickly healed accordingly.
The True God-level healing ability is really absurd.
The True God of Storm snorted coldly, "Alright, now that we know their tricks, there’s no need to delay any longer, let’s go together!"
The other True Gods also nodded.
"Alright."
"Agreed."
"Let’s finish him off."
With that, the five True Gods charged toward Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Meanwhile, Cheng Jianyong, without hesitation, launched a second wave of attacks!
Boom!
Over nine thousand turrets fired simultaneously!
Under Cheng Jianyong’s deliberate control, all the firepower of these turrets was aimed at the five True Gods.
Watching the overwhelming energy shells sweeping toward them.
Even the five True Gods felt a tingling sensation on their scalps!
The True God of Storm shouted, "Mountains, block it for us!"

However, this time the True God of the Mountains did not reveal his true form but refused, "Let’s all exert our efforts, this level of attack, even if I face it several more times, I’ll be forced into a dormant state."
Upon hearing this, the four True Gods slightly changed their expressions.
The next moment, they simultaneously released divine power, blocking those terrifying energy shells.
"Boom!!!"
This surge surpassed even the last one!
The five True Gods were blasted back again, all suffering not minor injuries, and their auras had declined a bit.
The True God of Storm angrily said, "Damn it, what an annoying attack!"
The True God of Judgment shook his head, "Alright, now all the energy cannons on that Sky Island are in charging mode,
"This time, they have no means to stop us. Let’s rush over and kill them!"
Upon hearing this, serious expressions on the other four True Gods’ faces disappeared, replaced by a hint of a smile.
The next moment, they vanished from their spot.
All four True Gods charged toward Han Xing’s Sky Island.
The True God of Night Demon, on the other hand, targeted Cheng Jianyong’s Divine Demon Battleship.
"Whoosh!"
As the True God of Night Demon attacked, it was as if the night descended.
It spread its wings, its enormous wings covering the heavens and the earth, even isolating all energy.
Cheng Jianyong and his group were faced with a large string of system prompts.
[You have been locked by the aura of the True God of Night Demon, space in this area has been sealed off, and you cannot use movement speed.]
[You have been shrouded by the aura of the True God of Night Demon. All energy in this area has been forbidden, and you cannot use skills.]
[You’ve been isolated by the aura of the True God of Night Demon...]
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong’s mind was struck by the same feeling he had at Tier Four, when facing the God of Light.
Powerlessness, insignificance, life beyond his control.
The movement speed of the True God of Night Demon was extremely fast.
Like teleportation, each flicker could leap hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
In less than a second, it was within thirty thousand kilometers of the Divine Demon Battleship!
At this moment, a sense of mortal crisis enveloped his heart.
And just then.
The Celestial Rail Strike Device, unused in the previous attack, finally completed its charging at this moment.
"Buzz!"
The Celestial Rail Strike Device burst forth with a dazzling white light.
A pillar of light of death surged and then directly blasted toward the True God of Night Demon.
The True God of Night Demon’s face drastically changed.
"Damn it! There’s more?"
At this close range, the True God of Night Demon was almost unavoidable!
It could only watch helplessly as the destructive white light pierced through its body.
Poof!
The white light completely penetrated the True God of Night Demon, and the huge bat’s body froze in the void, severely injured.
At the same time.
The four True Gods rapidly approaching Han Xing’s Sky Island, ready to wipe him out, also saw the distant scene.
"What’s going on, did Night Demon fail to slay those human kids?"
"Looks like it, Night Demon suffered a big loss too, this injury may weaken its combat power somewhat."
The True God of Judgment quickly said, "Don’t worry about it, let’s focus all our efforts on finishing the task at hand, killing this rule-breaking kid!"
"Judgment is right, focus on the task at hand, but be careful, I have a feeling this boy breaking through isn’t so simple."
The four True Gods did not underestimate.
Even when dealing with a Legend, they were extremely cautious.
While rapidly approaching, they were always on guard for any possible attacks.
Far away, the True God of Yellow Sand, watching the battle, showed a satisfied expression.
"As expected, these seasoned True Gods are reliable; as long as they make a move, no matter how powerful this human’s tricks are, he won’t be able to stir up any trouble!"
"So you are called the True God of Radiance? Today, your day of death has arrived!"

chapters.title: Chapter 1040 - 520: Battle for Breakthrough (Part 1)
paragraphs: Upon hearing the taunt of the True God of Yellow Sand, the True God of Radiance merely cast a glance at him.
Then a chain of Divine Power whipped across.
Thud!
The True God of Yellow Sand was struck by the Divine Power Chain, causing his Divine Body to tremble.
However, before he could react.
More Chains of Light appeared, illuminating the Void, then fiercely bombarded towards the True God of Yellow Sand.
"Damn it!"
The True God of Yellow Sand cursed angrily, but he had to go all out to deal with the attack from the True God of Radiance.
The True God of Radiance attacked the five True Gods on the field while looking solemnly at the battlefield over there, then quickly transmitted his thoughts to the Painful Empress beside him.
"Madeleine, I’ll leave these five True Gods to you; I’m going to rescue the master. Can you handle it?"
The Painful Empress’s expression slightly changed; she had just broken through to an Initial-tier True God.
These five True Gods, each of them had broken through for thousands, even tens of thousands of years!
For her to fight one against five was akin to seeking death.
But she still nodded, "Go ahead, Radiance. I will hold them off."
"No matter what happens..."
The allure in the Painful Empress’s eyes faded, gradually turning into a stern visage.
The True God of Radiance nodded.
He knew the Painful Empress would likely not be a match for these five True Gods.
But there was no other choice; they had no other Power now.
The next moment, the Painful Empress let out a shrill cry.
A terrifying sound wave spread through the Void, revealing all the Divine Power Spider Webs.
At the same time, from the True God of Radiance, an unprecedented aura burst forth!
The instant burst of radiance lit up the entire Void, making it difficult for all True Gods on the field to open their eyes.
Then, he directly escaped into the Rule.
Noticing the True God of Radiance’s intention, the True God of Yellow Sand shouted in shock, "Radiance is trying to leave! Stop him!
He directly revealed his true form and slammed towards the True God of Radiance.
However, the True God of Radiance paid a heavy price, leaving a Divine Power clone on the spot.
The next moment, the Painful Empress also burst forth suddenly.
"Damn it! Someone hold off the Painful Empress; I’ll chase the True God of Radiance!"
The True God of Yellow Sand shouted angrily, "Sandstorm!"
And at this moment, the Painful Empress’s Divine Power Spider Web suddenly contracted.
Enveloping all five True Gods including the True God of Yellow Sand.
"Hehe~ Yellow Sand, what’s the rush?"
"Stay and play with me a little longer?"
In that instant, layers upon layers of dense spider webs completely enveloped the true form of the True God of Yellow Sand.
Typically, nets cannot bind sand.
But under the manipulation of the Painful Empress, it seemed to break this rule.
The True God of Yellow Sand was entangled by the Divine Power Spider Web, as if he were rain caught in a fisherman’s net.
He looked at the Painful Empress with a grim face, "Madeleine, are you sure you want to face us five True Gods alone?"
Madeleine chuckled softly, "What else?"
"You’ll die." The True God of Yellow Sand stated solemnly.
"Hehe~ Everything of mine belongs to the master, if it means he can breakthrough, what of death?"
Madeleine seemed fearless.
In her heart, she had already placed Han Xing above everything, even her own Life.
The True God of Yellow Sand said coldly, "Very well, since you’re seeking death, I shall grant it to you!"
"Come with me, kill the Painful Empress!"
As he finished speaking, the attacks of the five True Gods simultaneously bombarded the Painful Empress.
The Painful Empress desperately conjured thousands of Divine Power Spider Webs to fend off the attacks.
However, without the True God of Radiance, Madeleine’s Divine Power Spider Webs shattered in mere moments.
Thud!
The enormous spider form of the Painful Empress recoiled tens of thousands of kilometers, spitting out a mass of black-red blood.
The True God of Yellow Sand snorted coldly, "Overestimating yourself!"
Yet, the Painful Empress swiftly adjusted her State, licking blood from the corner of her mouth,
"That hit hurt so good~"
"It seems I recall the taste of pain once more..."
"Ah... how exquisite it is..."
In this moment, the aura of the Painful Empress rapidly recovered and even surged again by a notch!
The True God of Yellow Sand frowned, remembering that the Painful Empress was best at the Law of Pain.
Now, having integrated the Law of Pain into the Law of Desire, it seemed to manifest a unique change.
This change brought her an incredibly powerful recovery ability, each time she was hit, her power could rise another notch.
Bang! Boom!
The five True Gods, joining forces, besieged the Painful Empress, repeatedly forcing the massive Blood Spider back.
Yet each time attacked, the Painful Empress bore expressions of pain and madness, seemingly accumulating something.
With terrifying wounds covering her, occasionally spraying blood, gradually dyeing the Void entirely Red.
With such a reckless style, the Painful Empress managed to temporarily hold back the five True Gods!
Han Xing’s Sky Island region.
Ten seconds earlier.
The True God of Radiance, having slipped into the Tree of Rules, was hastily approaching.
At this moment, the Crystal and True God of Judgment were tens of thousands of kilometers away from Han Xing’s Sky Island.
And then, they suddenly saw a Tree of Rules appear overhead.
The True God of Radiance’s figure suddenly emerged from the Tree of Rules, blocking the four True Gods.
At this moment, the four True Gods looked curiously at the scene before them.
"Interesting, escaping into the Rules, then using them for movement?"
The True God of Judgment remarked, "Such a method requires extremely deep insight and compatibility with Rules. Among us Middle-tier True Gods, few have mastered it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1041: Battle of Breakthrough (Part 1)
paragraphs: The True God of Crystal next to him echoed: “Indeed, Radiance truly is a Divine Spirit that survived from the Age of Ten Thousand Gods. His understanding of the Rules rivals ours.”
“If he continues to grow, he might actually break through to a Middle-tier True God in a short time, perhaps even reach Emperor Level.”
The one-legged giant Storm True God snorted: “What good is strong Talent? This guy is now the enemy of the Rules, chose to oppose us right after his breakthrough!”
“And those throughout history who opposed the Rules met tragic ends, even Hunter was no exception!”
“Exactly! The Rules are absolute, no one can break them!”
The next moment, the attacks from the four True Gods thundered in an instant.
True God of Radiance did not speak but took a deep breath, striving to unfold his Divine Power Domain.
“Buzz!”
Yet in just a split second, it was directly shattered!
“Pfft!”
True God of Radiance suffered severe backlash and spat out a mouthful of golden blood.
True God of Judgment shook his head and said: “Too weak, though his Talent is strong, the breakthrough happened too recently to enhance his Power of Rules.”
“Storm, you go deal with True God of Radiance, the three of us will kill that human.”
True God of Storm was ordered by True God of Judgment, and although unwilling, he knew this was not the time to dwell on it.
The next moment, he directly charged toward True God of Radiance.
However, at this moment, True God of Radiance took a deep breath and said solemnly.
“With me here, you shall not disturb the master!”
True God of Storm sneered: “Best consider yourself first!”
He waved his hand, tossing out a terrifying hurricane that instantly engulfed True God of Radiance.
Seeing this scene, the other True Gods’ eyes showed indifference.
They knew this was True God of Storm’s forte.
A being enveloped by this storm wouldn’t last long before being torn apart.
Yet at this moment, endless golden light burst out from the storm of death!
Those golden lights, like the sun buried deep beneath the sea, fully erupted at this moment!
The terrifying aura caused even Judgment, Crystal, and other Middle-tier True Gods to feel uneasy.
Moreover, they sensed the battlefield behind them, where the True God of Yellow Sand was, also experiencing strong Divine Power fluctuations.
There, it seemed as though a complete Great World had appeared out of thin air.
The Great World presented itself in pure blood red, from here it even seemed to possess real rules.
And the True God of Yellow Sand, along with the other four True Gods, were all enveloped by this Great World.
The True God of Crystal asked puzzled: “What’s happening? Why did a Great World suddenly appear?”
The True God of Mountains beside him shook his head, “It didn’t suddenly appear, but was created by that woman controlling the Rule of Desire.”
“She actually simulated a complete world rule using the Seven Emotions and Six Desires!”
“A world that reaches such a level is almost infinitely close to reality, even you and I can’t break it immediately!”
“This woman is remarkable!”
However, before the True God of Mountains finished speaking.
Countless True Gods of Radiance suddenly appeared near the hurricane thrown by True God of Hurricane.
All these True Gods of Radiance gathered toward the hurricane.
Each True God of Radiance’s involvement made the light inside even more intense!
At this moment, the four Middle-tier True Gods present showed strong shock in their eyes.
“Fusion of the Self! This guy is actually achieving Fusion of the Self!”
“That’s a technique exclusive to Emperor Level!”
“Quick, interrupt him!”
Yet, after continuously fusing 112 True Gods of Radiance, the Law of Light there had reached an extremely terrifying level.
It was as if a sun was rapidly rising!
Simultaneously, from within the hurricane.
And in the Great World where the Painful Empress was, a voice suddenly echoed.
“Radiant Ten Thousand Me!”
“Seven Emotions and Six Desires Reincarnation Realm!”
Buzz!
Endless Radiant Divine Power and Blood-colored Divine Power erupted simultaneously.
A Light Giant towering tens of thousands of kilometers suddenly appeared!
It was none other than True God of Radiance.
The four Middle-tier True Gods present were full of shock.
“Fusion of the Self, and to a hundredfold Fusion of the Self, he’s actually succeeded!”
True God of Judgment murmured: “Terrifying indeed, does Radiance have such profound foundations? Can he use Emperor Level techniques just after his breakthrough?”
However, the other True Gods were also in complete bafflement.
During the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, Radiance was too low-key, even these True Gods had heard of his name but did not know his specific prowess.
There wasn’t even a legend of him fighting certain battles.
Yet, this low-key existence.
Ten thousand years after the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, broke through to True God and suddenly possessed such terrifying power.
The True God of Crystal commented: “This Radiance is extraordinary, if he doesn’t die, the position of Emperor Level has a place for him!”
Though they were enemies now, they couldn’t help but express their respect for such a formidable Talent.
And by this time, True God of Radiance, transformed to a height of several million meters, had already trampled the death storm underfoot.
He extinguished the swirling death storm below him as if casually putting out a small fire.
Then, his gaze burned like a new star, looking at the four True Gods present.
The next moment, the Light Giant raised the glowing hammer in his hand and smashed it down forcefully.
Seeing this scene, the four True Gods shouted simultaneously: “Block it!”

“If he continues to grow, he might actually break through to a Middle-tier True God in a short time, perhaps even reach Emperor Level.”
The one-legged giant Storm True God snorted: “What good is strong Talent?

“And those throughout history who opposed the Rules met tragic ends, even Hunter was no exception!”
“Exactly!

True God of Radiance did not speak but took a deep breath, striving to unfold his Divine Power Domain.

“This woman is remarkable!”

Countless True Gods of Radiance suddenly appeared near the hurricane thrown by True God of Hurricane.

Simultaneously, from within the hurricane.

Buzz!
Endless Radiant Divine Power and Blood-colored Divine Power erupted simultaneously.
A Light Giant towering tens of thousands of kilometers suddenly appeared!
It was none other than True God of Radiance.
The four Middle-tier True Gods present were full of shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 1042 - 520: Battle of Breakthrough (Part 1)_3
paragraphs: They weren’t even thinking of dealing with the True God of Radiance.
After merging a hundred selves, his combat power has already surpassed the four True Gods present on the field.
"Boom!"
A dull crashing sound appeared.
At the site of the energy clash, it was like a supernova burst.
A ripple of energy spread like water waves, quickly propagating tens of thousands of miles.
The four Middle-tier True Gods were all blasted back!
"Poof! Poof!"
The True God of Judgment retreated continuously.
"So strong!"
"Wasn’t he just a Low-tier Divine Spirit? How did he suddenly merge so many selves?"
The True God of Crystal exclaimed in disbelief.
The merge of selves is a technique used by High-tier True Gods.
They can merge selves from different times, enhancing combat power exponentially or even tens of times.
This is the essential difference between High-tier and Middle-tier True Gods.
However, this is generally the last resort of High-tier True Gods, not used until the final moment.
Yet, they saw it in a Low-tier True God.
The True God of Judgment said with difficulty, "Hold on!"
"Even the Sea Emperor and Nether Emperor can’t hold on for long when merging selves; the True God of Radiance is just a Low-tier, won’t last long."
"Thirty seconds! I bet he can last up to thirty seconds!"
Indeed, after thirty seconds, the aura of the Light Giant began to decline rapidly!
The four True Gods present all showed expressions of delight in their eyes.
"He’s starting to weaken, go!"
"Drag the Radiance!"
However, the next moment, a Divine Format of a Top-tier Divine Spirit suddenly appeared in the Light Giant’s hand.
Then, directly in front of the four ancient True Gods, it was crushed.
The pure divine power contained in that Top-tier Divine Spirit’s Divine Format was absorbed directly by the True God of Radiance.
At the same time, the aura of the True God of Radiance, which was about to decline, suddenly surged!
The four ancient True Gods widened their eyes in shock.
"Damn! Using a Top-tier Divine Spirit’s Divine Format as a consumable, this guy is just too extravagant."
The True God of Crystal, defending against the True God of Radiance, said, "Don’t worry, Top-tier Divine Spirit’s Divine Format is quite precious; he can’t have much in reserve!"
"Even if he merges selves, he isn’t our match; as long as we hold on, the first to fall will surely be him!
However, after another thirty seconds.
The True God of Radiance again produced a Top-tier True God’s Divine Format!
"Grass!"
The True God of Crystal cursed angrily!
They continued to engage in a fierce battle with the Light Giant.
Every time they saw the aura of the True God of Radiance decline, the four True Gods would show a hopeful expression.
Yet every time at this point, the True God of Radiance would have another Top-tier Divine Spirit’s Divine Format in hand, absorbing it.
The situation became a deadlock for a time.
Meanwhile, over at the Painful Empress’s side, ever since transforming into a Great World, no sound has come from that area.
No one knows what is happening inside.
However, the Painful Empress is indeed holding off five Great True Gods alone.
In the Seven Emotions and Six Desires Reincarnation Realm.
The five Great True Gods plunged into an endless illusion.
They frantically broke through one illusion, only for an even more realistic illusion to appear quickly.
With a massive supply of Divine Formats provided by Han Xing, the Painful Empress too was recklessly consuming the Formats to provide herself power.
This is their only advantage.
Absorbing many Divine Formats, they have essentially activated an infinite energy buff.
Using ultimate moves regardless of the cost.
Time passed slowly.
In the blink of an eye, another twenty minutes passed.
At the cost of two Top-tier Divine Spirit Rules and eight High-tier Divine Spirit Rules.
The True God of Radiance and Madeleine stalled ten True Gods for a full 20 minutes!
This is a miracle!
Two Low-tier True Gods against 6 Middle-tier True Gods, plus 4 Low-tier True Gods.
Under normal circumstances, let alone holding out, not collapsing within ten seconds would be considered good.
Yet, the two of them did it!
And the Divine Format before Han Xing’s eyes has reached 80% completion!
Always keeping tabs on the external battle, Han Xing felt a surge of excitement in his heart.
Almost there! Just another twenty minutes!
In 20 minutes, he will be able to condense this Divine Format and become the true breaker of rules.
Then, whether to stay or leave, these guys won’t be able to do anything to him.
Yet, at this time, the True God of Radiance seemed to encounter some issues.
The Light Giant form he inhabited showed dense cracks.
Moreover, the True God of Night Demon, who was blasted by Cheng Jianyong, had also recovered at this moment.
It joined the battle without hesitation.
This made the already pressured True God of Radiance even more difficult to sustain.
To withstand the attacks from five True Gods.
The True God of Radiance continuously conjured Light Spears to fight against them.
After several consecutive uses, the aura of the True God of Radiance began to decline rapidly.
He could barely maintain this state.
Helpless, the God of Radiance dispersed one-third of his selves.
The aura dropped significantly, unable to crush five True Gods in a straightforward manner anymore.
The five True Gods’ eyes regained a look of delight.
"The True God of Radiance really can’t hold on this time!"
"Finally, can’t do it anymore? To hold us for so long counts as strong!"
"All together now, finish him off!"
And just at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong directed one-fifth of the defensive cannons towards them.
Although only one-fourth, it’s sufficient to heavily damage a True God.
At the same time, the True God of Radiance seized the opportunity, unleashing a wave of terrifying attacks.
"Damn it!"
The five True Gods, helpless, could only continue to defend with full force.
And the Divine Spirits in Silent City dared not approach.
Because the battle of True God level has reached a terrifying degree.
On both sides of the battlefield, even Low-tier True Gods can’t join in.
These Divine Spirits, if they dared to go over, a bit of the battle’s aftermath could lead to their demise.
The Divine Spirits of Silent City could only stand by and watch.
Time, passed another three minutes!
Only 17 minutes remain, and Han Xing will succeed in breaking through.
On the field, all True Gods and the Divine Spirits far off could feel, the rules becoming more impatient!

(PS: This breakthrough battle will still take several days, because it involves too many characters, the author’s ability is insufficient to quickly wrap it up, in addition to entering the factory being extremely busy, making it impossible to post continuously, everyone can wait patiently, the author really doesn’t want to abandon this story!!!)

chapters.title: Chapter 1043 - 521: Is There Anyone Else Coming to Kill Me?
paragraphs: The Power of Rules urged these True Gods to act quickly.
However, the battlefield between the True God of Judgment and the True God of Yellow Sand fell into a stalemate.
Thus, time reached the final 15 minutes.
The World Barrier constructed by the Painful Empress, although cracked, seemed able to continue supporting.
Meanwhile, on the side of the True God of Radiance, those with him were suppressed by over nine thousand Defense Towers on the Sky Island.
At this rate, even if the time ends, they won’t be able to interrupt the human who’s breaking through.
The True God of Judgment suddenly grew anxious, yelling out, "Nether Emperor! Sea Emperor! Spirit Emperor!"
"We need support!"
As soon as the words fell, something seemed to be sensed within the Forbidden Star River.
Splosh! Splosh Splash!
After a terrifying tremor.
From within, several glowing tendrils of Rules extended again.
These tendrils seemed to want to transport True Gods outward.
However, this time, the Forbidden Star River also sensed this, and this galaxy of immense power fell into an extremely tyrannical state.
Splosh! Splosh Splash!
The tendrils of Rules were submerged by surging waters.
The crowd seemed to see arrow upon arrow appear in the Star River, severing all those tendrils!
Within the Forbidden Galaxy, a voice of anger echoed, "Damn! Multiple transports have triggered the Forbidden Star River’s retaliation!"
"Return some people!"
"Below middle-tier True Gods, do not come out, gather all power and send two honorables."
In the end, only two tendrils successfully extended out.
From these two tendrils emerged two equally terrifying figures.
One was a creature akin to a Bronze Giant, exuding metallic radiance.
The other was a large bird with three heads, radiating seven-colored divine light.
"True God of Heaven, Aurora True God!"
The True God of Radiance called out their names.
And Han Xing, who was in a breakthrough state, suddenly widened his eyes as if remembering something.
The three-headed large bird seemed to be the creature the Divine Spirit of the Sea of Light sought.
Moreover, it’s said that this bird would appear beside those with strong fortune.
Unexpectedly, it was seeking out a True God.
"Heaven, Aurora, come quickly to assist!"
The True God of Judgment yelled.
The two True Gods also scanned the battlefield situation immediately.
In the next moment, the Bronze Giant and the three-headed bird all lunged towards the True God of Radiance.
Time was down to the final fourteen minutes.
They needed to interrupt Han Xing’s breakthrough!
With two more middle-tier True Gods joining, the True God of Radiance was beaten back step by step.
Dense cracks appeared on his Light Giant’s body.
It seemed it would explode on the spot.
At this moment, the True God of Radiance took a deep breath.
Nearby this void, countless phantoms of the True God of Radiance appeared again.
The True God of Judgment’s pupils contracted sharply, "The second Fusion of the Self! Have you lost your mind?"
"You’re only an initial-tier True God; it’s ridiculous enough to achieve the first Fusion of the Self!"

"If you force the second fusion, this will severely deplete your Power of Origin Rules. You originally had hopes of breaking through to Emperor Level, but if you exhaust your Self, you may be stuck at middle-tier True God forever!"
Upon hearing the True God of Judgment’s caution, the True God of Radiance’s actions did not pause, as Selves gathered toward him.
"Breaking through to Emperor Level, compared to the master, means nothing."
"Today, whoever wants to stop the master’s breakthrough must first tread over my corpse!"
With these words, the True God of Radiance fused with 50 Selves again!
The terrifying aura had vaguely reached the boundary of Emperor Level.
At the same time, the True God of Radiance once again condensed a Light Spear in his hand.
He glanced at Han Xing behind him and said, "Master, watch closely, this is my strongest strike."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing had already turned his gaze.
Then, he concentrated all his Spiritual Power to watch the True God of Radiance’s strike.
In the next moment, the Light Spear in the True God of Radiance’s hand seemed to reach a critical point in the Power of Rules it contained.
The void began to be densely cracked.
The True God of Judgment quickly warned, "Interrupt him!"
"Do not let him unleash this strike!"
As the words fell, seven True Gods rushed toward the True God of Radiance.
Simultaneously, the True God of Radiance whispered lightly.
"Hundred Generations Godslaying Spear, go!"
Swoosh!
Like a meteor skimming across the desolate cosmos.
This spear reached the spot where the seven True Gods were with unimaginable speed.
At this moment, the seven True Gods seemed to experience an undeniable feeling!
They had a premonition that they would be directly punctured and enter a state of slumber with this strike.
At the crucial moment, the True God of Heaven shouted angrily, "Mount Qun, shield us!"
"This is the Nether Emperor’s will!"
At this moment, the True God of the Mountains realized that if he did not step up, they might face unprecedented devastation.
"Damn it! Channel your Power onto me!"
The True God of the Mountains directly transformed into his true form.
In the next moment, divine Powers from the other six True Gods all fell onto the True God of the Mountains.
Despite this.
The Godslaying Spear still penetrated the body of the True God of the Mountains without hindrance.
In the next moment.
The mountain spanning the void, colossal like a star, instantly crumbled.
In the air, a vast Tree of Rules appeared, a stream of light swiftly burrowed into the Tree of Rules.
This phenomenon indicated.
The True God of the Mountains had already entered slumber within the Rules.
Unable to revive for at least several months.
And if not for the immortal trait, the True God of the Mountains would have perished by this strike.

paragraphs: The six remaining True Gods stared at this scene, their eyes shaken.
They even showed a trace of fear in their eyes toward that Light Giant!
At the same time.
The progress bar in front of Han Xing had already reached 90%.
In that instant, the Power of Rules throughout the entire Void began to churn, as if growing incomparably impatient.
The next moment, countless Red threads suddenly appeared all over Han Xing’s body.
Among these threads, there were more than a dozen extremely thick ones.
Han Xing’s gaze suddenly hardened. “True Gods? This many?”
At this moment, his heart sank straight to rock bottom.
He had thought twelve True Gods coming to kill him was already absurd enough.
Now it seemed that was still far from the limit!
Even more True Gods were rushing over.
“Fuck! How are there still so many True Gods?”
“You can’t see these bastards any other time, but now they all show up!”
At the same time.
Both sides who were fighting stopped their actions.
They seemed to have sensed something, gazing into the depths of the Void.
The next instant, everyone felt a bloody stench appear.
In the distant Void, a crimson tide emerged.
It was a moving Sea of Blood, its scale incomparably vast, even surpassing a Great World!
Waves towered to the heavens, countless corpses floating up and down within.
And above that Sea of Blood, three beings floated, their entire bodies covered in tentacles, their sizes even larger than stars.
Wherever they passed, all matter in the Void was polluted.
Shredded flesh, Stone Blocks, all kinds of reeking, maggot-infested organs.
An astonishing stench spread over, with hundreds of millions of flies trailing behind!
“Ancient Gods from Alternate Space!” The True God of Judgment’s gaze tightened.
Ancient Gods were existences even older than these True Gods of the Age of Ten Thousand Gods.
Every single Ancient God was an existence capable of bringing suffering to the world.
It was said that these Ancient Gods needed only one day to completely corrupt a Great World!
They were incomparably troublesome; in a frontal battle, even a Middle-tier True God couldn’t handle a single Ancient God!
Moreover, because the Ancient Gods of Alternate Space were all insane beings, they belonged neither to the Holy Spirit Realm faction nor the Forbidden Land faction.
These lunatics took any living being as their target!
The appearance of the three Ancient Gods put both sides on full alert.
However, that was still not all.
In the distant Void, one True God after another appeared—different in appearance, but with equally terrifying auras.
“These are... True Gods from other small worlds—there are actually four of them!”
Seeing this scene, Han Xing and the others, including the True God of Radiance, had their hearts sink to the bottom.
However, it was not over yet.
At the same time.
With these two waves of True Gods arriving.
More and more High-tier Divine Spirits and Top-tier Divine Spirits appeared in the Void.
Counting the True Gods from Silent City, plus the True Gods from the Silent Star River.
The number of True Gods gathered here had already exceeded twenty.
The number of High-tier Divine Spirits had even broken a hundred.
Even dealing with a legendary Emperor wouldn’t require such a luxurious lineup.
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but curse at this moment: “Fuck, to deal with just one Legend, they send out this many Middle-tier True Gods—this is way too bullying, isn’t it?”
The other team members were likewise full of indignation!
At this moment, the three factions—counting Silent City, that made four factions.
At the same time.
Within that Sea of Blood, one of the Ancient Gods suddenly looked toward the Painful Empress’s Seven Emotions and Six Desires Reincarnation World.
“Oh? The Rule of Desire? Interesting.”
The next instant, it directly stretched out a tentacle and stabbed fiercely.
The World Barrier, already covered in cracks, instantly shattered at that moment.
Crack!
With a shattering sound, that region was instantly shrouded in multicolored Power of Rules.
A gigantic Blood Spider’s figure was blasted tens of thousands of miles away.
“Pff!”
The Painful Empress spat out a mouthful of blood, her entire body covered in cracks.
On the True God of Radiance’s side, he suddenly came under the attack of another Ancient God.
His Light Giant form was suddenly contaminated by a mysterious power,
its surface rapidly blackening and rotting!
At the same time, countless eyeballs sprouted all over it.
This corruption rapidly spread across half of the Light Giant’s body.
The True God of Radiance seemed finally unable to hold on and withdrew from the [Radiant Ten Thousand Me] State.
However, like the Painful Empress, he suffered an extremely severe backlash.
“Pff!”
In that moment, the True God of Radiance hastily mobilized Divine Power to clamp down on the corruption spreading over his body.
His aura plummeted at extreme speed.
“Damn it, fucking Ancient Gods!” Cheng Jianyong cursed outright.
A surge of killing intent also welled up in Han Xing’s heart.
These Ancient Gods had moved directly against them the moment they arrived.
In just an instant, the situation that Han Xing and the others had struggled to maintain collapsed into rout!
At this moment, the Painful Empress and the True God of Radiance both stood in the Void, beginning to draw upon the Tree of Rules to heal their injuries.
However, because their injuries were far too severe, they were fundamentally impossible to heal in a short time.
They watched the surrounding enemies warily.
However, those Ancient Gods did not make another move.
Instead, they fixed their gaze on Han Xing, who was condensing his Divine Format atop that black Sky Island.
These few Ancient Gods, as well as the nearby True Gods, were all seeing Han Xing’s appearance for the first time.
One of them spoke: “So that’s how it is... The one destroying the Rules and causing the Rules to riot is this brat?”
At the same time, within that boundless Sea of Blood.
The three figures twisted to the extreme—existences who could fill one’s mind with endless negative thoughts just by approaching—also locked their gaze onto Han Xing.
“I can feel the mark of our Alternate Space on this guy...”
