chapters.title: Chapter 1045: Anyone Else Coming to Kill Me? (3)
paragraphs: “It seems this kid has had a grudge against our Alternate Space for a long time!”
Han Xing paused, seemingly recalling something.
Back during the Blood Tide Period, he had shattered several altars, leaving hundreds of Alternate Space marks behind.
After all this time, Han Xing had almost forgotten about it.
Unexpectedly, now that the Evil Gods emerged, they instantly recognized Han Xing as an enemy of their Alternate Space.
Thinking about it, it seemed normal for the two ancient gods to suddenly attack Madeleine and the True God of Radiance.
Because they themselves were sworn enemies.
At this moment, although Han Xing couldn’t control the Defense Tower or move, he could still speak.
Han Xing chuckled, “Of course there’s a grudge.”
“Back in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, most of your Evil God altars in the Alternate Space were destroyed by me.”
Upon hearing this, the countless eyes on the three ancient gods showed various expressions.
“So it was you, the little fellow who ruined our Alternate Space invasion plan back then.”
“In the blink of an eye, you’ve grown to such an extent that you’re already on the path of breaking the rules.”
“But unfortunately for you, with us here, you are destined to fail.”
Han Xing listened and laughed again, “No worries, even if I fail, I will at least take one of you down.”
“So, have you decided which one of you I will eliminate?”
The three shapeless ancient gods across from him hesitated upon hearing Han Xing’s threat.
Then they chuckled lightly, “Such bravado. Are you only daring so because you know you’re about to die?”
Beside them, another ancient god, covered in fly larvae, asked, “Kid, do you have any last words?”
“If not, we’ll send you on your way!”
Under the gaze of so many True Gods on the field, Han Xing said, “I do.”
“Damn it! Is there anyone else trying to kill me?”
“If you’re going to do it, hurry up; otherwise, you’ll miss your turn once it gets crowded!”
As Han Xing finished speaking,
there was a tremor in the Void.
In the distance, from the Void appeared four formidable beings with horns on their heads, whose mere flesh seemed to crush the space.
The moment these four beings appeared, their terrifying aura dominated an entire area.
Confronting both Silent City and Alternate Space.
At this point, a True God shouted out their identity.
“Ancient Demon Gods of the Abyss Realm, and there are four of them!”
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was stunned, “Damn, there really are!”
“Even the Ancient Demon Gods have appeared; now everyone’s here!”
At this moment, the four factions each occupied a space, completely surrounding the Sky Island where Han Xing was.
In the distance, Samoyed appeared tremblingly beside Han Xing, asking in a trembling voice, “Master, do you have any strategies?”
So many True Gods!
Any one of them could kill it with a flick of a finger.
Now they are all gathered here to deal with one Legend.
Today has been full of the most absurd things it has ever seen.
However, Han Xing rolled his eyes and said, “What are you thinking? Twenty True Gods, how could I possibly have a plan?”
“Damn it, this time we’re screwed!”
Even in his death, Han Xing would not have thought that his breakthrough would trigger such a great reaction.
In this situation, all tactics were useless; even escape plans were no longer viable.
These True Gods had long sealed off the Void for billions of kilometers around.
At this moment, the four forces each assembled.
The True God of Yellow Sand also led his True Gods to join with the True Gods of Judgment, Crystal, and others.
Currently, the strongest on the field was naturally the Forbidden Galaxy.
Next were the four Ancient Demon Gods of the Abyss Realm.
While the three Ancient Evil Gods of the Alternate Space were equally formidable.
The True Gods from the Great World were unclear on their stance, observing for the time being.
For a moment, no one dared to act rashly.
Han Xing watched his progress bar reach 92%.
Though knowing it was naive, a hope arose within him that these guys might wait for him to break through before making a move.
He had a premonition.
If he succeeded in breaking through, it might bring about an unimaginable transformation.
By then, maybe he would have a chance to survive...
And at this moment.
One of the Ancient Evil Gods spoke, “Why is everyone standing here doing nothing?”
“Don’t tell me you’re really planning to wait until this kid breaks the rules before taking action?”
Opposite, the three-headed large bird from the Forbidden Star River spoke, “Epidemic, what is your purpose here?”
“You group of rule-breaking traitors!”
The three ancient gods laughed, “Aurora, stop focusing solely on us.”
“Shouldn’t you be more concerned about what those guys from the Abyss Realm are doing here?”
At this moment, one of the Ancient Demon Gods said, “Per the Emperor’s orders, we are to take this kid’s corpse back.”
Upon hearing this, the Ancient Evil God laughed sinisterly, “Oh? Then it’s decided.”
“Forbidden Land only needs to prevent this kid from breaking through, while we just need him dead, and the Abyss Realm wants his corpse.”
It completely ignored the opinions of the True Gods from other Great Worlds.
After all, the rules of these Great Worlds were incomplete; birthing even an Initial-tier True God was considered remarkable.
With the arrogance of these Ancient Evil Gods, they were entirely indifferent to the opinions of ordinary True Gods.
Then, one of the Ancient Evil Gods chuckled, “So, what are we waiting for?”
“Let’s get started!”
As his words fell, he first stirred the Sea of Blood.
Pouring torrents of blood water surged toward the Sky Island where Han Xing was located.
Han Xing immediately ordered, “Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, control the Sky Island and move forward, target all attacks on those Evil Gods!”
“Madeleine, Radiance, blow them up! Blow them up hard!”
“Today, even if we die, make sure to drag two Evil Gods down with us!”
Upon hearing Han Xing’s frenzied words, the three Evil Gods on the field were slightly taken aback.
They hadn’t expected Epidemic’s targeting to provoke the human’s deep-seated hatred, turning his aggression toward them!

chapters.title: Chapter 1046: Supreme Hall Emerges
paragraphs: Those ancient gods, after the initial shock, quickly regained their composure.
‘Pestilence’ sneered, “Just a threat from ants.”
However, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the God of Radiance all received the command.
At this moment, the True God of Radiance once again recklessly activated the [Radiant Ten Thousand Me] state!
His aura surged crazily!
Not only that, the True God of Radiance also concentrated a spear in his hand.
This was the strongest attack of the True God of Radiance!
The terrifying energy fluctuation completely exceeded the previous strength several times, even nearing the limits of the Emperor Level!
This shocked all the divine spirits present.
“Hundred Generations Godslaying Spear!”
“Quick, stop him!” shouted the three Evil Gods in the Alternate Space.

At this time, more than eight thousand Defense Towers on the whole Sky Island, plus over a thousand Defense Towers on the Divine Demon Battleship, and the Celestial Rail Strike Device, all entered the energy charging state.
This was enough to severely damage middle-tier True Gods, and could even put a middle-tier True God into a deep sleep.
All the True Gods felt waves of palpitations, no one dared to act rashly.
Allowing the True God of Radiance to gather a terrifying attack, aiming it at the True Gods of the Alternate Space.
“You’re just going to watch?”
However, no one responded.
Because, they were enemies by nature, now merely gathered because of this rule-breaking human.
If they can cause severe damage incidentally, it’s a welcome consequence.
Anyway, this human needs a few more minutes to break through.
These minutes are more than enough for them to kill the opposition tens of thousands of times!
Meanwhile, Han Xing was using [Infinite Domain] to record the move of the True God of Radiance.
The three Ancient Evil Gods exchanged a glance, their expressions changing slightly.
Though, running away in front of so many True Gods seemed embarrassing.
But compared to pride, life is more important.
The birth of an Evil God is a taboo.
They possess greater power than ordinary True Gods.
But likewise, they have lost the ability for infinite resurrection.
The three Ancient Evil Gods exchanged a look, about to escape into the Void.
And at that moment, unexpectedly, a Blood Spider approached them.
“Gentlemen, let’s sink together into the endless desire~”
With these words, a world, infinitely approaching reality, appeared, enveloping the bodies of the three Ancient Evil Gods.
“Not good!”
The next moment, the spear of the True God of Radiance, and the attacks of over nine thousand energy cannons, rained down.
Instantly, Painful Empress’s small world showed endless cracks.
Crack!
The small world collapsed with a loud crash.
The space in that area also collapsed together.
A wave of energy approaching the Emperor Level raged inside.
Occasionally, wailing sounds could be heard from within!
Beside, watching were the True Gods of Silent City and the Forbidden Star River, all showing a hint of surprise in their eyes.
Because this level of concentrated fire was never forced out during their previous battles with the True God of Radiance.
And now, to deal with these three Evil Gods, they directly used their trump cards.
The True God of Yellow Sand and the True God of Judgment couldn’t help but feel grateful, luckily there were these Evil Gods from the Alternate Space attracting the hatred.
Otherwise, if they had faced this attack.
At least one True God would have been forced into a state of slumber.
A few seconds later, three figures fled like beaten dogs.
They appeared extremely miserable at this time.
Their bodies, covered with eyes, insects, and tentacles, were shattered in large parts.
Seeing this scene, all the True Gods wore expressions of shock.
Because if it had been any force on the battlefield, none would be able to withstand this wave of concentrated fire.
And at this moment.
Having thrown the Light Spear, the True God of Radiance once again exited the Radiant Ten Thousand Me state, his light extinguished, appearing exceedingly weak.
Painful Empress also suffered severe backlash due to her small world being destroyed for the second time.
The more than nine thousand Defense Towers on Sky Island also entered a recharging state.
In conclusion, Han Xing and his team had exhausted their trump cards.
Seeing this scene, the Three-headed Bird, also the Aurora True God, spoke up: “Everyone, the time has come, you can act now.”
“Kill them!”
A large number of True Gods charged toward Han Xing’s Sky Island.
At this moment, the True God of Radiance struggled to lift a hammer in the Void, seemingly wanting to continue the fight.
But his injuries were too severe, making even lowering his hand difficult.
Painful Empress also exerted herself fully, seemingly wanting to spit out silk again to entangle those True Gods.
However, her injuries were too severe to accomplish it.
In this moment, Han Xing looked at the True Gods surging around, a relaxed expression in his eyes.
It seemed like a look of someone who had seen past life and death.
Time seemed to freeze.
Han Xing suddenly chuckled: “Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, Lian’Er, Xiaoyang.”
Upon hearing Han Xing’s call, the crowd responded one after another.
“Brother Xing, I’m here.”
“Brother Xing, speak.”
Han Xing smiled: “We’ve reached the limit, ultimately, we didn’t break the rules, didn’t become beings beyond Hunters.”
“However, these years, I’ve lived extraordinarily.”
Hearing this, everyone began to smile.
“Indeed, who would have thought, a few years ago we were just a bunch of office drones working 996.”
“Now in the blink of an eye, we’re fighting to the death with these creatures who’ve lived for tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of years.”
“It’s truly extraordinary...” Shen Yun exclaimed.
Cheng Jianyong also laughed: “Still a bit regretful, not seeing Brother Xing’s successful breakthrough, the scene of suppressing everything.”
“That scene, must be so cool.”
At this moment, two young girls already had tears in their eyes.

These minutes are more than enough for them to kill the opposition tens of thousands of times!
Meanwhile, Han Xing was using [Infinite Domain] to record the move of the True God of Radiance.
The three Ancient Evil Gods exchanged a glance, their expressions changing slightly.
Though, running away in front of so many True Gods seemed embarrassing.
But compared to pride, life is more important.
The birth of an Evil God is a taboo.
They possess greater power than ordinary True Gods.
But likewise, they have lost the ability for infinite resurrection.
The three Ancient Evil Gods exchanged a look, about to escape into the Void.
And at that moment, unexpectedly, a Blood Spider approached them.
“Gentlemen, let’s sink together into the endless desire~”
With these words, a world, infinitely approaching reality, appeared, enveloping the bodies of the three Ancient Evil Gods.
“Not good!”
The next moment, the spear of the True God of Radiance, and the attacks of over nine thousand energy cannons, rained down.
Instantly, Painful Empress’s small world showed endless cracks.
Crack!
The small world collapsed with a loud crash.
The space in that area also collapsed together.
A wave of energy approaching the Emperor Level raged inside.
Occasionally, wailing sounds could be heard from within!
Beside, watching were the True Gods of Silent City and the Forbidden Star River, all showing a hint of surprise in their eyes.
Because this level of concentrated fire was never forced out during their previous battles with the True God of Radiance.
And now, to deal with these three Evil Gods, they directly used their trump cards.
The True God of Yellow Sand and the True God of Judgment couldn’t help but feel grateful, luckily there were these Evil Gods from the Alternate Space attracting the hatred.
Otherwise, if they had faced this attack.
At least one True God would have been forced into a state of slumber.
A few seconds later, three figures fled like beaten dogs.
They appeared extremely miserable at this time.
Their bodies, covered with eyes, insects, and tentacles, were shattered in large parts.
Seeing this scene, all the True Gods wore expressions of shock.
Because if it had been any force on the battlefield, none would be able to withstand this wave of concentrated fire.
And at this moment.
Having thrown the Light Spear, the True God of Radiance once again exited the Radiant Ten Thousand Me state, his light extinguished, appearing exceedingly weak.
Painful Empress also suffered severe backlash due to her small world being destroyed for the second time.
The more than nine thousand Defense Towers on Sky Island also entered a recharging state.
In conclusion, Han Xing and his team had exhausted their trump cards.
Seeing this scene, the Three-headed Bird, also the Aurora True God, spoke up: “Everyone, the time has come, you can act now.”
“Kill them!”
A large number of True Gods charged toward Han Xing’s Sky Island.
At this moment, the True God of Radiance struggled to lift a hammer in the Void, seemingly wanting to continue the fight.
But his injuries were too severe, making even lowering his hand difficult.
Painful Empress also exerted herself fully, seemingly wanting to spit out silk again to entangle those True Gods.
However, her injuries were too severe to accomplish it.
In this moment, Han Xing looked at the True Gods surging around, a relaxed expression in his eyes.
It seemed like a look of someone who had seen past life and death.
Time seemed to freeze.
Han Xing suddenly chuckled: “Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, Lian’Er, Xiaoyang.”
Upon hearing Han Xing’s call, the crowd responded one after another.
“Brother Xing, I’m here.”
“Brother Xing, speak.”
Han Xing smiled: “We’ve reached the limit, ultimately, we didn’t break the rules, didn’t become beings beyond Hunters.”
“However, these years, I’ve lived extraordinarily.”
Hearing this, everyone began to smile.
“Indeed, who would have thought, a few years ago we were just a bunch of office drones working 996.”
“Now in the blink of an eye, we’re fighting to the death with these creatures who’ve lived for tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of years.”
“It’s truly extraordinary...” Shen Yun exclaimed.
Cheng Jianyong also laughed: “Still a bit regretful, not seeing Brother Xing’s successful breakthrough, the scene of suppressing everything.”
“That scene, must be so cool.”
At this moment, two young girls already had tears in their eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1047: Supreme Hall Appears_2
paragraphs: Those were not tears of fear, but rather a special feeling.
Han Xing said, “Come over, come to my side.”
“Even if we die, we die together.”
Cheng Jianyong and the others nodded heavily upon hearing this.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng used the [Divine Oracle Sign].
Instantly bringing the team to Han Xing’s side.
The five reunited once more.
There was no fear of death in their eyes.
Those True Gods were now approaching the Sky Island, only a million kilometers away.
Han Xing glanced at his backpack.
He actually had two trump cards he could use.
One was the Radiant Spear copied from [Infinite Domain].
However, this strike could only put a True God to sleep, not kill it.
The other Arrow, however, was the true Divine Artifact capable of completely killing a True God.
But it could only be used once.
So Han Xing asked, “I have a trump card that can take down one True God.”
“Who do you think I should use this opportunity on?”
Cheng Jianyong instantly smiled upon hearing this, “Such a good thing, Brother Xing, you should have told us earlier!”
“It’s not bad to have a True God to accompany us to the grave before we die.”
Shen Yun analyzed and said, “Brother Xing, take down the Ancient God in the Alternate Space?”
“I just heard them say that the Ancient God in the Alternate Space seems unable to revive.”
“Using Brother Xing’s trump card could at least make two Ancient Gods fall.”
Upon hearing this, smiles also appeared on everyone’s faces.
Han Xing nodded and said, “Alright, then we’ll take down two Ancient Gods.”
“These guys seem stronger than those Middle-tier True Gods; taking them down with us wouldn’t be too bad before dying.”
The three Ancient Gods didn’t know they were already on Han Xing’s must-kill list.
However, as ancient beings from ten thousand years ago, they could still sense that some terrifying power was targeting them, bringing a deadly sense of crisis.
Just as Han Xing was preparing to interrupt the Divine Format’s formation and directly blast the Ancient Gods.
In the distance.
One of the True Gods from the small world, who hadn’t moved, suddenly sighed.
“Alas... Indeed, every being who breaks the rules faces a great catastrophe?”
“This kid won’t be able to get through this without our help.”
The voice was soft but audible to everyone present.
The Demon God from the Abyss Realm and the True God from the Forbidden Star River both had their expressions change.
Before they could think further.
In the next moment.
One of the True Gods from the small world suddenly lifted his hat.
A man with three eyes appeared.
From his eyes, a death ray shot out suddenly.
This death ray was more terrifying than the Celestial Rail Strike Device’s ray.
Both its speed and Attack Power exceeded that of a typical Middle-tier True God!
Not only that.
Beside him, the other True Gods suddenly burst forth with energy comparable to Middle-tier True Gods.
Among them, Han Xing saw several familiar faces.
A monk carrying a bow and arrow.
A Hunter with a dragon wrapped around him.
And a white-robed Archer, with a bright moon reflected behind him.
At this moment, Han Xing was totally surprised.
Because he recognized these people.
All of them hailed from the organization founded by Hunter, the Supreme Hall.
At this moment, the Hunter with a small dragon suddenly rotated his pale eyes and pointed with his finger.
In the next moment, his small dragon shot out, growing rapidly in size with bizarre speed.
In the blink of an eye, it transformed into a Giant Dragon, the size of a star!
The Aurora True God from the Forbidden Star River said deeply, “Dragon War! You’re still alive?”
The Dragon Hunter did not reply.
Meanwhile, in the Void, the Giant Dragon’s tail wrapped around Han Xing’s Sky Island.
The next moment, a voice appeared beside Han Xing’s ear, “Don’t resist.”
Han Xing instinctively complied.
The next moment, the Sky Island was directly taken away by the dragon’s tail.
The sudden change left everyone surprised.
A confused Ancient God in the Void asked, “Are you from the Supreme Hall?”
“Celestial Fall, Dragon War, Yue Heng, and Anton!”
“What are you guys planning to do?”
The three-eyed man chuckled lightly after hearing this, “You bastards, so many of you are attacking the people from the Supreme Hall, and you’re asking me what we’re doing?”
At this moment, the True Gods all showed expressions of realization.
The three-headed bird, Aurora True God, realized, “Ah, so this boy causing chaos is one of your Supreme Hall people.”
“I was wondering who had such great ability to dare to disrupt the rules.”
“You Supreme Hall folks have been hiding for so many years, daring to come out this time, do you think you’re not dying fast enough?”
Celestial Fall’s eyes widened instantly, “Aurora, watch your tongue?”
“Back then, you were hunted down like a dog, begging for mercy, chased all the way out of the Holy Spirit Realm, and now you dare talk to me like this?”
Upon hearing Celestial Fall’s blunt remarks, the Aurora True God’s three heads hung low.
It stared grimly at Celestial Fall, “Do you wish to die, Celestial Fall?”
Celestial Fall chuckled, “Are you stupid, Aurora? We’re already in a battle to the death.”
Provoked by Celestial Fall, Aurora True God became even angrier.
It sneered, “Fine, then we’ll fulfill your wish!”
“Charge! Exterminate the remnants of the Supreme Hall!”
In the next moment, twelve True Gods from the Forbidden Star River charged forward.
Whereas the four Ancient Demon Gods from the Abyss Realm did not act immediately, for unknown reasons.

chapters.title: Chapter 1048: Supreme Hall Emerges (Part 3)
paragraphs: In the alternate space, after being heavily injured by the True God of Radiance’s spear, the three ancient gods no longer dared to act recklessly.
Staring at the dozen or so true gods charging forth.
The three-eyed man, Dragon Hunter, as well as that Buddha and White-clothed Hunter, all drew their bows and arrows.
They were all Wild Rangers of their time, each possessing battle power at the true god level.
Han Xing said at this moment, “Celestial Fall, can we manage this? The number of true gods on the other side seems to be much greater than ours.”
The three-eyed man turned and smiled, “Kid, people from the Supreme Hall have never said they can’t manage it.”
“Even if there are more of them, we must showcase the style of the Supreme Hall!”
“Watch carefully, this is what it means to be a Wild Ranger!”
In the next moment, the three eyes of the three-eyed man all shot out a beam.
These beams fused into one.
A more terrifying attack than ever before emerged.
All true gods, whether initial or middle tier, seeing the ray from the three-eyed man sweeping over, avoided the sharp edge!
At the same time.
The Dragon Hunter pulled the bowstring, which faintly emitted a dragon’s roar.
“Roar!”
The next moment, an arrow shot out.
This arrow transformed into a giant dragon in the air, charging towards the group of true gods, then exploded violently!
At the same time.
The white-robed Hunter also lifted his longbow.
In the next moment, behind every true god, a bright moon appeared.
This was unexpectedly the enhanced version of the [Broken Moon] skill!
After a terrifying explosion.
The twelve true gods from the Forbidden Star River were blasted back.
The few initial-tier true gods from Silent City were severely injured!
The true gods on the scene showed shocked expressions as they stared at these four Hunters.
“How can they be this strong?”
The true gods from Silent City said incredulously.
Because the combat power they displayed at this time completely surpassed typical middle-tier true gods.
The Aurora True God took a deep breath and explained, “Because they are people of the Supreme Hall.”
“The Hunters’ selection was the most talented of that era; they were unmatched in the same tier. Now they’ve reached the true god realm, which also far exceeds ordinary true gods.”
“Therefore, we are no match for them!”
At this moment, Han Xing, seeing the four Wild Rangers from the Supreme Hall showing great power, was extremely excited.
“Wonderful! Truly deserving of the title Wild Ranger, each more fierce than the last!”
Originally thinking he would surely fail his breakthrough this time.
Unexpectedly, the situation took a turn, and the presence of the Supreme Hall emerged!
Hope seemed to reappear in Han Xing’s eyes.
At the same time, Han Xing looked at the increasingly tangible divine format before him.
The divine power fluctuation on it was about to reach divine level strength.
A divine format reaching divine level power strength, truly unheard of.
The progress bar in front turned to 98%!
The final two minutes!
Looking at the current situation, the four Wild Rangers, coupled with Han Xing’s Sky Island aid, could completely hold out.
The premise being, those ancient gods and demons from the Abyss Realm do not make a move.
Han Xing seemed to see the hope of victory.
However, the true gods of the Forbidden Star River, having attacked unsuccessfully for so long, were gradually becoming anxious.
They saw the rules in the area where Han Xing was, becoming increasingly dim.
Almost as if this man was gradually separating from the rules.
What does this represent?
This represents that their power of rules might not be able to affect this man!
Such a method is simply the nemesis of rules!
The power of rules urged on continuously.
Yet, the situation before wasn’t resolved by mere urging.
The Aurora True God said anxiously, “Abyss Realm, alternate space, are you not going to act?”
However, the three ancient gods also very much wanted to act.
But they were just scared by the burst from the True God of Radiance and that Sky Island.
Unlike those true gods, ancient gods cannot be immortal.
If they die, they truly die!
Seeing as Han Xing was about to succeed, the three ancient gods gritted their teeth, preparing to charge again.
At this moment, the True God of Radiance, who had recovered some strength, blocked the three ancient gods once more.
Not only that, over nine thousand high-tier defense towers on the Sky Island were activated immediately,
The three ancient gods stopped instantly.
As for the Abyss Realm, for some unknown reason.
The four ancient demon gods also did not act immediately.
Watching as the power of rules in Han Xing’s area became increasingly chaotic.
This was a sign of his imminent breakthrough.
The group of true gods appeared even more anxious.
At this moment, a cold snort echoed from the Forbidden Star River.
The next moment, this dazzling star river began to shake wildly.
It seemed as if an extremely terrifying power was about to burst out from it.
“Crooked Staff, Eye of the Netherworld.”
“Ruling endless dimness, sweeping through the nine gloomy realms.”
“Today, I, the Nether Emperor am finally coming out!”
Boom!
The Forbidden Star River shook violently, its waves continuously rising, seemingly trying to forcefully suppress this Nether Emperor!
However, within, the angry voice of the Nether Emperor resounded.
“Hunter! Today you cannot trap me!”
“I must come out, return to the Void Realm, and then kill all the remnants of your Supreme Hall!”
On the scene, many divine spirits murmured the name of this majestic existence.
“Nether Emperor!!!”
Han Xing asked from behind, “Celestial Fall, is this Nether Emperor this arrogant?”
The three-eyed man replied helplessly, “Of course he is arrogant, because he is a high-tier true god, none of us four together can beat him.”
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was startled, “What the hell, that strong?”
“Doesn’t our Supreme Hall have anyone who can beat him?”
Celestial Fall responded, “Of course, the Master of War Ghosts, the Master of the Celestial River, the Master of the Great Star can easily defeat him!”
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was delighted, “Where are they then?”
Celestial Fall shrugged, “Dead...”
Han Xing rolled his eyes.
At the same time, the waves in the Forbidden Star River became increasingly fierce.
Towering waves over a hundred thousand meters high were everywhere, crashing down repeatedly.
And in the river center, a massive black hand was struggling desperately to break free!

chapters.title: Chapter 1049 - 523: Seeing Through the Essence, Knowing Past and Future
paragraphs: However, the actions of the Nether Emperor incited a more intense reaction from the Forbidden Star River.
"Boom! Boom boom!"
The explosive sound of waves was incessant.
Seeing this scene, Han Xing couldn’t help but feel nervous.
If that Nether Emperor truly emerged, they would be finished!
A high-tier True God is capable of employing the Fusion of the Self anytime, anywhere.
One high-tier True God could kill them all!
"Damn it! Let me out!!"
The voice of the Nether Emperor grew louder, though soon was covered by the surging waves.
Until the voice of the Nether Emperor completely vanished, the waves of the Silent Star River also calmed down.
Everyone present was stunned for a moment.
Because this meant the Nether Emperor had failed.
The True God of Yellow Sand exclaimed in shock, "Is the seal of this Forbidden Star River really that terrifying? It can even forcibly pull back such a formidable entity!"
Yes, it pulled back.
At the final moment, they saw the Nether Emperor’s flesh body almost emerging.
Yet he was forcibly yanked back by the Forbidden Star River.

Beside him, the Aurora True God nodded and said, "Naturally, the Forbidden Star River was the terrifying power that slew so many of our True Gods back then. The stronger the entity, the harder it is to emerge."
At this moment, they looked towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was located, where a Divine Format was already nearly forming.
The Aurora True God urgently said, "Abyss Realm dwellers, are you really going to stand by and let this kid succeed?"
As he spoke,
The four Ancient Demon Gods exchanged glances,
Then simultaneously unleashed a terrifying aura, charging towards the Sky Island where Han Xing was.
They all knew this was the last chance!
If they didn’t kill that human this time, it would be even harder to get another chance later!
Meanwhile, the Ancient God of the Alternate Space also rushed over.
Celestial Fate turned his head and asked, "Kid, how much longer until you succeed?"
Han Xing glanced and replied, "1 minute and 31 seconds!"
Upon hearing this, Celestial Fate nodded, "Good, for the last minute and a half, no matter what happens, we will hold off the enemies for you!"
"If we unfortunately die in battle, don’t rush to avenge us.
"I can see your potential is even more terrifying than that of Hunter; you have an endless future."
"As long as you survive, your future achievements may surpass Hunter."
"So, once you break through, escape immediately, hide in the endless Void, and do not emerge no matter what happens."
Listening to Celestial Fate’s advice, Han Xing did not respond.
Meanwhile, those True Gods were already charging forward.
Celestial Fate, Dragon War, Yue Heng, Anton.
Four Venerable Hunters from the Supreme Hall unleashed their full aura.
In the next moment, they surprisingly used the Fusion of the Self simultaneously, just like the True God of Radiance.
These geniuses of the past, were the demons of their era.
It’s not surprising they could use such a technique.
However, the Ancient Demon Gods of the Abyss Realm were no pushovers.
The bodies of the four Demon Gods expanded rapidly, and in the blink of an eye, had grown tens of thousands of times, crushing everything around!
In the next moment, over twenty attacks from the True Gods came simultaneously crashing down.
"Buzz!"
Energy ripples erupted.
Han Xing’s Sky Island trembled violently.
At that instant, at least hundreds of high-tier Defense Towers were destroyed.
Seeing this scene.
The Dragon Hunter directly commanded his giant dragon to come to Han Xing’s side.
"Roar!"
With a dragon’s roar, the giant dragon’s body suddenly coiled around, shielding the entire Sky Island and Cheng Jianyong’s Divine Demon Battleship.
At this moment.
The four talents from the Supreme Hall faced off against over twenty True Gods.
Even though they had merged with their true selves, they couldn’t compete with so many powerful entities.
Their enemies were too strong!
In the next moment, Celestial Fate and the other four strong individuals were blasted back!
The terrifying energy waves totally collapsed that chunk of the Void.
If it weren’t for being protected by that giant dragon.
Just this wave would have obliterated Han Xing and the others!
"Pfft! Pfft pfft!"
The four people spewed mouthfuls of fresh blood.
The Fusion of the Self they used was no weaker than that of the True God of Radiance.
Nonetheless, upon first contact, they were directly forced to retreat!
Almost being forced out of their Fusion of the Self state.
The man with the face of Bright Moon behind them said with a pale visage, "Celestial Fate, these guys are strong, this isn’t good..."
Celestial Fate also looked grim, "Indeed strong, but no matter how strong, we have to endure!"
"This kid is our hope for turning the tide; if he survives, he could even surpass everyone!"
"Everyone, fight with me!"
The three Venerable Hunters exchanged a glance, and ruthless determination also surfaced in their eyes.
Dragon War led by drawing the bowstring and shouted lightly, "Kill!"
Swoosh! Swoosh swoosh swoosh!
Arrows flew across the sky out of hand!
And just then, a flesh body of an Abyss Realm Demon God loomed in the Void, absorbing all those arrows.
In the next moment, the remaining True Gods, the Ancient God of the Alternate Space attacked simultaneously.
"Pfft!"
The four Venerable Hunters were blasted back again.
However, they relentlessly charged forward.
Time after time, they were battered to the point of being unrecognizable, yet absorbed the Power of Rules to swiftly recover.
In the blink of an eye, thirty seconds passed.
The bodies of the four True Gods were covered in dense cracks!
They exchanged a look, each seeing the gravity in the others’ eyes.
"These guys... back then Hunter fought them like dogs, I thought they were really that weak."
"Turns out, it’s Hunter who was too strong."
"Any entity capable of breaking through to True God level shouldn’t be underestimated!"
Celestial Fate lamented while restoring the injuries on his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1050: Seeing Through Essence, Knowing Past and Future (Part 2)
paragraphs: The other three Venerable Hunters nodded in agreement.
In just thirty seconds, they were severely injured countless times; if not for the Tree of Rules constantly supplying energy to restore them.
The four from the Supreme Hall would have already died.
The ancient demon gods of the Abyss Realm were mainly to blame; their attack power was simply terrifying!
Additionally, the three ancient gods from the Alternate Space kept launching various curse attacks, making it hard for them to cope!
At this moment, Dragon War suddenly took a deep breath, “I’ll hold off the four demon gods from the Abyss Realm; the rest are up to you!”
Upon finishing, without waiting for others to respond, he charged straight towards the four ancient demon gods.
As he charged, Dragon War’s body rapidly expanded.
In the blink of an eye, his body was covered in dragon scales, and claws and a tail grew out.
The next moment, an Eastern Giant Dragon, colossal even before the Silent Star River, appeared!
“Roar!!!”
The terrifying dragon roar echoed through the void!
Many True Gods on the field changed colors.

The True God of Crystal stated gravely, “Legend has it, Dragon War possesses the bloodline of the Holy Dragon, able to briefly unleash the power of that Emperor-level Giant Dragon, but no one has ever seen him perform it.”
“Now it seems the legend is true.”
“The Holy Dragon bloodline in Dragon War’s body has become potent enough to transform into his true form!”
Other True Gods were also astonished as they looked at the silver-white giant dragon in the void.
Simultaneously, Dragon War directly lunged towards the four ancient demon gods.
“Boom!”
A face-off collision happened.
The four ancient demon gods instantly flew backward!
Meanwhile, Dragon War wrapped his tail around, directly dragging the four ancient demon gods away from the battlefield.
Leaving Celestial Fall, Yue Heng, and Anton to confront the remaining True Gods!
Thirty more seconds passed.
The three from the Supreme Hall reached a state of exceptional serious injuries.
Even the three-eyed man, Celestial Fall, had cracks appearing more frequently on his body.
Not even the Tree of Rules could quickly restore his injuries.
Blood gushed from one eye of Celestial Fall, and the relaxed smile he had earlier vanished, replaced by a serious expression.
Beside him, Yue Heng’s Bright Moon behind him also exhibited countless cracks, and there was even a notch as if bitten by some creature.
Yue Heng shouted angrily, “Damn it! I’ve been attacked too many times.”
“The power of rules from these guys remains in my body, constantly damaging it.”
“At this rate, I’ll soon enter a dormant state.”
Just then.
The Hunter resembling a Golden Body Arhat, who had been silent earlier.
Suddenly spoke, “Celestial Fall, I can’t hold on anymore, I’ll take a step ahead.”
The three-eyed man’s gaze instantly fixed upon him, only to see this giant resembling Golden Body Arhat had terrifying blood holes appearing on his back, with something seeming to squirm inside them.
This was the handiwork of the ancient gods from the Alternate Space.
As he finished speaking, this Arhat charged directly into the True Gods’ ranks of the Forbidden Star River.
Then, his body expanded rapidly, absorbing massive energy like a whale.
In that instant, due to the overwhelming amount of absorbed energy, an energy tide formed.
All True Gods on the field felt a terrifying sense of crisis!
“Retreat! Quickly retreat!”
“Anton is going to self-destruct!”
But before they could react.
Anton’s body exploded violently.
In that moment, time seemed to stop.
The True Gods watched as the void shattered like a mirror.
And the signs of explosion rapidly spread,
in just an instant, enveloping all True Gods, including the ancient gods from the Alternate Space.
“Crack!”
Boom!
After a terrifying explosion noise.
A Tree of Rules appeared in the sky.
And the many True Gods on the field were trapped within that energy storm, doing their utmost to resist.
Five seconds later, all movement ceased.
The True Gods reappeared, faces difficult.
Though none were taken away by that wave of explosion, they sustained exceedingly serious injuries!
“Anton! You’re ruthless!”
The True God of Judgment gritted his teeth.
This Venerable Hunter used self-destruct as a sacrifice, stalling them for five seconds.
Meanwhile, the True God of Crystal, while recovering his injuries, said, “No need to be agitated, this has always been a tactic of the Supreme Hall.”
“When they can’t win, they directly self-destruct. Those guys from the Supreme Hall have done it more than three times.”
At the same time.
Han Xing was just thirty seconds away from forming.
The Aurora True God commanded, “Go! Don’t let that kid succeed!”
The True Gods gathered their strength, once again charging towards Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Just then, Celestial Fall instructed the white-robed Hunter beside him, “I can hold off these guys for over five seconds.”
“The remaining time is up to you.”
Celestial Fall took a deep breath, intending to emulate Anton by directly self-destructing.
At that moment, the white-robed Hunter said, “Let me do it, you’ve died more than three times already. Another death, and you truly become a slave to the rules.”
As he finished, without waiting for Celestial Fall to refuse.
The white-robed Hunter instantly charged out.
Then, he drew his bowstring instantly.
Simultaneously, the white-robed Hunter’s moon disappeared from behind him, appearing behind the group of True Gods instead.
“Broken Moon!”
A faint voice emerged.
All True Gods felt their space was confined, including their power of rules, which were completely sealed.
They were immobilized, like insects sealed in amber!
